meta.source: Star Citizen Data.p4k -> Data/Game2.dcb (DataCore v8) + Localization/english/global.ini — eigene Extraktion
meta.lang: Missionstexte liegen in den Spieldateien nur auf Englisch vor; die deutsche global.ini enthaelt keine Missionstitel/-beschreibungen.
meta.systems: Zwei Quellen: das Missionsbrett (MissionBrokerEntry) und der Contract-Manager (ContractGenerator -> Contract/CareerContract). CIG migriert vom ersten zum zweiten; ContractLegacy.missionBrokerEntry ist die Bruecke, ueber die beide Systeme dieselbe Mission bezeichnen — solche Eintraege stehen hier nur einmal.
meta.guilds: Die Gildenzuordnung stammt aus der Ordnerstruktur der Spieldateien (contractgenerator/<gilde>_guild/...), nicht aus einem lokalisierten Namen — die global.ini fuehrt dafuer keine Bezeichnungen. Lesbar gemacht, aber keine offizielle Schreibweise.
meta.blueprints: Blueprint-Belohnungen haengen ausschliesslich am Contract-System; kein einziger der 419 Legacy-Contracts hat einen Pool. Ein Pool ist eine gewichtete Liste, aus der gezogen wird — welcher Blueprint faellt, ist Zufall.
meta.objectives: Der Spielertext der Missionsziele ist nicht Teil der Client-Dateien: MissionObjective/ObjectiveDisplayInfo haben im DataCore null Instanzen, gefuellt werden sie von den Subsumption-Modulen, die serverseitig laufen (unter Libs/Subsumption/Missions liegen nur AC/EA/Environmental). Ausgegeben wird darum der Ablauf aus objectiveTokens (Entwicklernamen) und missionFlow (Designer-Beschreibungen).

givers.name: Civilian Defense Force
givers.desc: Created as part of the Militia Mobilization Initiative, the Civilian Defense Force (CDF) is a volunteer militia that can be called upon by the UEE to provide support during times of crisis and large scale threats. The group is not intended to replace existing security forces, but rather temporarily bolster efforts during emergencies. CDF volunteers are called upon to fulfill a variety of roles from combat to support positions.

givers.name: Clovus Darneely
givers.desc: Clovus Darneely is a clerk at Reclamation & Disposal, Lorville's main salvage yard. With a reputation for being highly educated and a bit of an erudite, it is unclear among his clients why he works in such a remedial position.

givers.name: Constantine Hurston
givers.desc: A proud member of the Hurston family, Constantine Hurston has pledged himself to helping his family's legacy continue to grow. However, rather than rely on his name alone, Constantine claims that he prefers to earn any promotions by his own merit. While currently only a Jr. Outsourcing Agent, he firmly believes that he will soon prove his worth and quickly rise through the ranks of Hurston Dynamics.

givers.name: Headhunters
givers.desc: One of the oldest gangs in the Pyro System, the Headhunters have earned themselves a reputation for being ruthless and respected. Unlike many outlaws, when the Headhunters strike a deal they're known for keeping their word. Especially if they promise to kill someone. They are currently seeking to wrest control of Ruin Station away from XenoThreat.

givers.name: Miles Eckhart
givers.desc: After leaving the Army, Miles Eckhart missed the excitement of his former life and decided to try mercenary work. He took to it so well that before long he started his own company, Eckhart Security. Specializing in operations in unclaimed and hostile systems like Nyx, Miles remains fully independent and unaffiliated with the Mercenary Guild.

givers.name: Recco Battaglia
givers.desc: Recco Battaglia, the latest in a long line of miners, had continued the family tradition until an accident at a dig site left her unable to work. Frustrated with her post-accident treatment under the bureaucracy of the UEE and United Resource Workers, Recco moved out to Nyx where she now coordinates contractor operations for the People's Alliance.

givers.name: Ruto
givers.desc: One of the best known info brokers in Stanton, the true identity of Ruto remains a complete mystery. Only appearing as a hologram of the former Imperator, Kelos Costigan, Ruto manages a vast network of criminal activity, connections, and knowledge for clients such as the Nine Tails.

givers.name: Tecia Pacheco
givers.desc: Tecia "Twitch" Pacheco came up as a soldier who transitioned into freelance security work after her service ended. Things were going well until she suffered nerve damage on a job for BlacJac and was fired. Left without employment but with a very specialized skillset, Twitch used her knowledge of the criminal underworld of ArcCorp to her advantage and began operating her own illegal enterprise.

givers.name: Wallace Klim
givers.desc: After being terminated from his position as a chemical engineering instructor at the University of Rhetor, Wallace Klim is now one of the top producers of high-end drugs in the Stanton System. The quality of his product is apparent by his own frequent personal use.

givers.name: XenoThreat
givers.desc: XenoThreat believes that the UEE's continued acceptance of aliens has set Humanity on a path towards destruction. Rather than protecting its citizens, the UEE has given in to greed and has shown a complete disregard for the values that made Humanity great in the first place. In response, XenoThreat is attempting to lead a revolution to take back the soul of the Empire.

missions.title: {ReputationRank} Rank - {CargoGradeToken} Cargo Haul
missions.desc:
Hi there,

The refinery at {Address} has been busy. They’ve processed a bunch of {Item} into containers {MissionMaxSCUSize} or smaller, and are looking to get it shipped out from a freight elevator. I just checked with the LEOs to see which ones needed this stuff and was able to put together this run.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

{SingleToMultiToken}

Should be an easy run for you, if you’re free.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

{SignOff}

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.desc:
Hello,

There’s some junk waiting at a freight elevator in {Address} that needs to go to a freight elevator at {Address} for processing. I've confirmed that the containers won't be bigger than {MissionMaxSCUSize}.

My mom would’ve loved this run. She’s one of those who thinks every scrapyard is filled with hidden treasures. Can’t even tell you how many hours I spent bored out of my mind following her around one. If that’s your thing, here’s a chance to actually make credits going to one.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

{SignOff}

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. missions.title: get the goods
missions.desc:
Oh hello, I recently overheard a little bit of intel that {address} received some confidential materials that are of great interest to an acquaintance of mine. So interesting that they’re willing to pay for someone to storm the facility, grab the goods, and deliver them to {address}. Now I expect there to be plenty of security, who will most likely put up a fight, so I’d bring a gun or two.

Word is the confidential materials were delivered in a consignment alongside other stuff and are now being stored in the facility’s automated vault. Senior security officers on-site carry datapads containing retrieval codes used to access the vault. You’ll have to get your hands on a datapad before using the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes.

If you need a little sweetener, I’ve seen the manifest and can confirm that the other crates being stored at the facility are pretty choice. My client could care less about what happens to them, so they’re yours to do as you please. Run this right and those extra crates could be a nice bonus on top of the delivery fee for you.

We got some outlaws overstaying their welcome on one of our stations. They tried to pull a fast one on us but now they’re trapped in {address}. We need you to clear ‘em out.

Rough & Ready doesn’t want a single one of them left alive when you’re through. Don’t care how messy it gets as long as it gets done, got it?

- Smokey

missions.title: Retrieval Op
missions.desc:
Here's the deal – a client of ours (who should have spent the extra credits for a Northrock escort) had one of their ships attacked and now they need us to run point on a retrieval op for an important package that was stolen.

Thankfully, we caught a break and were able to track down the people responsible to {Address}. We need you to head there and recover the package. You'll be able to ID it by its serial number: #{SerialNumber}.

I expect that the outlaws are going to put up a fight, but just remember that they aren't the priority.

Once you got the package, fly it back to the client at {Address}.

One last thing, make sure you bring a ship that has enough room for some cargo. Don't want you getting all the way there in your Gladius or whatever only to have to turn back.

Do us proud,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

*RETRIEVAL OPERATION SUMMARY*
* Recover Package #{SerialNumber} from {Address}
* Deliver to {Address}

missions.title: Additional Resources For Research
missions.desc:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of materials which they believe could be essential for their experiments.

In particular, our scientists at {Address} have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "Explorer's Guide to Harvestables" in your Journal.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.title: Bounty Assignment: {TargetName} (HRT)
missions.desc:
Hey,

Got a contract for you that requires a bit more tactics than usual. A high-level criminal by the name {TargetName} is hiding with a large contingent of outlaws at {Address}.

Our intel suggests that {Last}’s forces most likely will act as defensive line in order to protect their boss. My best guess is that you will have to deal with them before you gain access to {Last}.

That said, I don’t want you shooting indiscriminately. Sometimes these outlaws keep civilians around and they should be treated like non-combatants.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Covalex Local Shipment Route
{Destination} Stroll
missions.desc:
Any chance you’re at {Destination}?

Need a box hustled from {Address} to {Address}. Get it there on time and unbroken and it’ll be the easiest creds you’ll ever earn.

-Smokey

missions.title: Defend Site and Retrieve Confidential Materials
missions.desc:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep & Package Retrieval
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: Yes

Hurston has learned that the Nine Tails are attacking {address}. Our on-site forces have suffered heavy casualties and stopped responding to comms. Initial reports indicated that the gang was attempting to obtain confidential material recently delivered to the facility. Thankfully, we have security measures in place that should give us time to respond. We need an operative to head to the facility immediately, retrieve those boxes, and deliver them to a secure location.

You and whatever backup you choose to bring are authorized to take any actions necessary when confronting the trespassers. Suspects are considered armed and dangerous. Hurston will not provide material support and/or updates regarding the status of the facility's security forces.

The confidential materials were discreetly delivered alongside other boxes in a consignment and locked in our automated vault with access codes kept on datapads held by senior security staff. However, there’s a strong chance Nine Tails may already have gotten their hands on them. You’ll need to find those datapads and then enter the codes at the package conveyor to retrieve the confidential materials. Payment will be sent once they have been delivered to {address}.

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

missions.title: Extermination Job
missions.desc:
Rough & Ready has a rat problem. One of our crews tried to pull a little mutiny and now they’ve taken over {address}.

Since I can’t be 100% sure they don’t have sympathizers onboard the station, I want you to handle putting down these traitors for me.

If you can clear out our little pest issue you’ll be paid handsomely. Just don’t leave a single one of them alive. Don’t want anyone else getting funny ideas.

- Smokey

missions.title: They Will Be Missed
missions.desc:
A senior security official by the name of {TargetName} has been marked for termination. While they can be found at {Address}, they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.

Normally, I would recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. However, in this instance a more delicate touch is required. While you should feel free to eliminate any and all of the security forces on site, you must ensure the safety of all the civilian workers there.

Tiresome for sure, but a requirement none the less.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

missions.title: Wrecked Ships for Sale
missions.desc:
Had a few wrecked ships towed to {Address}. They’re fully out of commission and in dire need of scrapping. If you’re interested in salvaging what’s left, it can be all yours, for a fair price, too.

Plus, you don’t have to worry much about any distractions while you’re workin’ since you’ll be near one of our stations and we make sure folks behave themselves.

- Smokey

titleVariants.text: Orange Level Contract: Handle Security Threat

missions.title: out of stock
missions.desc:
One of my clients has been unhappy to learn that someone's been muscling in on their territory. Now rather than going down the more traditional route of killing some people and starting a whole thing, they’ve opted to send a different kind of message instead.

You’re gonna go down to {Address} and destroy all the drugs on site.

Of course, if someone does wanna pick a fight with you, feel free to defend yourself, but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

missions.title: Pilot in Distress
missions.desc:
It seems one of the routes that we had thought relatively safe has proven otherwise. Outlaws have attacked one of our pilots over at {Address} and they won't make it much longer without support.

I'd appreciate it if you could fly there as quickly as possible and help them deal with these attackers.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Pilot Seeking Combat Support
missions.desc:
One of our pilots had just picked up a shipment of supplies near {Address} when they were attacked by some vicious shipjackers.

We just received their distress beacon and I'm hoping you can go provide them combat support.

Any assistance you could give would make all the difference.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Ship Needs Emergency Assistance
missions.desc:
A Citizens for Prosperity affiliated ship was attempting to deliver some supplies to {Address} when they were attacked by the recipients who didn't want to pay for their purchase and chose violence instead.

I'll instruct our traders to be more careful about who they deal with in the future, but for now, I would really appreciate you lending them a hand in fighting off these attackers.

Appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.desc:
POSTING: Purchase Order

It’s locked inside a hangar, so you’ll need to get to it via the station’s elevators. But once inside, you’ll be able to override the lockdown at a console. Do that and it should be easy pickings.

missions.title: CDF ALERT: {Location} Blockade Runners Needed
missions.desc:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

A hostile fleet of ships equipped with quantum jammers have created a blockade around {address}, disabled the station's defensive turrets, and stolen a large supply of Zeta-Prolanide. In response, the CDF has received authorization to activate its volunteer force.

Though the overall situation is dire, the theft of the Zeta-Prolanide is our priority. Without direct action, the loss of the sector's Zeta-Prolanide stores could have a devastating effects to the wider economy of the whole system.

While local security forces are investigating the incursion, they've tracked the stolen inventory to several locations. CDF volunteers are tasked with heading to these locations, recovering the stolen Zeta-Prolanide, and transferring it back to the station before the material completely degrades and is no longer viable. Just be careful, intel suggests that larger clusters of Zeta-Prolanide have a higher outlaw presence.

Since time is of the essence, having a tractor beam to assist in moving the cargo is highly advised.

As an added incentive, volunteers will receive regular bonus payments for their combined efforts.

missions.title: Confiscate Contraband
missions.desc:
Crusader Security has learned that an illegal production facility at {Address} is currently being used to manufacture contraband.

We are seeking a contractor to secure the site, confiscate any contraband, and deliver it to us at {Address}. The administrative commodity terminal will allow you to submit the contraband into our evidence hold and collect your payment.

Now, this is an automated facility so it’s not clear how long they’ll be manufacturing for, or even how many people may be on site. To be safe, I would go in expecting to meet heavy resistance.

Your total compensation will be based on how packages are safely delivered into evidence.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Vanzant
ID# 712L921P

missions.title: Defend Location and Deliver Confidential Materials
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a security professional for a retrieval op at {Location}. The location is currently under attack and security forces on-site are unresponsive and presumed dead. We believe confidential materials recently delivered to the facility for temporary holding were the target of the raid. Your main focus will be collecting those boxes and delivering them to a secure location.

For security reasons, the confidential materials were delivered as part of a larger shipment and secured in the automated vault. The materials have unique retrieval codes that must be entered on the keypad at the package conveyor. Protocols require that only senior security officers can carry a datapad containing a code, but considering the volatile situation, we can't guarantee that the Nine Tails haven’t taken possession of them. Once secured, deliver all of the confidential materials to {dropoff1} for payment.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {address}.
• Use force as necessary to collect the confidential materials.
• Deliver the confidential materials to {address}.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment.
• Access to a spaceship that can transport cargo.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.
• Experience hauling important cargo.

missions.title: Erase Eavesdropper
missions.desc:
Got a minor annoyance the Headhunters need dealt with. There's an orbital sentry at {address} that some pesky little troublemaker set up to spy on our ops. Want to make some easy creds and go blow it up for us?

Stows out.

missions.title: Inter-Outpost Delivery at {Destination}
missions.desc:
Hey,

We’ve got an opportunity for any haulers interested in lending a hand or two to Citizens for Prosperity.

There’s a box that needs to be moved from {Address} to {Address}. Shouldn’t take long, if you’re around the outpost and available.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Lookin' for Zeta-Prolanide
missions.desc:
Word is that a lot of Zeta-Prolanide has been stolen from {address}.

If you happen to come across any, bring it over to {address} and we'll make sure you get a good price.

And if not, you can abandon this offer, no hard feelings.

missions.title: Med. Purchase Order: Vehicle Mined Ore
missions.desc:
POSTING: Purchase Order
LOCATION: {System}

TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is currently looking to fulfil another purchase order for a variety of materials. We appreciate your help in this matter.

~{Hint_Location} For a comprehensive list of where to find these minerals, consult Mining Fundamentals #2: Where to Mine in your mobiGlas Journal.

Since this is a purchase order and not a mining contract, you are expected to provide your own equipment, such as a {Hint_Tool}.

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at {Address}.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Overdrive Initiative: INTEL RAID
missions.desc:
We've received tips that XenoThreat's intending to launch another attack on Stanton system. The CDF has petitioned the Advocacy to create a new initiative called Operation Overdrive to stop this attack before it happens.

The CDF is dispatching volunteers to infiltrate and obtain any intel that could give insight into what they're planning. Needless to say, expect heavy resistance from any XenoThreat on site.

As an added incentive, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

missions.title: Overdrive Initiative: XENOTHREAT INCURSION
missions.desc:
Waves of XenoThreat ships have been pushing into Stanton system and attacking random civilians. We can't tell if this is an isolated attack or a reaction to our recent initiatives, but we need them stopped.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

missions.title: Protect Site and Procure Confidential Materials
missions.desc:
ATTN: Mercenaries with Cargo Handling Experience

Nine Tails are currently assaulting one of our facilities at {address}. As they just received a delivery of confidential materials, we don’t believe this is a coincidence. BlacJac needs someone to hurry to the location and secure these important boxes before the Nine Tails do. You are authorized to use lethal force against any who attempt to stop you.

As part of our standard security protocol, the confidential materials were integrated into another consignment and secured in the automated vault. You’ll need to find the relevant retrieval codes for the confidential materials and enter it at the package conveyor to retrieve the boxes. Retrieval codes are stored locally on datapads and only given to high-ranking staff. Hopefully they’re alive to help you, but considering the complete comms blackout, we fear that’s not the case. There's a chance Nine Tails have already gotten their hands on the datapads.

Once you’ve gathered all the confidential materials, they will need to be delivered to {address}. Payment is contingent upon their delivery.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Ripe for Retribution
missions.desc:
Some interesting information just fell into my lap. Guess the notorious XenoThreat leader {TargetName} is holed up at {address} working on some big op for them. Perfect opportunity to kill the piece of shit once and for all.

Thing is, the Xenos have their eyes all over Headhunter operations at the moment. There’s no way we can mobilize and deploy a crew without {Last} getting tipped off. So I’m offering you the chance to make Pyro a better place and earn some creds at the same time.

If interested, I suggest gearing up and finding some backup before heading out. You'll only get paid if you take out {Last}, but don’t hesitate to kill any other little XenoThugs that might be hiding there with ‘em.

Stows out.

missions.title: Ripe for the Taking
missions.desc:
Got some good news for you. As we speak, there’s an automated facility that is churning out package after package of primo product that’s pretty much ripe for the taking.

All you have to do is swoop down there, deal with a thug or two, grab whatever you can, and sell it for a huge profit. Shouldn’t be a problem at all. And there are plenty of people around who would pay good creds to take product like that off your hands.

Speaking of credits, I’m not gonna just give out the coordinates of this facility out of the kindness of my heart. I think it’s only fair to ask a finder’s fee for info this good.

I wouldn’t wait too long. Not sure how long the site will be left running.

-Ruto

missions.title: Support Security Forces and Secure Confidential Materials
missions.desc:
Reports indicate that our security staff at {address} have been wiped out by a group of Nine Tails, who are attempting to steal confidential materials that were recently delivered to the facility. Crusader Security needs an experienced contractor to expel the hostiles and secure these boxes.

Based on the initial reports, we strongly recommend that you come well-equipped and consider bringing back-up. For security purposes, the confidential materials were transported there as part of a consignment with other boxes and locked in an automated vault. The retrieval codes to access the confidential materials are stored on datapads held by high-ranking security staff, but we don’t know who has them now. Odds are that the Nine Tails will be looking for them too.

When you have all the confidential materials, deliver them to {address} to receive payment.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: They Will Be Missed
missions.desc:
A security officer by the name of {TargetName} is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at {Address} along with a host of other eager types in uniforms.

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of {TargetName} which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

----------------------------

One of the folks over at {Address} just hit me up about a pile of cargo, {MissionMaxSCUSize} or smaller, that needs to be hauled out to a few different spots.

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)
{SingleToMultiToken}

I'm trusting you to set your own route here, so don't mess it up. And try to stay away from anywhere too dangerous. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

missions.title: {ReputationRank} Hauler Needed for Direct {CargoGradeToken} Shipment
missions.desc:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Have a run here that could become a lucrative regular thing if we can pull it off. This’ll take you into Pyro, so you’ll have to be ready to tangle with some of the locals.

You’ll need to grab the stuff from {Address}, make the jump to Pyro, and then get to {Address}.

All you need to do is bring a ship with space for {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers, a handheld tractor beam, and be ready to do some damage if someone picks a fight with you.

missions.title: {ReputationRank} Hauler Needed for Direct {CargoGradeToken} Shipment
missions.desc:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at {Address} to {Address}. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to {MissionMaxSCUSize} in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

missions.title: {TargetName} needs stomping
missions.desc:
Got a small fry who thinks they can hit the Headhunters and get away with it. So {TargetName} tried to knock over one of our stashes and think they can get away with it.

Last we heard they were spotted around {Address}. We need someone to head over and send a very clear message who is the reigning power in the system.

Do it quick and clean.

Stows out.

missions.title: Agent of Chaos
missions.desc:
Citizens for Prosperity have entrenched themselves at {Address}. To keep them from getting too comfy at that station, we want to show them what life is really like in our system. We’ll pay you to hit the station, grab the {item}, and kill anyone that gets in your way.

Payment hinges on you delivering those supplies to {Address}. Anyone you kill will just be a perk.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Ambush Op
missions.desc:
One of our Clips put out a kill order on a {AmbushTarget}. Feel like making ‘em happy by taking it out?

Here’s what you need to know. The target and their escort are scheduled to pass by {Address}. Looks like there’s an emission cloud nearby that can hide your ship’s sig. Wait there until you’re ready to strike.

The Clip only cares about wiping out the target. Anything of value you find floating in the wreckage is all yours.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus {ScripAmount} Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

- Stows

missions.title: Assist Retreating Ship
missions.desc:
One of our people is currently under attack at {Address}. They have attempted to elude their attackers to get to safely, but the outlaws have proven too skilled for them to break away.

We need you to fly there, engage with the attackers, and then destroy the nearby fuel reserves. The hope is that this display of destruction will dissuade them from continuing pursuit.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Blow Up Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Reserves
missions.desc:
I'm getting pretty bloody sick of Citizens for Prosperity sticking their noses where they don't belong.

Started thinking that it might be pretty nice to ground their fleet for a little bit. We blow up their fuel tanks at {Address} and those little pissheads won't be going nowhere quick.

Sound like your kinda thing?

-Stows out

missions.title: Call for Help: {Location}
missions.desc:
We've received a distress call from {Address}. A group of unknown assailants have launched an attack. There have been multiple deaths reported and we need to reclaim the outpost.

I know this is far from your current position, but we're desperate to secure the area and get the outpost back and running again.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Combat Assistance - LOW THREAT
missions.desc:
[LOW THREAT]

~serviceBeacon(InitiatorName) is requesting combat assistance in deep space. If accepted, you will be paid ~serviceBeacon(PaymentAmount) aUEC upon elimination of the threat.

Distance to ~serviceBeacon(InitiatorName) : ~serviceBeacon(DistToInitiator)

missions.title: Confidential Material Stolen
missions.desc:
You available for a job? One of our secure locations got hit by outlaws and some highly confidential material was stolen. As you can imagine, Citizens for Prosperity is eager to recover them as soon as possible.

Thanks to a local contact, we were able to trace the outlaws back to {Address} where they're storing the confidential materials inside a secure automated vault. To access it, you’ll need to first find the relevant retrieval code and enter it at the vault’s package conveyor. Our best guess is that one of outlaw leaders will be carrying the code on their person so there is a very strong chance you’ll have to engage with them directly to get it.

Once you’ve gotten possession of the confidential material, we want you to deliver it to {Address}.

You’ll be making a big difference to a lot of people if you manage to pull this off.

Thanks in advance,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Convince Upstarts to Abandon Sector
missions.desc:
Everyone has been talking about a new player named {TargetName} who is operating out of {Address}. They've become a real concern for the Headhunters.

It's time to shut them down.

Head over, take out {Last} and then clear out any fuel stores they have there to convince anyone remaining to leave.

Figure after you pull this off, nobody will even remember their name.

-Stows

missions.title: Covalex Cargo Hauling Re-evaluation
missions.desc:
Hey,

Have a bit of good news for you. Covalex recently finished an evaluation of our contractor pool, and decided to reconsider your status as a cargo hauler. To requalify, all you need is to successfully complete the following delivery.

Pick up {Item} from a freight elevator at {Address} and deliver it to a freight elevator at {Address}. In order to complete this haul in a fast and efficient manner, you'll need a ship that can haul {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

Hopefully everything goes smoothly so we can welcome you back to the team.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.title: Crash some ships
missions.desc:
A lotta wannabe gangs have stepped to the Headhunters over the years thinking that they could force their way into the system. We're still here. They aren't. But it seems the survivors of these groups have decided to band together and try again. Guess some people never learn.

Latest group hit a couple of our convoys while on supply runs. Shouldn't be a surprise that the Judge wants to stomp them out quick. We've learned they're out near {Address} and likely rearming for another attack.

We want you to go there and make them wish they died with their old gang.

Stows out

missions.title: Danger: Contraband Weapons Inbound
missions.desc:
This is a general warning. We have learned that the Headhunters are transporting a large amount of weapons into the system with the intent of launching attacks against CFP-owned settlements.

While we believe that change can only come to this system through nonviolence. The presence of these weapons will undoubtedly cause considerably more bloodshed and devastation so we want to remove them from the equation.

Any of our supporters with appropriate combat training are asked to undertake this dangerous assignment out near {Address}. We will compensate you for the tremendous risk you are taking.

Thank you and be safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Death and cargo
missions.desc:
Local crew decided to hit one of our convoys and steal our shit. They got away, but we aren't gonna let them celebrate for long. I want you to head out to {Address} where they got a base, blast them into ash, and get our stuff back.

Once you got the cargo, take it over to {Address} and we can all forget these assholes ever existed.

Stows out.

missions.title: Destroy Headhunter Stolen Data
missions.desc:
The Headhunters recently attacked one of our transports and were sadly able to get their hands on some secure data. Although the encryption on it is strong, its only a matter of time before they'll be able to access it.

Before that happens, we need you to go to {Address} and destroy all traces of the information from their servers.

You'd really be helping Citizens for Prosperity out if you can pull this off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Eliminate Fuel Stores
missions.desc:
We've been having escalating issues with the outlaws at {Address} and can no longer stand by and watch as their aggressive actions hurt our community.

We are wary of launching a full scale assault, but believe that if their fuel stores are wiped out, it would deter them from further hostile actions.

If you're able, I'd appreciate you handling the destruction of the fuel personally. A ship capable of launching missiles would probably make the most sense, but I leave that up to you.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Elite Op
missions.desc:
Headhunters are looking for someone with the skills and crew to execute an elite op. A military frigate and escort ships are stalking one of our Clips around the system. Don’t know their intentions but it can’t be good. Figure while they’ve got their eyes focused on their prize, we get someone to gather a crew to hit ‘em.

Already got a spot picked out. If you get to {Address} there’s an emission cloud that’s exactly what we need. Head there with friends, power down your ships, and wait for the {AmbushTarget} and its escorts to pass by.

With a bonus of {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for the main contractor, payment alone should make this worth your while, but you can also keep anything you scrounge from the wreckage.

- Stows

missions.title: ENTRY LVL. COURIER NEEDED IN NYX
missions.desc:
AVAILABLE FTL CONTRACT
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**
FTL requires an entry-level courier to complete deliveries in Nyx.
Courier must provide own transportation.
Prior training in manual lifting is preferred, with the ability to move boxes of up to .25 SCU in weight.
By accepting this contract you agree to take full responsibility for the safety of the assigned packages.

{SignOff}

missions.title: Expel Claimjumpers
missions.desc:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary
LOCATION: {LagrangeLocation}
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*:
A recently acquired Shubin Interstellar mining claim awaiting processing was discovered to have been jumped by a rogue mining outfit who are actively stealing ore from the site. While local authorities have been notified, there is concern that valuable assets may be harvested before an official investigation can be launched.

Therefore, as is our right as claim holders, we wish to secure a mercenary force to go to {Location} and destroy the several orbital sentries that are protecting this illegal operation. Caution is advised as there may still be a few illegal miners at the location along with any reinforcements they muster.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Expel Outlaws
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Clear Location
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client is sending frantic comms that one of their locations is under attack. We need a contractor who can hustle to {Address} and clear the location of hostile actors.

According to onsite personnel, the outlaws are currently holed up near the {Location}. Approach with caution and be prepared to use lethal force if the outlaws resist being removed.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Finishing The Job
missions.desc:
One of my haulers has run into some trouble over at {Address} and was forced to ditch their ship. I need someone to go there with a heavy-duty tractor beam to grab the cargo and finish the job.

They were carrying a decent supply of gear for me, and the last thing I need is for some do-gooder to come across it and trace it back to us.

If you do run into anybody, no need to be friendly. Just shoot the asshole and get my gear. Understood?

Take it to the freight elevator over at {Address} and I’ll make sure you get a cut of the sale.

-Twitch

missions.title: Ghost some XenoTrash
missions.desc:
Need you to move quick on this one. There's a XenoThreat lieutenant named {TargetName} who's popped up for air. Judge thinks this is a big chance to mess with XenoThreat's command by taking them out. I heard {Last} was spotted flying around {Address}, so get there quick before they disappear again.

I'd bring some support, I doubt they'll go down without a fight.

Stows out.

missions.title: good help’s hard to find
missions.desc:
I know someone who’s looking to start up a new business, but they’re having a hard time hiring the skilled workers they need.

Now the thing is, they found the perfect crew over at {Address}, but the people they work for won’t let them go. Even hired extra armed guards to make sure of it.

What I want you to do, is go there and kill all the guards while making sure all the workers remain unharmed.

missions.title: grab and go
missions.desc:
This one should be a ringer for somebody like you. There’s a package being held at {Address} and I need you to bring it to {Address}.

There's one super tiny issue that you should know about. There’s gonna be a crap ton of security down there. But I'm sure it should be fine.

:)

missions.title: Headhunter Pilot Needs a Hand
missions.desc:
Seems we got some upstarts trying to muscle in our operations by hitting a Headhunter ship near {Address}. Not sure how they expected to get away with it.

They need to learn the hard way that's not how things work in Pyro. You up for heading over there and teaching these bastards a lesson?

- Stows out

missions.title: Headhunter Ship Needs Backup
missions.desc:
One of my pilots wasn't thinking straight and got themselves mixed up in a heap of trouble over at {Address}.

The real kicker is the fool has a full hold. Can't really afford to lose the stuff they're carrying, so I'd appreciate it if you could go bail them out for me.

- Stows out

missions.title: Hit a CFP Ship
missions.desc:
CFP Security forces have been attacking locals and we're looking to balance the scales. Caught wind of one in particular named {Last} who's been causing some damage and we need them taken out.

You can find them flying around {Address}. Go introduce yourself.

Stows out.

missions.title: Hit on XenoThreat command
missions.desc:
These XenoThreat assholes are like aloprats. Every time you thing you wipe them out, they just pop back up again. They seem to be back to their usual shit and trying to put together something big. No idea what, but we've been cleared to stop it before it starts.

A group of XenoThreat biggies are supposedly meeting at {Address} to plan or just rage or whatever it is they do, but we're gonna bust it up. Or you are.

Head over there and wipe out everyone you find. Sure enough I'm sure the biggies will jump into the fight. That's what they always do.

This'll be a tough one. As much as I hate XenoThreat, they're damn good in a fight, so watch yourself and bring help if you can.

Stows out.

missions.title: Hunt Some Heads
missions.desc:
Got some asshole’s trying to push us out of the system. You up for pushing back?

See, there are some folks who really don’t want us here, and have started sending out hunting parties of five to seven ships, often with a bigger gun ship, to places where we’re building up our presence. Time for us to show that we’re here to stay.

I’ve strung together a few spots starting at the location marker on your HUD where we’re seeing the most hostile encounters. Need you to visit each one and scan to see if we can bait them into a fight.

Know this is going to be a hard one, so don't be cocky and try to go it alone. If I were you, I'd bring at least three friends onboard for support. To make it worth your while, I'm promising a bonus of {ScripAmount} Council Scrip to the main contractor that pulls it off.

- Stows

missions.title: inventory clear out
missions.desc:
A client of mine‘s trying to negotiate a deal, but isn’t having much luck. The other party feels like they got all the leverage because they’re sitting comfortably on a pile of inventory. To help move the negotiations along, I’m gonna need you to head down to {Address} and destroy all the drugs on site.

Now, I should probably tell you that the site’s being protected by some very serious people, so getting to the stash is going to be a bit tricky, but I trust you’ll find a way.

missions.title: Kill Order
missions.desc:
Need another CFP ship taken out. It belongs to {TargetName}, who's been driving locals out of their homes if they don't accept Citizens for Prosperity help. They're a real piece of work and we've been given the go-ahead to take them down.

Their ship was spotted around {Address}, so head out there and do the deed.

Stows out.

missions.title: Knock Power Out
missions.desc:
Got a few scavs that have rooted themselves into {Address}. We have our own plans there and need the place cleared out.

That's why I want you to ho and turn off their power. Let's see if that doesn't cause these rats to abandon the place for good.

-Stows

missions.title: limited supply
missions.desc:
Seems there’s a new upstart in the sector who hasn’t been paying the right dues to the right people. To teach them a little lesson, my client wants you to go down to {Address} and destroy all the drugs on site.

The low-level lugs they got on site will probably make a stink about it and try to stop you. Handle them however you want but getting rid of the product is the most important thing.

missions.title: live and let an independent contractor deal out revenge
missions.desc: Everybody holds grudges, right? I mean, when you get popped pulling a crime, I get that you’re a little sour, but that’s pretty much the game, right?

live and let an independent contractor deal out revenge

missions.title: Looking For Trouble
missions.desc:
I’ve noticed an uptick in attacks on Headhunter ships and it's got me feelin' jumpy. Got an important resupply shipment that we can’t afford to lose, and need help determining what route to send it. I’ve strung together a few potential spots that I’d set up in if I was gonna hit ‘em. Any chance you could visit and clear out any lowlifes that may be hiding there?

The route starts at the location marker on your HUD. After you scan it and clear whatever’s there, I’ll send you to a few other areas that could work. I’ve been hearing people have been rolling through these spots, so would be smart to bring a friend to watch your back.

You make it to the end and I'll give the main contractor a bonus {ScripAmount} Council Scrip as thanks.

- Stows

Once you’re ready to sell us the required materials, deposit them in the freight elevator located at {Address}.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: makin’ a mess
missions.desc:
This is a bit aggressive for my taste, but credits are credits, right?

Got a client who's looking for a highly motivated individual to head over to {Address} and kill everyone who’s there.

Basically, start shooting and don’t stop. You'll get paid once the site's clear.

missions.title: Multiple Deliveries Ready
missions.desc:
Hey,

Guess there was a technical glitch with our system that marked certain packages as delivered when they never were. Still untangling the mess, but have a few sorted out and good to go.

- Package #{serialnumber} goes from {Address} to {Address}.
- Package #{serialnumber} goes from {Address} to {Address}.
- Package #{serialnumber} goes from {Address} to {Address}.
- Package #{serialnumber} goes from {Address} to {Address}.
- Package #{serialnumber} goes from {Address} to {Address}.

Would be good to get these rectified immediately if you’re available.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.

Best,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Need a CFP taken down
missions.desc:
Need an available trigger to take down a target in a CFP outpost. They're a real piece of work named {TargetName}. Old school merc filled with lead-pipe cruelty.

Heard they're posted over at {Address}. Swing by and take them out. Try not to cause too much damage. They're the target, not anyone else.

Stows out.

missions.title: Need a death at {Location}
missions.desc:
Need someone taken care of. They're holed up near {Address}. Not sure if you care who they are, but their name's {TargetName}. Not much to tell, local thug who killed someone who was connected.

They've been on the run, so they're gonna be skittish. I'd approach with caution.

Stows out.

missions.title: Need a hitter
missions.desc:
So here's the deal, we got some small time dirtbags who think they're hotshots running out of a base near {Address}. I don't know what toxic shit they're drinking but they thought it'd be a good idea to step to some Headhunter Clips. Killed one, injured three more. So I'm looking to send someone there to blast their ambition right out of their skulls.

Head over and get it done. You'll get a nice bump of creds for it.

- Stows

missions.title: Opportunity for Independent Cargo Hauler
missions.desc:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you.

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of {Item} from a freight elevator at {Address} and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at {Address}.

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.title: Oust Claimjumpers
missions.desc:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary
LOCATION: {LagrangeLocation}
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*:
A local Stanton independent mining team was working {Location} as Shubin Interstellar contractors when a hostile force attacked and took over the site. We believe that the perpetrators are still at the claim using the equipment left behind to harvest the valuable ore there for themselves.

Among the equipment lost were a handful of orbital sentries that had unfortunately not yet been fully deployed at the time of the attack. Long range scans of the claim have led us to conclude that the outlaws have activated the orbital sentries and are using them to protect their illegal operations.

To reclaim the site, we are seeking contractors to go to {Location}, destroy the orbital sentries, and clear the site of hostile miners. Efficiency is strongly recommended as there is a high risk they will call for reinforcements once they discover they’re being evicted.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Price of Business
missions.desc:
Not sure if you’d had the pleasure of dealing with the Rough & Ready, but the gang is laser focused on cornering the fuel market in Pyro. Smart play, but one we can’t let happen without them providing us some concessions. Since they’re currently not interested in negotiating, we’re forced to show them what happens to those who oppose us.

We’ve identified {Address} as a prime target for such an attack. We also know they recently received some supplies that should be a fitting price for their obstinance. Once inside the station, do whatever you need to do to confiscate the {item}. We’ll send payment once you’ve delivered them to {Address}.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Primo Target
missions.desc:
Got a platinum target that needs to get taken down. {TargetName} is a heavy hitter who's one of the people running security for Citizens for Prosperity. Although {Last} might have forgotten, the Headhunters remember their work with a merc company a few years ago that lead to the deaths of five brothers and sisters. We want blood for blood.

They've been spotted poking around {Address}, so you should still be able to find them there.

They're a mean bastard, so bring some friends but make sure they end up dead.

Stows out.

missions.title: Reduce Outlaw's Operational Readiness
missions.desc:
There is a group of outlaws at {Address} that have become increasingly brazen in their attacks on Citizens for Prosperity assets in the system.

To minimize loss of life, we want to first try convincing them to move on to somewhere else by disabling their generators and destroying their fuel reserves.

Hopefully, that should be enough to convince them to move on to greener pastures.

Thanks,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Remove Claimjumpers
missions.desc:
POSTING: Security / Mercenary
LOCATION: {LagrangeLocation}
WORK EXPERIENCE: Combat Pilot (Military Experience a Plus)
TERMS*:
We just received word that a Shubin contractor was chased off one of our claims by outlaws who are operating there illegally. Further complicating matters, they have set up a few orbital sentries to protect themselves while they mine.

Our hope is to contract with a mercenary who can search for and destroy the sentries at {location}. If you do encounter an illegal miner at the site, be mindful that it is common practice for these types to contact reinforcements for assistance. It might be better to neutralize them as quickly as possible before they can do so.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Remove Illegal Occupants
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented security professional who can quickly and safely assist us in the complete removal of illegal occupants who have temporarily gained control of {Address}.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Remove all illegal occupants found within the site; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

missions.title: Repossess Supplies
missions.desc:
As much as XenoThreat has strived to make Pyro a pure haven for Humans, not everyone is aligned with our goals. Chief among them is the Headhunters, who have debased themselves by hiring an alien hauler to deliver supplies to them. We missed the chance to hit that shipment, but still want to send the message that working with aliens in any capacity will not be tolerated in this system.

That shipment was delivered to {Address}. We want someone to hit the outpost, claim the {item}, and take it to {Address} so we can properly dispose of it.

You up for keeping Pyro free from alien influence?

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Reprisal Attack
missions.desc:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.

We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a {AmbushTarget} and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by {Address}, which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.

Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.

And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus {ScripAmount} Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.

Stows out.

missions.title: Scout and Scan
missions.desc:
Headhunters have been expanding, but still need help getting a lay of our new territory. I’ve got a run to check spots we want scanned ready to go.

This one kicks off at the location marker on your HUD and will look at a few more locations after that, but I’ll update you as we clear them out. Not expecting you to run into any trouble but no guarantees. Trouble seems to follow us.

Get this done and I'll toss the main contractor {ScripAmount} Council Scrip as a thanks.

Stows out.

missions.title: See What’s Out There
missions.desc:
Headhunters want some intel on what’s happening around territory. We’ve already set up some monitoring satellites, but nothing beats a good ol’ patrol. You up for it?

If so, get on over to the location marker on your HUD. Start by scanning that region and then we’ll guide you to a few more spots that we want info on.

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

- Stows

missions.title: Silent Strike
missions.desc:
Any interest in taking out a {AmbushTarget} for us?

Shouldn’t be too much trouble. We’ve already done the legwork and figured out that they're scheduled to pass by {Address} soon. Just go dark in the nearby emission cloud and you’ll get a good jump on ‘em.

They might roll through solo or with some friends. All would be single-seaters but they can hold their own in a dogfight. We’ll drop some forces in the region who can provide support once the fun starts.

You pull this off and I'll toss {ScripAmount} Council Scrip to the main contractor for a job well done.

- Stows

missions.title: Simple Hit
missions.desc:
Got another scumbag who needs their ticket punched. {TargetName} is just a low level thug who doesn't seem to learn. We've warned them to either throw in with us or move system, but they don't seem to be listening so we're out of patience.

Head to {Address} and you should find {Last} flying around.

Stows out.

missions.title: Space Patrol
missions.desc:
The local Clip wants current intel on several of our sectors. Not sure what they’re looking for but I’m not about to ask. My job is to find someone willing to swing through and scan these locations. You available?

All you need to do is head to the location marker on your HUD, run a scan, and if it’s clear, move to the next spot. If you run into any issues, take care of it.

Ain’t sound too tough now does it? Plus, I'll give the main contractor a bonus {ScripAmount} Council Scrip as thanks.

Stows out.

missions.title: Stand Our Ground
missions.desc:
We’re getting pushback from folks who don’t seem happy that we’re here. Folks have gotten keen to our haunts and started sending out squads to hit our ships. You down to visit a few of those spots to show that we won’t be scared off?

If so, start by seeing what’s around the location marker on your HUD. From there I’ll guide you to a few other hotspots that we need checked. Better get your shit in order before heading out. I'd recommend loading up on ammo and convincing two friends to join the patrol.

You do this for the Headhunters and I'll see to it that the main contractor gets a bonus of {ScripAmount} Council Scrip.

Stows out.

missions.title: Steal Subsidies
missions.desc:
Leave it to the lying UEE to say they’re not involved with the operations of Citizens for Prosperity simply because they “donate” supplies to a tertiary aid organization who then immediately delivers it right to them.

We just got word that one of these government aid shipments was dropped off at a Citizens for Prosperity aligned outpost. That’s why we’ll pay you to raid {Address} and claim the {item} for the cause. Once you deliver everything to {Address} we can redistribute the shipment to help in our fight. Nothing better than using the enemies resources against them.

But don’t think they’ll just hand the stuff over to you. Even though Citizens for Prosperity are supposedly here to bring peace, you best be prepared to go toe to toe with ‘em.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Stolen Supplies
missions.desc:
Hey,

We could use your help.

A local we work with was completing a delivery for us, but unfortunately, she ran into some outlaws and had to surrender her {Item}. Silver lining is the outlaws didn’t notice the trackers we placed in the cargo and now we know they’ve taken their haul to {Address}.

We’d like you to recover the packages for us and finish delivering them to {Address}. I don’t imagine the outlaws will give them up willingly, but I wouldn’t ask you to put yourself in harm’s way if these supplies weren’t of critical importance.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd suggest you have a handheld tractor beam with you.

So, what do you say?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Surprise Party
missions.desc:
Some numskull flying a {AmbushTarget} was caught spying on our ops. We ran ‘em off with a warning only to spot ‘em doing the same shit someplace else. Since they didn’t get the message, seems we gotta send a stronger one.

There’s an emission cloud near {Address} that they fly by frequently. Primo place to power down, hide, and launch a surprise attack. Sometimes they fly solo, sometimes there’s other single-seaters with them. It’ll be all you for that first hit, but we’ll put some support ships nearby to help finish the job.

And if you needed some extra motivation, there's a bonus of {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for the main contractor at the end of the job.

Stows out.

missions.title: Tactical Strike
missions.desc:
Some folks don’t seem happy with us. Got word that several sub-capital ships and a number of escorts are targeting our ops. Figured the best way to keep ‘em from causing us trouble is to hit them before they hit us.

We got eyes on a {AmbushTarget} that’s part of this squad, and it looks like they regularly pass by {Address}, a spot tailor made for a surprise attack. A nearby emission cloud can hide you and anyone you bring along for muscle.

No sugarcoating it. This ain’t gonna be easy. But the payoff should make it worth your while. Finish the job and the main contractor gets a bonus {ScripAmount} Council Scrip.

Plus, who knows what kinda good stuff you’ll find floating in all that wreckage.

Stows out.

missions.title: Target at {Location}
missions.desc:
There's a nest that needs to be taken out around {Address} that has been taken over by some squatters. We don't care about most of them, but word's gotten back to us that they're sheltering {TargetName} who has a long history of stealing Headhunter loot. Time's come to take them out.

Word is that {Last} is in a ship, but may rely on the base's defenses to protect them, so be careful. You kill 'em, you get paid.

You know, the usual.

Stows out.

missions.title: Target takedown for a fast track in
missions.desc:
So here's the deal, Headhunters are looking to expand their talent pool and have a few openings for anyone who's got the stones.

There's a real piece of work named {TargetName} who thinks they've been really clever pinching cargo off of haulers moving through the system. We asked for a cut of their profits as a licensing tax to continue operating. When {Last} responded, they were very disrespectful.

We've tracked their ship to {Address} and need them taken out. You should know, they're being smart and sticking close to some allies so they won't be alone.

Do this and we'll consider you for future Headhunter work.

Stows out.

missions.title: too many cooks
missions.desc:
A client is getting out produced by a new competitor and is looking to throw a wrench into the works.

You’re going to head to {Address} and kill all the civies who work there.

Do what you want with the gun-toting goons guarding the workers, but remember that they aren’t the priority.

missions.title: Treat yourself to a fight
missions.desc:
Another gang tried to make a move and carve out some territory for themselves. They failed but Headhunters don't forget. We've taken out most of them but one of the last members named {TargetName} has been spotted flying around {Address}.

Odds are they're getting desperate, so don't underestimate them in the fight.

You'll get paid when it's done.

Stows out.

missions.title: Tutorial - Your First Flight
missions.desc:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in {Name} finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the {TransitNameShort} transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around {Name} – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

missions.title: Tutorial - Your First Outing
missions.desc:
Well done!

With the first part behind you, you should now have some basic familiarity with the movement controls, managing your hunger and thirst, and some of the core functionality of your mobiGlas – namely the Contract Manager and your Journal.

This next section will help you familiarize yourself with {Name} and take you to visit {StoreName}, a weapons store here in {Name}.

You can shop there, and at other stores like it, using United Earth Credits (UEC). During the Alpha phase of Star Citizen’s development, we will be using a currency called aUEC (Alpha United Earth Credits). This is a temporary currency specifically designed for testing the in-game economy and balance.

missions.title: Tutorial - Your First Steps
missions.desc:
Congratulations on taking your first steps into the universe!

Over the course of this tutorial, you’ll learn how to get around both on foot and in space.

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.

First up is helping you familiarize yourself with some basic movement controls and the use of your mobiGlas while still inside your “Hab” (or habitation). Follow the objectives and hints on your HUD (heads-up display) to proceed through this mission.

missions.title: Wanna be a Headhunter?
missions.desc:
You know us. You know what we do. System’s getting a little crowded, so we’re looking for some good soldiers to help keep our place here.

If you’re up for it and don’t mind getting your hands dirty, we’ve got something to prove you’ve got the stuff we’re looking for.

{TargetName} was a former member who sold us out to XenoThreat and got some of their brothers and sisters killed. Now they think they can just live their life without consequence.

You take them out. You get boosted in. Sounds like a fair trade.

They’ve been spotted around {Address}, so get there and take care of it.

Stows out.

missions.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: {TargetName} (?RT)
missions.desc:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Got a bounty that needs to be collected on {TargetName}. The bastard is hiding over at {Address} with a bunch of other scum, so be careful going in.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Wanted: {TargetName}
missions.desc:
We got a greenlight to finally take out {TargetName}. They've been a pain in our ass ever since they came to the system a few years ago and it's finally time to take them out once and for all.

We've gotten word that {Last} was spotted flying near {Address} and the Judge wants this handled now.

Take 'em out.

- Stows out.

missions.title: Wipe Citizens for Prosperity Data Farm
missions.desc:
Turns out those Citizens for Prosperity bastards have been gathering intel on us. They're going to try to cut us off from several revenue streams and bleed us dry. Can't let that happen.

Head to {Address} and destroy their data storage.

That should teach them not to stick their noses where they don't belong.

-Stows out

Got a box sitting at {Address} that needs to make its way over to {Address}. Any chance you can knock this out real quick?

Might be the easiest gig I’ve ever assigned out. Only real threat would be tripping over your own feet. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at {Address} to {Address}. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to {MissionMaxSCUSize} in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

Need a pilot for a straightforward haul going from the freight elevator at {Address} to {Address}. Should be easy enough as long as you got a ship that can handle containers up to {MissionMaxSCUSize} in size.

Credits don't come much easier than this. Just be careful as the route's not exactly in the safest of sectors. And don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam to bring along.

missions.title: {ship} clean up
missions.desc:
Got a particular salvage job that we could use some extra hands on.

We need you to find a {ship} that got punched out around {location}. Security’s already searching for it and if they find it, they’ll ID it for sure and we’ll be in loads of trouble.

So, we want you to make sure that can’t happen. Either tow the ship out of the search area or rip the entire hull off so nobody can tell who it belonged to. Whatever you decide, keep your mouth shut about this.

We’ll cred you up and anything you scrap is yours to keep. But if security finds the ship before you’re done, we’ll all be screwed and you won’t get paid so don’t disappoint.

missions.title: {TargetName} Vanished
missions.desc:
I’ve got people left and right askin’ me if I know what happened to {TargetName}. Now personally, I’d be more than happy to see ‘em gone for good, but for whatever reason they got friends in high places demanding answers.

I can’t spare any of my people to go on a wild goose chase, so I'm looking for the perfect candidate to go over to {Address} and find out what happened to {Last}. You’ll get paid if you find where they are.

10 credits says they got way too high and passed out in a dark corner somewhere.

-Smokey

missions.title: A Swift Reprisal
missions.desc:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in {Address}. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us.

Stows out.

missions.title: A Well Deserved Break
missions.desc:
A request has made its way to my desk regarding the untimely end of one {TargetName}, a member of the Claw Salamander who is currently scuttling around an old QV Breaker Station.

It is highly likely that you will find them at {Address}. Be mindful though that with a station this large it may take a bit of searching to track them down.

Hope you enjoy your time in Nyx,
Vaughn

missions.title: Aid The Blockade
missions.desc:
Now that Crusader’s found their fleet, it seems the Nine Tails finally realized just how useful a bit of extra help can be.

Long story short, they’re looking for some hired muscle to keep Crusader at bay. You’ll and everyone else who volunteers get a payout for every security ship you take down.

And on top of that, if all of you keep Crusader occupied long enough for the Nine Tails to finish up whatever the hell it is that they’re up to with this quantum blockade, you’ll get a big fat bonus.

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Large Supply of Research Resource
missions.desc:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are working around-the-clock to assist with the treatment for the current fungal outbreak in Levski. Due to logistic issues, our team at {Address} is running low on a key resource in their research. Losing production at that location would hamper the Alliance Aid’s effort to cure people suffering from this terrible affliction in a timely manner.

That’s why we're eager for the help of anyone who can find and deliver this vital supply to {Destination}.

Please remember that contracted goods are tracked by their legal owners and can't be accepted.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

To help us expand our access to it, we will be offering an excellent rate for those who help find and deliver it to our scientists at {Address}.

Obtaining it from our regular distributors could take weeks. Considering how many people desperately need help, stopping research for that long would seriously impact our effort. missions.title: Annihilate Sentries
missions.desc:
Recent scans discovered several orbital sentries and ships at {address}. We believe they’re part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, in response to our recent actions in the Stanton system. Seems XenoThreat must be doing something right, if they’re out here spying like this.

We’re looking for an experienced and highly-skilled merc willing to eliminate this operation. If you don’t want Pyro to become a surveillance system, then this is your chance to stop it. The sentries probably won’t be too big of an issue, but pay mind to the patrol ships. If they manage to break away, you’ll have a whole lot more trouble breathing down your neck.

You’ll have our gratitude and a sizable payment once the job is done.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Away From Prying Eyes
missions.desc:
I told the Nine Tails that blocking quantum travel to hold a whole area hostage was gonna attract the wrong kind of attention, but do they listen to me? No. Now Crusader’s got dozens of scanning ships out there poking their noses into things I’d rather stay hidden.

That’s why I'm trying to hire as many people as I can to help me out. I wanna pay you for each Crusader scanning ship you take out.

In fact, I’ll even up your rate per-ship if all of you hit a certain number of kills. Call it a performance incentive.

And if you're really feeling like an overachiever, take out any fools brave enough to try running cargo to the blockaded station. I've got some suppliers who'll be appreciative of the extra demand.

missions.title: Bulk Covalex Shipment Needs Recovering
missions.desc:
Hi,

Here's the situation. After spending an hour on comms talking to the hauler, trying to help them diagnose what's wrong with their ship, it's been decided that we now need to get someone to head over to {Address} and complete the delivery.

This is a pretty big one. You'll need a ship that can store {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers and unless you're super strong a heavy-duty tractor beam to shift it all.

I would really appreciate if we could just get this one done. Take the cargo to the freight elevator at {Address} and we can put this all behind us.

{SignOff}

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

missions.title: Clear Criminal Nest
missions.desc:
Crusader Security has learned that {Address} is currently being used as a base of operations for numerous illegal activities.

In order to put a stop to this "nest of criminals," we are seeking a contractor to go to the site and clear all the occupants. By force if necessary.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.desc:
{TargetName} borrowed a bunch of creds from the Headhunters and thought the smart move was to try and hide instead of paying us back, so I need someone to make an example of {Last}.

They were just spotted at {Address}, so I’d recommend heading there now before the trail goes cold. {Last} is a paranoid sort, so don’t be surprised if they’re not alone. Handle it however you want as long as {Last} is dust when you’re done.

Stows out.
