missions.title: Complete Stranded Ling Shipment
missions.desc:
Hello,

Some sad news. Unfortunately our hauler ran into some trouble and had to abandoned the cargo they were due to deliver. We haven't heard anything back from them so we're assuming the worse.

We're in the process of contacting their family and are conscious this is a very sensitive time, but also can't afford to leave a job incomplete. Our trackers show the cargo is still intact over at {Address}.

If you could finish the delivery we would be really grateful. We're not picking up on any nearby ships so it should be safe for you to collect. Bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

Deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at {Address} and we'll take care of the rest.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Calling for a skilled contractor to recover a displaced shipment located at {Address}. Client's hauler was transporting some high value cargo when they decided to respond to a distress beacon and got ambushed by a group of outlaws. The client believes their pilot is gone but their cargo could still be recovered.

The information we have so far is that you'll need a ship that can carry {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers, a heavy-duty tractor beam for shifting the goods, as well as your support ships to help deal with the outlaws at the location.

Client will be expecting the completed delivery to be made to the freight elevator at {Address}.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: CRITICAL REFUEL REQUEST: {Ship}
missions.desc:
Hi,

Another day another beacon. There's a {Ship} looking to be topped up with {FuelType} at {Address}. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of {RefuelRequest}, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

I can't lie: it's a nasty place to get stuck and a worse place to get caught by surprise. We've lost good people out there - even the ones who got lucky made it home with pieces missing.

If you decide to take the job, do me a favor and keep everything peeled. If you've got a buddy with time to spare, maybe reach out for a little back-up.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.

Actually she never said that - but I'm pretty sure she would if she did this for a living.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

missions.title: Deadbeat
missions.desc:
The Headhunters recently loaned credits to {TargetName} under some clear conditions. Specifically, pay us back or we’ll kill you. Wild to think that wasn’t enough of an incentive, but here we are past the payment deadline. Now as much as we like {First}, I need you to make good on our promise.

{Last} was last seen at {Address}. Track ‘em down, ghost ‘em, and get paid. It’s as simple as that.

Stows out.

missions.title: Defend {Location} From Mercs
missions.desc:
So, I thought we had done a good job of keeping things on the quiet side, but looks like the fact {Address} has Headhunters ties has gotten out. Now there are some heavy operators causing major problems there, targeting the {Objects} and generally causing me a massive headache.

With the amount of firepower these interlopers are packing, you're gonna need to bring along a crew of your own to pull this off. Especially since I need you to be protecting any friendly ships that need help.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.

missions.title: Defend {Objects} From Mercs
missions.desc:
A band of hired guns has been sent to mess with our interests over at {Address}. Seems someone has been tipped off that if the {Objects} there are destroyed that it will severely interrupt Headhunter operations in the area. That's a problem I want you to fix.

Not gonna lie, theses mercs are no joke. It'd be foolish to go it alone. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.

missions.title: Delivery of Abandoned Ling Cargo
missions.desc:
Hey,

Need a reliable contractor to help us out with a bit of a situation.

Our of our haulers has dropped out mid-contract and now our client's cargo is stuck in transit. Think they were trying to negotiate a better rate with us, but that's not how Ling does business. Anyway, they're done and we desperately need the shipment finished.

Petra and I have been working with this client for years now and have built up a good rapport. Be a shame to throw that all a way because of an unreliable hauler. Can you head to {Address} and collect the shipment? You'll need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship that can carry {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

Take the shipment to the freight elevator over at {Address} and we'll get you paid as soon as. We'd really appreciate your help with this and I'm sure our client would too.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.title: Double Dealing
missions.desc:
Rough & Ready recently provided fueling services for a hauler named {TargetName}, who agreed to deliver their next load of supplies to us as compensation. Well, we just found out that the lying skag sold their latest shipment to a rival gang instead.

We’re looking for someone to track down and eliminate {Last} for the double cross.

An old friend of mine just spotted the skag at {Address}. Looks like they're loaded with more cargo that’s not coming our way, and traveling with an escort. We’re only paying you to take out the ship, so anything you find aboard is yours to keep.

- Smokey

variants.title: Eliminate All Stations Pyro6 L1 No Non Hostiles

missions.title: Eliminate Annoyance
missions.desc:
Headhunters flying in and out of {Address} are being harassed by some aggressive upstarts. Need them dealt with before they become a real pain in the ass.

Get there and I’ll update you on what these pests are doing so you can hunt ‘em down.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw {ScripAmount} Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig as a bonus.

- Stows

missions.title: Eliminate Eavesdroppers
missions.desc:
Some numbskull is trying to dig up dirt on the Headhunters. Some orbital sentries were dropped at {address} to spy on us. We’ve also spotted a ship checking on them. Simple proposition for you. Go wipe out the sentries there and we’ll pay you for it. That sound like something you’d be into?

As for the ship, you can do whatever you want with it, but if it spots you, don’t be surprised if it tries to go get some back up. That’s just how these things go.

Stows out.

missions.title: Eradicate Eavesdroppers
missions.desc:
Headhunters are looking for a merc to do a little clean up for us. Found out that someone’s trying to spy on us over at {address}. Can’t let that stand. We need a skilled operator to take care of the orbital sentries they dropped there, and if needed, deal with any of their ships that get in your way. Seems like a decently run op, so hitting it might not be easy but it sure should be fun.

Let us know if you’re the right one for the gig. Creds will be transferred once our scans show it’s gone.

Stows out.

missions.title: Eradicate Sentries
missions.desc:
Do you value Humanity’s freedom? If so, I’m offering you a chance to prove it. Recent scans discovered orbital sentries and patrolling ships at {address}. We believe they’re part of a UEE espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat. It’s important that we stop their intelligence gathering before we launch our next mission.

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to eliminate these forces immediately. The sentries are the priority, but the ships might prove a bigger issue if they’re allowed to escape. You’ll have to evaluate the situation more closely once you’re on site.

We could take care of it ourselves, but want to send in a contractor so the scum behind it don’t know who hit them. Payment will be sent promptly upon completion. Plus, the satisfaction of knowing you’re helping a good cause.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Exact Justice
missions.desc:
{TargetName} was recently revealed to be a mole for XenoThreat. It all makes sense now because the skav was a major asshole. Unfortunately, they split before we could handle it ourselves.

Based on all they learned about our ops, we need ‘em taken out pronto. They see one of us coming and they’ll just run again, but I figured someone like you has a better chance of getting close enough for a killshot.

We just got word {Last} was hanging around {Address}. Looks like there’s other ships around protecting ‘em too. Think you got the skill to rid the ‘verse of a traitorous bastard and their bastard friends?

Stows out.

missions.title: Exterminate Eavesdroppers
missions.desc:
Some idiots think they can blatantly spy on the Headhunters and get away with it. They’ve set up several orbital sentries at {address} and have a few ships patrolling the area. We don’t know who’s behind it but we honestly don’t care. We just need it gone.

Let us know if you feel like putting some real brash bastards in their place. We’ll pay you well and deliver the creds the second the job is done.

Keep in mind that it’s really only the sentries we care about. The ships they got patrolling are only a concern if they get in your way or if they try to call in some friends to stop you.

Stows out.

missions.title: Extra Small Covalex Shipment Needs Recovering
missions.desc:
Hi,

So I had a contractor who was supposed to deliver some stuff for us but has completely gone off the radar. I've pinged their ship and I've got no idea what's happened but they're floating around somewhere over at {Address}. If you could head over there recover the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at {Address} you'd be doing me a huge favor.

Don't forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam to move all the cargo. Oh and a ship that can transport {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

{SignOff}

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

missions.title: Failed Delivery
missions.desc:
My associates and I brokered a deal with a hauler named {TargetName} to deliver supplies to us. Funny thing is the shipment never showed up. They claimed pirates raided their ship and took our supplies, but it turns out that story’s 100% ranta dung.

Lying to back out of our deal can’t go unanswered and you’re going to make that message abundantly clear. {Last} was recently seen with an escort at {Address}. As long as you kill {Last}, we don’t care what happens to the cargo they’re hauling.

- Smokey

missions.title: Finish Interrupted Ling Delivery
missions.desc:
Hey,

Here's the thing: one of our haulers has run into some trouble over at {Address} and had to ditch their ship. Could you head over there and help us finish the delivery?

Not a huge job by any means, but you'll still need a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship with enough space to store {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

Drop the cargo off at the freight elevator at {Address} and we'll send you the creds.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling

missions.title: Finish the job
missions.desc:
One of our pilots was supposed to bring a shipment back to us, but seems like he got into some trouble over at {Address}. Either he got his brains blasted all over the cockpit, or freaked out and ditched his ship. For his sake, I hope it’s the first one so I don’t have the hunt this asshole down. What’s important right now is that our cargo’s just sitting out there.

If you’ve got a heavy-duty tractor beam and a decent ship, can you head over there and get our stuff? Chances are the assholes who attacked my pilot are still there, and I’m betting they’re pretty tough.

If you get out alive, take the cargo to the freight elevator at {Address} and I’ll get you paid.

Stows out.

missions.title: Fuel to the Fire
missions.desc:
If you’re in the market for some easy credits, I’ve got an offer for you.

See, word on the vine is that {address} is operating as a fuel depot. They must not have gotten the memo that the fuel trade in Pyro belongs to Rough & Ready.

That’s why you’re going to make your way there and destroy their fuel reserves. They should be easy for you to spot. They’re the large yellow storage tanks dotted around the outpost. Watch out though, there are turret emplacements defending the area, so make sure you’re ready to dodge their shots or blow the guns sky high.

I’ll leave it up to you how you handle the demo. Bombs would be my first choice, but I don’t care much as long as the gig gets done.

- Smokey

missions.title: Getting what we deserve
missions.desc:
Here’s the thing, I got a situation over at {Address} and need someone with a brain between their ears to sort it out for me. Former pilot of mine thought he could cut a deal with another gang and unsurprisingly it didn’t work out for him. Now my cargo is sitting idle and being guarded by a whole bunch of nullbrains waiting for their hauler to come pick it up.

Need you to head there with a heavy-duty tractor beam and a strong crew to get my shit back before its gone for good.

Take it all to the freight elevator at {Address} and I’ll give you a generous cut of the takings.

Stows out.

missions.title: Grab ‘n’ go
missions.desc:
Just got word of an abandoned ship with a fat stack of cargo ripe for the pluckin’. If you’re interested, you’ll need to head to {Address}. Word might have gotten around, so there’s probably some skags hanging around, but just ghost them and get the stash.

Bring the cargo to the freight elevator at {Address} and I’ll get you your creds.

Make sure you got a heavy-duty tractor beam on you too, no idea how big or small that cargo is.

Stows out.

missions.title: Guard {Location} From Rivals
missions.desc:
The maintenance and reliable function of {Address} is pretty darn important to the Headhunters, but this rival crew seems determined knock it out of contention. They're on site now, targeting {Objects} there.

Protecting the site, and any friendly ships, in the area is important enough that I want you to bring some reliable backup along when you go and terminate these nullbrains.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

missions.title: Guard {Objects} At All Costs
missions.desc:
Our partners at {Address} need help. A rival outlaw crew are swarming the area and attacking the {Objects} there. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site is absolutely critical to our future plans in the area and its damn important that it remains in working order.

With the scale of this attack and the skill of these pilots, there's no doubt that some reliable backup would serve you well. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and stop these bootlicks before they can do any lasting damage.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

missions.title: Help Headhunters at {DefendLocationWrapperLocation}
missions.desc:
Got word that Headhunters ships heading to {Address} are coming under attack. Scans have revealed enemy forces in the wider region intent on targeting our ops.

There’s enough of them that it’s gonna take more than one person to clear away all that trash. If you can grab your gear and a few friends, I could really use you out there.

The specific attack areas and targets are evolving. Don’t worry about the details now. Just get there and I’ll let you know where you’re needed.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor a bonus {ScripAmount} Council Scrip.

- Stows

missions.title: In the Wake of Disaster
missions.desc:
Fortune has shined upon us once again. I’ve just learned of a battle near {Location} that’s just transpired far from the prying eyes of any meddlesome comm arrays, and reinforcements from either of the forces involved have yet to be dispatched. This means that there is a window of opportunity for an enterprising soul to pick the graveyard clean.

I’d like to extend this opportunity to all my trusted contacts. Any and all interested parties can have the location… for the right price. Coordinates will be provided once you accept the contract and will remain available until you choose to terminate it.

Of course, speed will be of the essence as you will not only face potential competition from other salvagers, but also the looming possibility of reinforcements arriving to survey the battlefield.

If you’re still hesitating, just remember, fortune favors the bold.

-cd

missions.title: Jackpot
missions.desc:
Looking for a hauler to pick up some cargo for me. Thing is, there’s a catch.

The cargo’s in the back of an abandoned ship located at {Address}. As you may have figured, this ain’t our cargo, but it sure as hell doesn’t deserve to go to anyone else. I’ll be damned if those CFP assholes get their hands on it before we do.

Be lucky as hell if we were the first to know about this, but I’d wager there’s gonna be more ships swarming around there than flies on a kopion carcass. If you got some pals you can trust, bring them along and ghost those assholes. And don’t forget your heavy-duty tractor beam of course.

You manage to get that cargo and bring it to the freight elevator at {Address}, I can get you a nice cut of the sale.

Stows out.

missions.title: Keep {Location} Safe
missions.desc:
I won't bore you with the nitty gritty, but trust me when I say that {Address} is important to the Headhunters. So imagine how pissed I am to learn that they're being harassed by some aggressive upstarts who are hellbent on taking out their {Objects}. It won't stand.

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed, including any friendly ships in the area. Nullbrains like these hopefully won't pose too much of a challenge to a rising star like yourself.

Clear ‘em all out I’ll throw {ScripAmount} Council Scrip to whoever accepted this gig.

- Stows

Get there and provide some protection before everything gets destroyed. These chumps are lightweights so shouldn't be too much of a problem for you to handle.

missions.desc:
Hi, it's El.

Need a hauler for a job ASAP. One of our contractors had a "personal emergency" and had to ditch their ship and it seems like they're not coming back. Not ideal, really.

Good news is the cargo is still intact, at least according to the tracker. It'd be a huge win for me if you could finish the job by grabbing the cargo at {Address} and bringing it to the freight elevator at {Address}.

Seems like this was a pretty big one, you'll need a ship that can transport {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Really appreciate your help.

{SignOff}

Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping

missions.title: Ling Shipment Recovery
missions.desc:
Hello,

Looking for a quick job? Got a client who's waiting on a shipment but our hauler ran into some engine trouble. Can't seem to get them up and running so we need someone to take over.

Fly out to {Address} and you'll spot their ship. You can't miss it - it's the one that's sitting still in the middle of space. Make sure you bring a heavy-duty tractor beam along with a decent ship that can carry {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

Once you've picked up the goods take them to the freight elevator at {Address}.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

The idiot who was supposed to move these things threw out his back trying to carry all of ‘em at once. So, you know, maybe bring a handheld tractor beam and try taking ‘em one at a time like a normal person. But, hey, don’t let me tell you how to do your job. Just get it done.

missions.title: Need Resource for Research
missions.desc:
To all available contractors,

Our research team at at {Address} is working tirelessly on solving the current ‘Regen Crisis’ and addressing the issue of unstable imprints. Their work has produced promising results, but a lack of a key resource is impeding their ability to run further experiments.

We’ve received word from our supplier that increased demand combined with lower mining yields means that we won’t receive our scheduled shipment for another few months. Our research team can’t wait that long, and we’re hoping you can help.

The resource is hard to come by, but we have it on good authority that the old Hathor mining facilities were built in areas with a high concentration of the ore. Since Hathor went defunct not long after establishing their operations in- system, there’s a good chance that activating one of these mining lasers could provide you with what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.title: Orange Lvl. Contract: Defend {Objects}
missions.desc:
I'm hoping that you'll be able to provide protection services at {Address}. One of our high priority clients is having some real trouble with a band of outlaws targeting their {Objects}. Need to be able to keep the assets as safe and intact as possible. Client’s expecting the service they pay for, so don’t mess this up or we might lose a loyal customer.

For now, we’re still a little in the dark when it comes to these outlaws, but if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering {ScripAmount} MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Orange Lvl. Contract: Protect {Objects}
missions.desc:
One of our high priority clients is under attack from a criminal gang targeting their {Objects} in {Address}. The client’s assets are valuable, so we need to keep those safe at all costs, but I won’t kid – it’ll be a challenge and a half with these thugs determined to do some real damage.

If it were me, I wouldn’t hesitate to bring backup to deal with them. They’re no joke, so we’re offering a well-earned {ScripAmount} MG Scrip to the main contractor who deals with these guys successfully.

Best of luck,

missions.title: Overdrive Initiative: PRIORITY TARGETS
missions.desc:
Our analysts have examined the intel seized from those XenoThreat recon teams but the data appears to be locked behind a sophisticated encryption system and requires a custom cryptokey to access.

We've managed to locate several XenoThreat lieutenants operating in the system, you are to find and engage the suspects and see if they are in possession of a cryptokey that will allows us to access the intel.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

missions.title: Overdrive Initiative: XENOTHREAT SURVEILLANCE
missions.desc:
One of the suspects captured during the recent attacks revealed that XenoThreat is looking to remotely access a number of comm arrays around the system.

Having XenoThreat listening into comms is extremely dangerous for the people living here, so the CDF has been enlisted to reset the comm array, then defend it from any XenoThreat Vanguards that will attempt to reconnect to the servers.

Once those Vanguards have been defeated, clear out any remaining hostile ships in the area.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

missions.title: Parting Gift
missions.desc:
I have a delicate situation that needs handling. After years of being a loyal member of Rough & Ready, {TargetName} defected from the gang and is out there shopping secrets to our rivals. We need {Last} ghosted immediately.

With stuff like this, I’ve found it’s always better to pay someone unassociated with us to do the deed. Scans picked up {Last} near {Address} not too long ago. We’ll pay you well to head there now and take care ‘em for us.

{Last} isn’t an idiot and knows we’ll be coming after ‘em. Be prepared for a helluva fight and don’t expect ‘em to be alone.

- Smokey

missions.title: Past Due
missions.desc:
Time is up for {TargetName}. The skav is way past due on paying back the Headhunters, so I need you to punch them out.

Kill ‘em, not hit ‘em, just in case that’s unclear.

Someone recently spotted {Last} around {Address}, so head there and take ‘em out.

Full disclosure, we’ve gotten reports they used some of our creds to hire extra protection. Prepare accordingly.

Stows out.

missions.title: Payback
missions.desc:
XenoThreat recently hit a Headhunters' stronghold. I’ll spare you the details, but they did some truly heinous shit to our crew. We’ve identified the leader of the op as {TargetName} and are looking for a little payback. We don’t care what you do to get the job done. Only that {Last} is dead.

A source just told us that you can track down this XenoThreat scum over at {Address}. This sicko’s a pro and never travels alone, so don’t expect taking them out to be a walk in the park.

Stows out.

missions.title: Preemptive Strike
missions.desc:
Headhunters got word there’s a XenoThreat op in the works that's targeting one of our crews. We don’t have precise details about the plan but we know that {TargetName} is organizing it. Instead of sitting back and waiting for something to happen, we’ve decided to be proactive.

{Last} was just spotted with others around {Address}. We can’t mobilize anyone fast enough to get there. I want you to rush there and deliver a preemptive strike.

Stows out.

missions.title: Pro Tem Group Warrant Contract
missions.desc:
Hey,

Hope everything is going all right. I may have reached out already, but I wanted to be sure and introduce myself. I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system today, providing a variety of services to all major governmental bodies as well as various private concerns. The reason I am contacting you is because we believe someone with your skills could be a boon to our clients.

Not only that, but I think we'd be good fit for you. Our contractors traditionally get a higher rate of pay than a lot of our competitors in system, and a lot of them tell me how they really enjoy being tasked with the challenging and interesting work we offer.

Now, Northrock holds itself to such high-standards so before we can make anything official, you'll need to achieve approved contractor status by completing a pro tem contract.

I was hoping you could capture several wanted members of an outlaw gang: {Target1}, {Target2}, and {Target3}.

Get that done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Protect {Objects} From Luggers
missions.desc:
Some morons with some seriously inflated notion of their place in 'verse made the damn foolish choice of attacking the {Objects} at {Address}. We've got some things in play over there so we can’t let ‘em get away with it.

If you're interesting in helpin' out, get there and deal with these luggers before they can do too much damage. Don't figure you'll break too much of a sweat dealin' with them.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor {ScripAmount} Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.

Stows out.

missions.title: Protect Our Site

Some idiots with a deathwish are attacking our ships around {Address}. Can’t let ‘em do that without paying the price. Want to do the honors?

If so, head out and get after ‘em. The crew there is tracking the attacker’s movements and I’ll pass along situational updates as they come in.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor a bonus of {ScripAmount} Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.

Stows out.

I was having a shite day, and it just got worse. Our interests over at {Address} comm'd to let me know that their {Objects} are under attack by these no-name hoods looking to stake a claim.

You're gonna go there for me and protect the place, including any friendly ships unfortunate enough to be caught in the crossfire. Don't think putting these wannabees in their place will be too tricky for someone like you.

Also, I’ll sweeten the pot by giving the main contractor {ScripAmount} Council Scrip just to show my appreciation.

I cannot stress enough how dangerous these guys are, so I wouldn’t hesitate to bring backup to deal with them. If you and the assets make it out intact, we’re offering a well-earned {ScripAmount} MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Best of luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

missions.title: Red Lvl. Contract: Protect {Objects}
missions.desc:
An emergency contract just came through about a gang of violent thugs wreaking havoc on one of our VIP clients’ infrastructures. If available, we need you to rush to {Address} and defend the client’s extremely valuable {Objects} at all costs.

Foxwell is extremely aware of this group, so believe me when I say these pilots are not to be taken lightly. I strongly recommend that you arrange a highly competent backup force to fly with you to the site.

If you manage to survive the encounter with the client’s property intact, we’re adding {ScripAmount} MG Scrip any main contractor brave enough to take this job on.

Stay safe, and good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

missions.title: Red Wind Challenging Cargo Recovery
missions.desc:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We’re having trouble completing a hauling mission and need a reliable contractor who has experience working in dangerous environments to complete the job. Just as a heads up, the cargo is in an abandoned ship surrounded by multiple, highly dangerous outlaws. We strongly advise you bring some backup with you and heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s goods. Details follow:

RECOVERY LOCATION
· {Address}

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at {Address}

Since this is a bit risky, we’re offering proportionate pay. I’ll leave it up to you to decide how to distribute it to your crew.

TAKE PRIDE IN YOUR WORK – Even as a contractor you are representing Red Wind Linehaul. Do not intentionally do anything to harm the company’s reputation.

missions.title: Red Wind Dangerous Cargo Recovery
missions.desc:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

Putting out a call for a highly skilled pilot who can recover our client’s cargo. Please only accept this contract if you have experience dealing with extremely hostile situations involving multiple combatants. Additional crew members and a heavy-duty tractor beam are highly recommended.

RECOVERY LOCATION
· {Address}

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at {Address}

The cargo should be in the bay of the abandoned ship. The client has already expressed frustration regarding the cargo’s delay so please work quickly and efficiently.

BE RESILIENT – Life is hard and sometimes you have to roll with the punches. Keep going and don’t let it bring you down.

missions.title: Red Wind Package Handler
Red Wind Special Cargo Recovery
missions.desc:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

We have a special assignment for only the most competent contractors. One of our haulers who is sadly no longer with us failed to complete their last job. The cargo they were supposed to deliver is sitting stationary in their former ship in the location listed below.

RECOVERY LOCATION
· {Address}

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at {Address}

I’m not going dance around the issue, this is an extremely challenging job. You’ll need to bring a strong team of skilled pilots with you to deal with the outlaws that killed the previous contractor and a heavy-duty tractor beam to retrieve the client’s cargo. That said, if you take on this contract, we will make it worth your time.

HOW DID WE DO – Complete our short feedback survey on our Spectrum page for a chance to enter our monthly prize draw.

missions.title: Red Wind Straightforward Cargo Recovery
missions.desc:
RED WIND LINEHAUL
'YOUR GOODS IN GOOD HANDS'
----------------------------

A Red Wind hauler has been ambushed by some outlaws and now our clients’ cargo is sitting still whilst they prepare to steal it. We need a pilot with a heavy-duty tractor beam and a combat ready ship to head to the location below and recover the cargo before it’s gone for good.

RECOVERY LOCATION
· {Address}

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Freight elevator at {Address}

The pilot reported multiple hostiles so make sure you take this seriously.

EVERY OPPORTUNITY COUNTS – Make the most of what’s given to you, show us that you can handle more work.

missions.title: Reputation Management
missions.desc:
Some assholes are refusing to pay us what we’re owed. Problem is, these idiots are bragging about it. Had they kept it quiet, we could’ve taken care of this more surgically, but now we need to send a message.

The fools are operating from {Address}. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

- Stows out.

missions.title: Rescue Incomplete Ling Delivery
missions.desc:
Hi,

Got a relatively straightforward one for you if you're interested.

One of our pilot ignored a maintenance warning and sure enough, a couple of hours later their ship broke down over at {Address}. They're on their way back to the office now but we could do with a reliable hauler whose got a ship big enough to transport {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers to complete the haul for us.

Think you could help us out? You just need to pick up the stranded shipment and deliver it to the freight elevator at {Address}. And I probably don't have to say this, but a heavy-duty tractor beam would probably be handy to have along.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.title: Restore Order at {DefendLocationWrapperLocation}
missions.desc:
Our crew at {Address} needs help. Enemy ships are swarming the area and attacking anything and everything they can find. That’d be bad enough as is, but this site has some absolutely crucial gear and personnel that we can’t have destroyed or compromised.

Considering the size and scale of the attack, you’re gonna need a fully supplied ship and some reliable wingmen. Gather your crew, fly out to the site, and I’ll send you specifics on where you’re needed most.

To prove just how serious we are about getting this done right, the main contractor will earn a bonus {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for making sure absolutely nothing goes wrong.

- Stow

missions.desc:
A new gang who is proving to be a real pain in the ass for the Headhunters just upped the stakes by attacking the {Objects} at {Address}. Never a good thing since we got interest in the welfare of the folks there, but doubly so because if they do too much damage it might royally screw an upcoming operation.

Head over there as soon as you're able and stop the attack before they can do any lasting damage. And if any friendly ships need a hand, I want you to look out for them too. Don't expect this gang to be pushovers but you should still be able to deal with them if you keep your head on.

If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows

missions.title: Secure {Objects} From Rivals
missions.desc:
Our friends at {Address} have been compromised. A new gang in the area are threatening them by targeting their {Objects}.

If those get destroyed its going to be seriously bad for business, so I want you over there pronto on protection duty.

If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows

missions.title: Secure Our Airspace
missions.desc:
Our airspace around {Address} has been compromised. Enemy ships are threatening the base and any of our ships in the area. Gotta put a stop to this immediately, so get your shit in order and get over there. Just get going and I’ll update you with any relevant info on where you’re needed.

If you need any extra motivation, I’m adding a bonus {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for the main contractor.

- Stows

missions.title: Silence Sentries
missions.desc:
Our resistance movement is growing by the day, but that comes with some unwanted attention. Recent scans discovered orbital sentries at {address} and a ship running a patrol pattern. We believe this is part of an espionage campaign targeting XenoThreat, most likely funded by the UEE.

We’re looking for an experienced merc willing to destroy the sentries ASAP. Since they already have eyes and ears on us, sending in someone from outside the org would draw less attention. If you take the gig, you’ll be paid promptly once the sentries are destroyed.

Now, while the patrol ship isn’t the main target, we suspect that if it escapes it might have reinforcements in reserve. Might be smart to deal with it promptly.

If you decide to help us, XenoThreat will remember you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Silence Spying Op
missions.desc:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for someone to handle a delicate situation. We’ve discovered a ship and orbital sentries at {address} spyin’ on us. We’re in a bit of a bind because we don’t want to start a larger fight with whoever’s behind this. That’s why we’re looking for some hired help who can quickly and discreetly take care of it for us. Interested?

Last thing, once you’re out there, make sure to keep an eye on that ship. Bet as soon as you start blowin’ up their sentries they’re gonna try to bring in some help to stop you.

- Smokey

missions.title: Small Covalex Shipment Needs Recovering
missions.desc:
Hiya,

I've got a client who's been messaging me all morning about a shipment they were supposed to receive and when I checked up on the cargo it turns out that it's sitting completely still in the middle of space.

This is obviously bad for a number of reasons, and not just because I had to spend 20 minutes getting yelled at. Can you head over to {Address} and see what happened? The original contract called for a ship that could carry {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers so make sure you've got that and a heavy-duty tractor beam.

Once you've got the cargo, can you make sure it's delivered to the freight elevator at {Address}? Thanks a bunch.

{SignOff}

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.title: Squash Spying Op
missions.desc:
Recently made an interesting discovery that someone set up a handful of orbital sentries at {address}. Guess they’re trying to grab some info about our operations there. They even have a few ships guarding to make sure nothing happens to them.

Of course, we want these bastards gone, but I’m worried that getting rid of it ourselves would be bad for business. That’s why we’re looking for a little ‘plausible deniability’. Someone from outside of R&R to eliminate the problem, so whoever is behind it can’t directly tie the attack back to us. I know this won’t be a walk in the park, especially with those guards lurking. Who knows how many reinforcements they have at the ready? But if you manage to get it done, we’re prepared to see you paid right.

Think you’ve got the skills to pull this off?

- Smokey

missions.title: Standard Cargo Recovery Op.
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Recover Cargo
Approval code: = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can salvage a messy situation. A client's trusted pilot apparently wasn't so trustworthy and made off with a shipment. But thankfully our trackers are reporting the shipment's static for the moment, waiting to be picked up. If we play our cards right, there's still time to resolve this.

The abandoned ship is located at {Address} and will need a heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the goods. A ship that can handle {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers is a necessity, and expect contact from whatever outlaws this double-crossing pilot was hoping to sell to.

Once recovered, deliver the cargo to the freight elevator at {Address}.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Stomp Spying Op
missions.desc:
The Rough & Ready crew is looking for an independent merc interested in something heavy. We’ve been keeping an eye on a developing situation at {address} where ships are guarding several orbital sentries spying on our operations.

Now, I might’ve been born at night, but it wasn’t last night. Considering the blatant way they’re set up, whoever’s responsible had to know we’d eventually discover it. Almost feels like they’re baiting R&R into attacking it, and I don’t want us falling for it.

Instead, you’re gonna do it for us and get paid a damn good amount of creds for your effort. The ships stationed there will be less suspicious of an unaffiliated ship approaching and make it harder to pin the attack on us.

Just be sure to plan accordingly before heading in. Maybe bring your own reinforcements in case any of their ships escape and call in some of their own.

- Smokey

missions.title: Stop Attack at {DefendLocationWrapperLocation}
missions.desc:
Looking for someone who can not only dogfight but recruit others to the Headhunters cause. Our operations center at {Address}, along with any ships going to and from it, are being targeted by hostile forces. We need support there pronto.

Not gonna lie, but there’s lots of heat around there. That’s why you’ll need to be fully supplied and find some trustworthy friends to fly at your wing. When you get your crew together, head out there and I’ll update you if there’s any flare ups in the area that need your attention.

This op needs to go off without a hitch, so I’m offering the main contractor a bonus {ScripAmount} Council Scrip for a job well done.

Stows out.

missions.title: Stop Gang From Destroying {Objects}
missions.desc:
Got word from some allies of ours over at {Address} that they're coming under attack. A gang we've had run-ins with before are trying to take them over by first destroying their {Objects}.

This crew are mungers through and through, but they mean business and can handle themselves in a fight. It will take a bit of doing to make sure they don't blow up everything. You might even think about bringing some help along.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor {ScripAmount} Council Scrip.

- Stows

missions.title: Stop Rival Attack at {Location}
missions.desc:
There's this small gang that continues to be a thorn in our side, and the bastards have just ambushed some friends over at {Address}. Seems like they're doing their best to destroy the {Objects} there.

I need you and whatever crew you can muster on site stopping these mungers from blowing everything up and protecting any friendly ships that need a hand.

Handle this right and I’ll give the main contractor {ScripAmount} Council Scrip.

- Stows

missions.title: Strike Saboteur
missions.desc:
Interested in doing a little hunting?

{TargetName} sabotaged one of our fuel shipments and cost us a ton of creds, so I’m looking for someone to make ‘em pay for what they did. Just got word {Last} was spotted at {Address}. If you head there now, there’s a good chance you can pick up their trail and take ‘em out for good.

{Last} didn’t work alone, so don’t be surprised if they’re traveling with extra protection.

- Smokey

missions.title: Stuck Ling Shipment Pending Delivery
missions.desc:
Hey,

Just our luck that we land one of the biggest contracts of our life and our hauler's engines seize up. They've tried their best to fix it but seems like it's just not happening.

Can you fly out to {Address} and grab the cargo for us? It's really important that we show our client that we're just as reliable as the other big players out there.

Just so you know this is a large shipment. You'll need a ship that can handle {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to move it all. Once you've transferred it to your ship, deliver it to the freight elevator at {Address} and we'll send confirmation to the client.

Considering the circumstances, we're paying above market rates to whoever can complete this.

Thanks,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.title: Take Out Citizens for Prosperity Fuel Supply
missions.desc:
It seems like I can't go a day without waking up to one of my people bitchin' and moanin' about how hard Citizens for Prosperity is making their life.

Eventually we're going wipe those do-gooders out of the system, but for now I'll settle for some peace and quiet.

Go to {Address} and destroy the fuel stores CFP have got there. That should at least keep them out of our business for a bit.

-Stows out

Just don’t forget to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam as that shit’s heavy.

When you’re done, drop it off at the freight elevator at {Address} and we’ll take care of the rest.

Stows out.

missions.title: Track Down Gang Member
missions.desc:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on {TargetName}. As a Clips level member of the Headhunters gang, {Last} has led operations that have targeted XenoThreat operatives, missions, and infrastructure. For these transgressions, XenoThreat will pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates {Last}.

LOCATION UPDATE: {Last} was seen near {Address} not too long ago. If you decide to accept this contract, you should head to the coordinates immediately. {Last} knows we’re looking for ‘em and has been traveling with an escort recently. Don’t be surprised if they’re not alone.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Track Down Spy
missions.desc:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on the head of {TargetName}. As a member of the Headhunters gang, {Last} hacked into XenoThreat systems to steal information on our operations and personnel. The harm done can only be rectified by ensuring {Last} can never do something like this again. That’s why XenoThreat will pay anyone who can track down and assassinate {Last}.

LOCATION UPDATE: Recent scans identified {Last} traveling with other ships near {Address}.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Track Down Traitor
missions.desc:
XenoThreat has placed a kill order on {TargetName}. A known member of the Headhunters gang, {Last} has betrayed Humankind by being a known alien ally who associates with them in both a personal and business capacity. XenoThreat wants these traitorous associations stopped immediately before they bring more alien influence to Pyro. We’ll pay anyone who successfully tracks down and assassinates {Last} for these crimes against Humanity.

LOCATION UPDATE: {Last} was recently spotted with an escort at {Address}.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Trigger A Trap
missions.desc:
Some asshole going by the name {TargetName} has been running a scheme where their cargo ship requests refueling services only to ambush our ships when they get there. Even loaded the damn thing up with real cargo to make sure it passes scans. We’ve spread the word so nobody in Rough & Ready will fall for the trap again, but I want this skag punished.

I think {Last} knows a lot of our people on sight, so I’m guessing it’ll be better to pay you to take care of it. Heard that they were spotted around {Address}. Head there now and take care of that cargo ship and anyone protecting it once and for all.

- Smokey

missions.title: Tutorial - Your First Flight
missions.desc:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in {Name} finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the {TransitNameShort} transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around {Name} – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

missions.title: UDM Package Handler
URGENT REFUEL REQUEST: {Ship}
missions.desc:
Hey, you!

I've got a beacon at {Address}. They say their tanks are running dry and they could use {FuelType}. If you're interested, I get the feeling they'll be really pleased to see you.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of {RefuelRequest}, and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

They're stuck out in an area with a bad reputation, though things have been a bit more quiet recently. Still worth staying alert I'd say, just in case there's still trouble lurking out there.

Either way, the sooner everyone's able to get flying again - and that includes you - the better.

Happy trails,

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

missions.title: UWC'S HIRING REFUELERS
missions.desc:
Hey!

DD from the United Wayfarers Club here.

The UWC offers repair, rearming and refueling services across the UEE. It just so happens that we're on the look-out for new affiliates whose ships are fitted for refueling. If you've got the fuel pods and like it when people are pleased to see you, the UWC might be the club for you.

And if you think it might be, I've got a live beacon you might like.

If you do happen to like it, a word to the wise: make sure your fuel pods are full before you head out.

A Club member has run out of ~misssion(FuelType) at {Address}. I'm not sure on the details, like how they ended up out there with no Go Juice, but the UWC doesn't like to leave folk hanging.

The client vessel will pay you at the rate of {RefuelRequest}. As a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

It's a straightforward run. Perfect if you want to get a feel for this kind of job. Get out there, fill up the tanks of their {Ship} and get them on their way. Do enough runs like this, and the process becomes muscle memory. Until then, there's a journal entry on your mobiGlas called "Refueling Protocols" that covers the basics.

There have been no reports of outlaw activity in that sector, but stay alert. I always recommend you aim for a fast turnaround. The sooner you're done, the sooner I can fix you up with another contract. UWC's always looking for new affiliates.

Looking forward to working with you.

Dina Deloit
Dispatch Hub
United Wayfarers Club
"We’ve got your back"

missions.title: Yellow Lvl. Contract: Protect {Objects}
missions.desc:
Any willing pilots in the area? Need some protection around {Address} for a client. A band of outlaws has been targeting their {Objects}, and if nothing's done about it they'll do some real damage. Need someone to protect the client’s property as much as possible and deal with the thugs.

From the intel we’ve managed to gather, these thugs are small-time but can cause some pain if you’re not careful. So, if you manage to nail this to the Foxwell standards, we’re offering {ScripAmount} MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: A Chance to Impress
missions.desc:
Firstly, allow me to introduce myself. To put it rather dramatically, I deal in lives.

People hire me when some soul needs to be extinguished, and I in return employ the perfect person to serve as the extinguishant. This provides security to all parties involved as none know the identity of the other. An ideal situation as far as these things go.

I was recently made aware that you may possess skills that would make you of service to me and decided that it would be worthwhile to pursue the validity of this claim.

If you have any interest in forging a working relationship, I will need a demonstration of said skills.

Seek out and discreetly kill {TargetName} over at {Address}.

Do so successfully and you will be rewarded. Not only that, but you will have proven yourself worthy of further consideration.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.title: Active Bounty: {TargetName} (HRT)
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a qualified bounty hunter to apprehend the high-risk target {TargetName} from {Address}.

A high-risk target typically pilots a large multicrew vessel, has several known allies, and is expected to be difficult to apprehend. It may be useful to bring along support staff to assist with engaging this target.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Neutralize {TargetName}; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to vehicle suitably outfitted for combat.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Collect Manufacturing Resource - Large Scale
missions.desc:
POSTING: Resource Gathering
LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System
WORK EXPERIENCE: Mining, Commodity Trading
TERMS*:
Shubin Interstellar is stepping up to help stop the spread of the People’s Ailment. Our facilities are helping in the efforts to produce much needed ventilation filters to replace the faulty ones responsible for the spread of the dangerous Molina Mold, but we need your help to hit that ambitious goal.

Our current stockpiles of an important resource are not sufficient enough, so we need contractors who can deliver a large-scale haul of it to {Address}.

Resources tied to another contract will not be accepted.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System

Shubin Interstellar is switching a sizable portion of our focus to assist in the production of ventilation filters to help stop the spread of Molina Mold. Even though we have the capacity and desire to help, our access to one resource is hampering our efforts.

We’re looking for motivated individuals willing to procure and deliver a medium scale supply of it to our facility at {Address} so relief efforts can continue humming along.

missions.desc:
POSTING: Resource Gathering
LOCATION: Pyro System, Stanton System
WORK EXPERIENCE: Mining, Commodity Trading
TERMS*:
As a member of Alliance Aid, Shubin Interstellar is dedicated to assisting in the production of as many high quality ventilation filters as possible. These filters are key to stopping the spread of Molina Mold and keeping more people from being stricken with the People’s Ailment.

We’ve just received word from our facility at {Address} that their stockpile of a vital resource is getting low. Our normal supplier won’t be able to do a resupply run for a while, so we’re hoping you might be able to do a small scale run of it now to bridge the gap.

If you’re available, simply acquire it as you see best and bring it to our facility, and we’ll compensate you well.

Resources tied to another contract will not be accepted.

*Shubin Interstellar is an equal opportunity contractor. By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Courier Needed
missions.desc:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid went down at {Address}. Courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to {Address}.

THREAT LEVEL – There is a strong chance that the courier was attacked by outlaws eager to acquire the vital supplies needed to stop the Molina mold out break in Levski. Medium level engagements expected.

TRAVEL – All transportation needs should be arranged by courier.

FTL Courier Services thanks you for helping us do our part for Alliance Aid.

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Treatment Cargo Haul - Large Scale
missions.desc:
Hi,

People are breathing a sigh of relief that a treatment for the People's Aliment has been found, but we're not out of the woods just yet. There's still plenty of folks suffering . We're hoping you can help the cause by handling a large scale haul of the stuff.

If you're available, we need you to pick up from {Address} and then fly it over to {Address}. Remember to bring a handheld tractor beam and a ship that can hold {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

Safe Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

Hey,

Pretty heartbreaking hearing what's happening to the people out in Levski with this Molina mold outbreak? Our family has decided to do all we can to help out with Alliance Aid. Got a medium scale haul of antifungal waiting to be picked up at {Address} and taken to {Address}. Think you can handle this for us?

Before you go, please make sure you bring a ship that can hold {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers. You'll also need a handheld tractor beam to deal with the containers.

Safe Hauling,

*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

Received a tip about a ship that had been attacked at {Location}. Apparently it's been there for a little while, but the Governing Committee would like to know how it got there.

We're looking for someone to go out, retrieve the blackbox and bring it to {Destination} so we can figure out what happened.

Just a reminder, the blackbox isn't small, so you'll need a ship with some storage.

Standard listed rate upon delivery

Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Bounty Assignment: {TargetName} (HRT)
missions.desc:
Hey,

Have an interesting bounty for you. A high level criminal by the name {TargetName} has been located at {Address}.

Based on our intel, its highly unlikely that the target’s going to be sitting and waiting out in the open. You most likely will have to infiltrate the facility and draw them out.

Something like a large firefight should be enough to do the trick.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Bring Down the Hammer
missions.desc:
Sent ships to investigate a distress beacon only for it to turn into an ambush by the People’s Alliance. They’ve been fighting like hell to get away but can’t seem to extract themselves.

Let’s get ‘em some help on the double. Think you can go on over to {Address} to give ‘em some support?

-Stows

missions.title: Capture Arlington Gang Member Les Arlington
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

An anonymous comm has tipped us off that Les Arlington, child of gang leader Maltrox Arlington, had been spotted picking up a delivery at a Covalex transfer center. We will provide you with the coordinates of where we believe their current whereabouts are.

Les is an experienced pilot who has been flying for almost as long as they’ve been walking and usually serves as the gang’s get-away pilot. It may be worthwhile to bring extra support ships in order to cut off any attempts at escape.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Cleaning Up Someone Else’s Mess
missions.desc:
You know when you ask someone a question and you have a feeling they’re lying, but you choose to give them the benefit of the doubt? Yeah. That’s what I’m dealing with right now.

Two “expert” haulers I hired to transport some gear for me ran into some trouble and ended up ditching my goods over at {Address}. Needless to say, I’ve ordered a hit on them, but what I need from you is to go recover that cargo. The tracker says the cargo’s still on the ship, so you’ll just need a a heavy-duty tractor beam and your own ship to recover it.

You might run into a couple of scavengers lurking around there, but I doubt you’ll have any trouble with them.

When you’re done, take the stuff to {Address} and I’ll sort you out with a reward.

-Twitch

missions.title: Clear CFP Route of Hostiles
missions.desc:
To help protect our pilots, Citizens for Prosperity will often recommend the use of less traditional routes through the system. However, it seems that a gang of outlaws has gotten word and has begun to stage repeated ambushes along one such flightpath. Rather than just go around the problem and risk it persisting along the new route, we feel it we be prudent to meet these outlaws head on.

You and whatever support ships you enlist will head to {Address} and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Clear Out Drugs
missions.desc:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We got word that a syndicate spiked a rival’s drug package and its causing chaos on the streets. Forensics have identified the source, a production facility over at {Address}. Word is the drug manufacturers don’t even know they have a poisoned crop on their hands.

We’re sorting through how to handle the arrests, but the important thing is to get this crap off the streets now. I need you to get down there and destroy the drugs they’re storing on site.

They won’t be happy about it, so you’ll probably have a fight on your hands, but the important thing is clearing out the product.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Clear Out Site
missions.desc:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We’ve gotten word that {Address} is being used by some local criminals as a base of operations. BlacJac needs the site swept and any inhabitants cleared out of there.

You are authorized to use lethal force if necessary.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Clear Site of Drugs
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary or security professional to report to {Address} and destroy the drugs being stored there.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Clear the site of drugs; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• No ongoing addiction issues.

missions.title: Dangerous Ambush
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high profile client recently lost an important shipment when a pilot double-crossed them and ran off with their product. After weeks of hunting we’ve discovered that they were connected with an outlaw pack, so the client is looking to us to deter similar future issues from arising. The ultimate target is the pilot of a {AmbushTarget}, who leads the crew responsible. This won’t be easy. They don’t go anywhere without escort fighters and sub-capital ships. That’s why we highly recommend that you find a trusted friend or two who can handle this with you.

Intel gathered by our analysts indicates that they frequently fly by an emission cloud near {Address} which would provide an excellent area to stage a surprise strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. We’re also adding a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - {ReputationRank} Rank - {CargoGradeToken} Cargo Haul
missions.desc:
We're looking for someone discreet to move a new batch of altruciatoxin to a number of buyers . Yeah, it's illegal, but only if you get caught.

The shipment is at {Address}. You'll need to take it to these drop points:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

{SingleToMultiToken}

Be sure your ship can carry size {MissionMaxSCUSize} containers, and don't forget to pack a handheld tractor beam. Not sure how you're planning on moving the boxes, otherwise.

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS -- {ReputationRank} Rank, {CargoGradeToken} Scale Cargo Run
missions.desc:
If you're looking for creds, the Saints need someone with hauling experience to do a supply run from {Address} to {Address}.

You're gonna need a ship that can hold size {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers and a handheld tractor beam to move the boxes around.

Don't open the crates but just so you know, most of this stuff is legal but not all of it. Try not to cross paths with anyone who might make that a problem for you. Get me?

-Twitch

missions.title: Deal with {TargetName} and Support Forces
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Bounty
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Got a big league bounty contract that’s primed to be executed. {TargetName} and their crew were identified executing a raid on {Address}. If their MO holds true, {Last} has surfaced to land a big score and then will disappear into the ether. Let's not allow that to happen again.

Word is the hostile forces have spread themselves across the location. That’ll make hunting down the precise location of {Last} difficult. In addition, expect the target to act defensively when under attack. In previous engagements, they remained hidden and directed their forces from afar. It is our recommendation that you focus on thinning out their allies first and force {Last} to come to their own defense. Would also advise you to bring plenty of ammo and even some support to help keep you from being overwhelmed.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Defenders needed against Headhunters
missions.desc:
We received an emergency comm from {Address} reporting that they are currently under attack by a group of Headhunters. We know our presence in the system has upset the Headhunters, but it hardly excuses this unprovoked attack.

If available, please gather your gear and head out. Just understand that Headhunters are experienced fighters and will not back down easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Demolition Mission
missions.desc:
I’m looking to send a strong message to the crew over at {Address} and know the perfect way to do it - property damage.

All you need to do is head on over, destroy a few things here and there, and really drive home an important lesson about respecting your betters.

Do that for me and I’ll be feeling very happy. And generous.

Interested?

missions.title: Destroy Toxic Narcotics
missions.desc:
We’ve been investigating a recent bout of OD’s and they all seem to have originated with a bad batch of drugs made over at {Address}.

I’m working with other contractors to ferret out those responsible, but people are dying as long is the product is still out there.

I want you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there. Should buy us some time before we shut them down for good.

They will have guards protecting their supply, so be prepared to engage with hostiles.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Logistic Data
missions.desc:
We got a bit of a problem that I'm hoping you can solve for me. One of our informers has revealed that XenoThreat has been amassing data on Citizens for Prosperity operations throughout the system.

This information, if used correctly, could put our people at serious risk. The best solution is for you to completely destroy the servers where the data is being stored at {Address}.

With their trove of information wiped out, it should give our people a fighting chance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Eliminate Drug Stash
missions.desc:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Contraband Elimination
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: R. Russel
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Local criminals have been identified using {Address} to manufacture large quantities of illegal. Hurston Security requires a contractor to go to the facility and eliminate all contraband being stored there.

Payment will be sent once all the contraband is eliminated.

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

missions.title: Eliminate XenoThreat Idris
missions.desc:
Hey,

The rumors are true. XenoThreat has deployed an Idris to stalk and attack Citizens for Prosperity operations in a dramatic escalation of their hostility towards us. We just received word the ship, under the command of {TargetName}, is advancing toward {address}. We can’t get our own forces there fast enough to fight them, and are in desperate need of help.

We’re looking to hire someone brave enough to take it to these bastards. It’s not enough to scare them away, we need to guarantee that it can’t come after us again.

Not sure if you’ve faced down an Idris before, but it’s a tall task for someone to take on alone. I’d highly recommend recruiting others to the cause.

Best,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Eradicate All Nests
missions.desc:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Pest Extermination
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: Medium
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Hurston is seeking a contractor willing to exterminate several nests that have been preventing departments from surveying the relevant caves for resources. We are prepared to offer generous payment for the eradication of these various pests.

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **
