HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Sweep
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: G. Livingston
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

Hurston is seeking a contractor willing to clear out the criminal occupants from {Address}.

The site has been used to host numerous illegal activities, so it is imperative that it is secured.

You are authorized to take any actions necessary. Payment will be sent once the facility is confirmed to be clear.

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

missions.title: Headhunter Needs Help
missions.desc:
You busy? A promising prospect was doing a special run for me but ran into trouble with the People’s Alliance around {Address}. This one’s on me. Knew they weren’t the best dogfighter but thought they could do this without running into any other ships.

Told ‘em to hold tight and do everything they can to stay alive until support gets there. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for someone with your skillset.

-Stows

missions.title: Help Deal with Outlaw Hunting Party
missions.desc:
Recently we've had incident reports of numerous Citizens for Prosperity contractors in the system having run-ins with an outlaw hunting party operating out of {Address}.

To help re-establish safer routes through that sector, you will be dispatched to head there and engage with these outlaws. The group is known to travel in smaller packs, so its important that you and whatever backup you bring wait in the area to deal with all of them or else there's a chance the threat will remain.

Thank you for helping us,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

variants.title: Help Deal with Outlaw Hunting Party
Help Deal with Outlaw Hunting Party

missions.title: Help Headhunters Prospect
missions.desc:
Guess some folks just can’t dogfight. Sent a young prospect out on patrol, and am now being barraged with comms about how they’re barely hanging on. Had them update me with the details about who they’re up against and I damn near fell outta my chair laughing.

If this kid can’t handle a People’s Alliance ship, they sure ain’t ready for flight assignments. Appreciate it if you could save their hide anyway.

If you’re free, could you head over to {Address} and show ‘em how it’s done?

-Stows

missions.title: Highly Dangerous Ambush
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Recently, we sent a contractor after a {AmbushTarget}, who was leading a crew targeting the operations of an extremely important client. Unfortunately, it was a trap and we lost some good people. We can’t let the target get away again, so we’ve decided the best course of action is to give them a dose of their own medicine.

Ambushing this target seems like the safest course of action, and we’ve identified a good spot for such an attack. There’s an emission cloud near {Address} that the target and their crew frequently fly by. You can power down your ship and hide there until you’re ready to strike. This crew is ruthless and extremely skilled. Don’t make the same mistake as the previous contractor and go this alone. It would be best for you to bring a few trusted friends to help handle this crew.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. Plus, we’ll throw in a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip for the main contractor for taking care of this.

This contract is non-negotiable.

missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

It appears that second time's the charm for the Arlington gang. After one failed attempt, the recently escaped criminal family has managed to boost an Idris from a repair yard. Now we know what the mining laser and biometrics they stole were for.

Since we had such success capturing them the first time, Eckhart Security has been granted the warrant for the gang’s arrest. This is going to take considerable firepower to bring down a capital ship of this ability.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to track down the Idris and neutralize the gang.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract and will be adjusted based on the final evaluation of you and your team's combat effectiveness rating.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Intercepted Supply Run
missions.desc:
Life is tough on the frontier, and every delivery to our settlers is important. We really can't afford to lose any more this year.

One of our key suppliers has been hit by a group of outlaws over at {Address} and gone silent on us. I fear the worst, but if we can still recover the supplies they were transporting, it could make a huge difference.

Chances are the outlaws who attacked them are still lurking around there so be on your guard. Once you've dealt with them, grab the cargo and take it to the freight elevator at {Address}. Make sure you're flying a ship that can carry {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers and bring a heavy-duty tractor beam too.

Fly safe out there,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Kill the king
missions.desc:
Looking for any hitters available for a quick gig. Over at {Address}, they're getting hit by some geniuses led by {TargetName}. We've tussled against {Last} in the past so it's no surprise they haven't wised up.

We want you to head there and take them down. Kill whoever you like, but {Last} should be your focus.

Stows out.

missions.title: Launch Surprise Attack
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Need someone to take out a {AmbushTarget} and deal with the escort ships protecting it. They’ve already interfered with several of our ongoing operations and have become a real problem across several of Eckhart Security cases. Not sure what their endgame is, but it won’t matter once you deal with them.

We’ve let slip that we will be working a job over at {Address} which should serve as bait to draw them out. The spot is ideal for an ambush because of the emission cloud that’s a perfect place to power down and hide until you’re ready to strike. If you’re available, the {AmbushTarget} and its escorts should be passing through soon.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The main contractor will also receive a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Ling Family {ReputationRank} Cargo Haul - {CargoGradeToken} Scale
missions.desc:
Hi,

Normally Reyes schedules our hauls, but she’s gone for the day, and I just got a comm inquiring about a simple, direct run from {Address} to {Address}. The cargo is a load of fruit that will lose its value if it spoils. We don't want to anger this client, so would appreciate it if you knocked this out in a timely manner.

Here’s some other details you should know. The largest container used is {MissionMaxSCUSize}, so don’t forget your handheld tractor beam.

Sincerely,
Petra Ling
Managing Director of Cargo Operations
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.title: Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
missions.desc:
Hi,

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a handheld tractor beam.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers

{SignOff}

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.title: Looking for a Damn Hero
missions.desc:
Got ourselves in a real mess here. A Headhunters ship on an important mission got attacked near {Address}. Can’t get too into the specifics but it’s absolutely vital that they survive. The People’s Alliance know this too because they’re throwing everything they can at ‘em.

Not gonna pull any punches. This is a serious-ass situation that many wouldn’t survive. If you do, I’ll sing your praises and make sure you’re paid well.

-Stows

missions.title: Lost But Not Gone
missions.desc:
A rival crew was able to get their hands on our delivery routes and now they have one of my cargo ships pinned down at {Address}.

Now the ship’s sitting there being guarded by a full crew of these assholes. They must be waiting for someone to show up with a transport ship, but you’re going to get there first.

Head there with a crew of your own and a heavy-duty tractor beam to take the goods away. Make sure they’re the best people you got. It’d be a mistake to underestimate these bastards.

Ghost them and bring my cargo back to the freight elevator at {Address} and I’ll make sure you’re seriously comp’d for this.

-Twitch

*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Minor Mining Job

WORK BRIEF:
If you’ve got time, I’ve got a pretty basic mining job for you. I'm building a database of mineral types and their locations but I need some raw data, so I need someone to locate {Resources} {MineableType}. You can keep what you find, I'll pull the data I need. {Rarity}

Also, if you're stuck on where to look or new to mining, the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.

Thanks.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Locate Missing Individual
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: I. Takao
RISK ASSESSMENT: Low

The staff at {Address} has recently filed a missing persons report for one {TargetName}. They have been missing for several days and were last seen heading to the {Location}.

You are being contracted to conduct an onsite search for {Last} and see if you can determine their whereabouts.

Payment is dependent on returning a record of their current location, alive or dead.

missions.title: Moraine Data Retrieval
missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Data Retrieval

WORK BRIEF:
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and make a copy of their server data. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Need someone taken out
missions.desc:
Got a crew that's been hitting Headhunter ships lately. Their leader's a real piece of work named {TargetName}. We've tracked them to {Address}, so we're looking for someone to put them down for good.

This group likes to fight, but shouldn't be a problem for someone like you.

Get over there and get it done.

Stows out.

missions.title: Neutralize Dangerous Criminal Fleet
missions.desc:
A criminal fleet has taken up root in a sector that Citizens For Prosperity is trying to develop and all forward progress has stopped thanks to their violent actions. It is imperative to a long term goals that we find a way to neutralize this fleet before that cause any further damage.

You and your most trusted support ships will head to {Address} and neutralize any hostiles you find laying in wait there. They have been known to operate in smaller packs, so it's vital that you wait until all of the hostiles have been dealt with.

Your assistance is much appreciated,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Neutralize Outlaw Incursion
missions.desc:
HURSTON DYNAMICS OUTSOURCING
CONTRACT: Neutralize Hostile Force
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Dalik
RISK ASSESSMENT: High

Our security forces have been notified of an ongoing outlaw incursion at {Address}, and we are in need of an independent operator capable of clearing out the hostile actors.

According to onsite personnel, the outlaws are currently holed up near the {Location}. Approach with caution and be prepared to use lethal force if the outlaws resist being removed.

Payment will only be authorized once the location has been effectively cleared.

** The information transmitted may contain confidential and/or privileged material. Any review, retransmission, dissemination, or other use of or taking action in reliance upon this information by persons or entities other than the intended recipient is prohibited. **

missions.title: Opportunity for Independent Cargo Hauler
missions.desc:
Earning such accolades as 'Imperial Finances' Top 10 Shipping Companies' and 'Delivery Digest's 2945's Most Trusted Transport,' Covalex is busier than ever. And that means more cargo going to more places. That's where you come in.

Covalex is looking for dependable and industrious pilots to join our expanding family. Do you have access to a ship that can hold {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers? Can you pass an Advocacy background check if required? Then a universe of opportunity is waiting for you.

Simply complete an 'Evaluation Trial’ by picking up a shipment of {Item} from a freight elevator at {Address} and successfully delivering it to a freight elevator at {Address}.

Upon satisfactory completion, you'll be eligible to become part of Covalex Shipping's vast network of independent transport specialists*.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

*Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.title: Orange Level Contract: Potential Security Threat
missions.desc:
Several unknown ships have been spotted in areas frequented by haulers delivering goods for our client. They’re worried these ships are monitoring their haulers in preparation for an ambush, so they’ve hired us to patrol the area.

Start by going to the location marker on your HUD and scan it to ensure it’s clear. After that, we’ll send you to some other areas to scan for potential threats. We recommend that you bring a wingman and plenty of supplies to be ready to handle whatever might come your way.

Also know that successfully completing this contract will earn the main contractor a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.desc:
The folks at {Address} are under attack and need our support. Their ships in the wider area are being targeted and there’s a growing concern that this is only a precursor to something bigger.

The situation is evolving, but I’m being fed constant updates on what’s going on and will keep you informed as the contract progresses.

Are you available to come to their aid? Would be smart to recruit some friends to help. These are important clients and we can’t afford to fail them. The main contractor will earn a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip if you get the job done.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

missions.title: Orange Level Contract: Return the Favor
missions.desc:
Recently, a {AmbushTarget} baited Foxwell forces with a bogus rescue beacon. By the time our forces realized what was happening, a squad of ships unleashed a devastating attack and only one Foxwell contractor survived. Their scan logs identified the bait ship, and we’ve had scouts monitoring them ever since.

Our surveillance has revealed the squad has a regular flight pattern that we think we can exploit. There’s a sizable emission cloud at {Address} that makes it an ideal spot to post up. Think you have what it takes to handle this for us?

It’ll be you against the {AmbushTarget}, other large craft, and a sizable escort. Wish I could be more specific than that but this crew regularly rotates ships in and out of the squad. Would be smart to bring some support, so you don’t get overwhelmed by their numbers.

Complete the job and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton

The client wasn’t specific about the threats, but they don’t think everything’s on the level out there. Hopefully we’ll be able to bring them some peace of mind.

Additionally, the client arranged for us to offer a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip to the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton

missions.desc:
We’ve got clients reporting outlaw attacks on ships around {Address}. They got locked down tight and anybody heading in or out is a target. Any attempts to solve the issue have just been met with more outlaw reinforcements appearing.

The client is desperate for a solution, so we’re hiring a contractor to go and restore peace in the area. If any other issues flare up once you're there, I’ll comm you directions on how to help.

Really need someone on this fast. So to sweeten the pot, the main contractor will also get a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Looking for a contractor willing to hustle there, hide in the emission cloud, and then spring the trap when the time is right. There’s usually escort ships with the {AmbushTarget}. Careful not to jump the gun and blow your cover. The element of surprise is crucial from what I’ve read.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Good luck,

missions.title: Ownership Reassignment
missions.desc:
All right,

Over at {Address} there a few certain things they have in their possession that need to be liberated. Sure there may be a few guards or concerned individuals you’ll have to deal with, but for the most part it’s a relatively straight forward transaction – grab the stuff from the {Location} and take it to us at {Address}.

Sometimes simple is best.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Patrol Dangerous Outlaw Sector
missions.desc:
We’ve identified a sector that’s been increasingly riddled with outlaw attacks and we think that if we begin to actively patrol the area we can turn things around. We’d recommend gathering at least two wingmen to head out there in combat-ready ships and confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Patrol Dangerous Travel Lanes
missions.desc:
Outlaws have been increasing their activity along one of the more popular routes in the system and we’re hoping to provide a deterrent before the problem gets out of hand. As such, we’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and deal with any hostiles you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Patrol Extremely Dangerous Sector
missions.desc:
After weeks of seeing crime rates increase, we’ve been able to identify a sector that we believe to be the source of the outlaw activity that has been leeching into the surrounding areas. While it would be too much to expect to eradicate all threats, we believe that by sending combat patrols into the area we might be able to start reversing this worrisome trend. Our in-house combat analysts recommend bringing around three wingmen in combat-ready ships to confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Patrol Outlaw Hunting Grounds
missions.desc:
We’ve identified a sector that’s been plagued by outlaw attacks recently and hopefully, with your help, we can change that. We’d suggest bringing some backup in combat-ready ships to confront any hostile forces you might encounter.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Patrol Risky Travel Lanes
missions.desc:
We’ve noted an increase in traffic along one of the travel lanes we monitor. Chances are that we won’t be the only ones paying attention. I’d like you to head out there in a combat-ready ship and make sure there are no outlaws attempting to take advantage of this sense of security.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. After all of them have been secured, the main contractor will get a bonus of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Patrol Travel Lanes
missions.desc:
We need someone with combat experience to patrol a travel lane for us. Over the years, we’ve found that it's good to get out there and make ourselves visible. Sometimes a pilot like yourself traveling through an area is enough to deter any potential outlaws. But in case you run into any that are feeling a bit more ambitious, a ship ready for combat is recommended.

Once you’ve accepted this contract, make your way to the location marker on your HUD. After you’ve scanned all the waypoints and ensured that the route is secure, the main contractor will get a bonus of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Protect Site Trial Contract
missions.desc:
ATTN: Former Mercenary Operator

I’m aware that BlacJac stopped offering security work, but due to staffing changes it was decided to offer you another chance.

We’ve gotten word that {Address} needs some assistance dealing with a local outlaw gang. BlacJac is looking to have you go to the site and assist in eliminating this threat.

And since you’re already on thin ice as is, I don’t want to hear that you were involved in any friendly fire incidents.

If you’re able to pull this operation off, we can see about getting you reinstated.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Protecting outpost from XenoThreat
missions.desc:
XenoThreat forces launched an unprovoked attack near {Address}. We're looking for any available combat operators to go and provide support.

If you haven't dealt with them before, it's important to know that XenoThreat are trained fighters so this will not be an easy fight, but it's a necessary one.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Rally to Help Clips Convoy
missions.desc:
One of our Clips is in a tight spot. Just got a comm from ‘em saying their convoy is being swarmed by the People’s Alliance and they need help on the double. Well, they said it in a more colorful way than that. All I’ll say is that I don’t want to hear what they’ll say to me if they don’t survive and are forced to regen.

Situation must be serious if this Clip is freaking out. Really need you to get to {Address} immediately, and ensure that they make it out alive.

Stows out.

missions.title: Red Level Contract: Ambush Attack Squad
missions.desc:
Foxwell got word from an important client that outlaws have put together a squad that’s been stalking the system with sub-capital ships and escort fighters. Our client is concerned that if left unchecked, outlaws will create more of these attack squads and destabilize system security. We’ve been hired to wipe out this group before that happens.

We need a confident and skilled contractor for this task. Good news is that we have a plan in place. One of the ships used by this squad, a {AmbushTarget}, was stolen from our client, who’s still able to track its movements. They’ve shared the location data with us and we’ve discovered that this squad often goes by {Address}. We’ve scouted the location and discovered a large emission cloud makes an ideal spot for an ambush.

Not going to lie, this isn’t going to be easy. We don’t have any additional forces available to deploy, so it would be good to bring your own support.

You manage to pull this off, I've arranged for a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip for the main contractor.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement

missions.desc:
A client needs our help. Outlaws are roaming certain sectors where they do business and attacking anyone they come across. Our client has already lost several ships and can’t afford to lose anymore.

We need someone to patrol those areas and draw out any hostile forces. The job begins with you heading to the location marker on your HUD and scanning. Then we’ll share a handful of other patrol points for you to scan.

From the sound of it, these packs of ships feature skilled and aggressive pilots. Best be ready to rumble if you run into any of them. Would be good to have at least two trusted pilots by your side for this one.

At the end of a successful patrol, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Stay chilly,

Kevin Walton

Don’t mess this up. These clients are paying for and expecting top tier protection. If anything goes wrong, we could lose this contract. That’s why we’ll give the main contractor a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip if all goes down without a hitch.

Good luck,

missions.desc:
Need a battle-hardened pilot for an important patrol. A prominent client is fed up with outlaws targeting their ships and satellites. We’ve been hired to scan the areas in question and deal with any hostile forces. The patrol begins at the location marker on your HUD before moving to a number of other locations we’ll expect you to clear.

Not sure what you’ll run into out there, but based on intel shared by the client, they’re frequently seeing fighter groups of five to seven ships roaming the region. Some even have larger ships leading the charge. That means you better be ready for a serious fight. If you can, try to recruit at least three friends to the cause. Even a seasoned pilot will need all the help they can get against this crew.

Since this is going to be a tough one, the main contractor will get a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip at the end of the patrol.

Good luck,

missions.desc:
Looking for a consummate professional to handle a high-stakes job. We’ve got VIP clients at {Address} who are facing extremely aggressive and motivated outlaws targeting ships around their location. Exact details on the attack are still rolling in, but it appears to be a wide ranging, multi-pronged operation.

If you’re available, I highly recommend that you bring additional combat support ships, plenty of supplies, and your A-game. Get this right, and we’ll reward the main contractor with a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Good luck,

missions.desc:
We’ve received a handful of comms about recent attacks undertaken by an {AmbushTarget} and its escort ships. After opening a file, we started tracking the ship’s movements and noticed that it frequently passes an emission cloud near {Address}. We want to use that to our advantage to launch a surprise attack.

Once on site, you should hide in the emission cloud to cloak your signature enough to allow you to make the first strike. Unfortunately, Foxwell can’t provide additional reinforcements for this operation, so you’ll be responsible for bringing any support forces. You might need the help too. The crew of the {AmbushTarget} is aggressive and battle hardened.

You get this taken care of for us and there's a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip in it for the main contractor.

Good luck,

missions.title: Remove Hostile Force
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can quickly and safely assist us in the complete removal of the outlaw group who have temporarily gained control of the {Location} at {Address}.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Remove all members of the hostile outlaw force; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

missions.title: Remove Upstart Gang From Sector
missions.desc:
It feels that whenever we start to make real progress in the system, the outlaws are there to push one step back. We had recently cleared out {Address} only to learn that a new outlaw gang has taken root there, using it as a launching point for various criminal enterprises.

Since we can't afford to let this rot spread, you and a few support ships are being charged with heading there to clear out all the gang's packs. After you deal with one pack, be sure to wait until all of the hostile packs have been dealt with.

Know that you are helping to make a real difference,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Retrieval Op
missions.desc:
You got a ship and a heavy-duty tractor beam? Good. I’ve got work for you.

Don’t know how they knew we were coming, but one of my haulers got jumped over at {Address}. The pilot’s gone silent so I assume they’ve been ghosted, but the cargo tracker is stationary for now.

Expect the bastards who took out my pilot to still be around, so bring backup. Get the cargo and get out, don’t need to risk anymore good haulers on this mess.

Get the goods to the freight elevator to {Address} and I’ll send your payment.

-Twitch

missions.title: Salvage Wrecked Ships on the Drift
missions.desc:
Got word there’s a few ships near {Address} just floating all by their lonesome. It’s good salvage, but none of our crews have the time right now. We figured to give you first snap at it.

If you want the coords, we’ll sell them to you for a price. Then you’re free to pick the wreck as clean as you like and sell it all for a tidy profit. Now, you might run into some trouble out there from rival scavs, but I’m sure it won’t be anything you can’t handle.

- Smokey

missions.title: Scrap {TargetName}
missions.desc: I ain’t got time to waste so I’ll get straight to the point - {TargetName} needs to be dead and I want you to do it. You can find them over near the {Location} at {address}. They won’t be alone, but don’t get distracted by those other useless piles. You only get paid for taking out {Last}.

missions.title: Security Contractor Evaluation
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is in need of new, qualified, and detail-oriented security professionals to expand our existing roster. To evaluate your skills, we would like you to assist in protecting {Address} against hostile threats.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Help protect the site; using force as necessary.
• Avoid any friendly fire incidents.

• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

In an effort to reevaluate your skills, microTech Protection Services would like you to assist in protecting {Address} against hostile threats.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.

• Avoid any friendly fire incidents.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

missions.title: Settle a Score
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

One of our clients has been the victim of consistent harassment so the time has come to send a clear cease-and-desist message by taking out their prized {AmbushTarget}. The lowlife in question follows a fairly predictable routine making them susceptible to an ambush. We’ve identified {Address} as the ideal spot. It features an emission cloud where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting.

By the way, the {AmbushTarget} often flies alone but is sometimes joined by a friend in a single-seat ship. Neither should give you too much trouble, but we have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. There’s a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip in this for the main contractor too.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Ship In Distress
missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Ship In Distress

WORK BRIEF:
Got an urgent distress call from one of the Miners Amalgamated crews I sent out, saying they’re under attack by a gang that ambushed their ship.

I need you to rush down there, board the {Ship} and help protect my people out there.

Please let me know ASAP if you can help.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon elimination of all targets.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Special Covalex Delivery Stanton System
missions.desc:
Got a special assignment - Loads of packages ready to delivered across the system. Its a bit more than the usual so I'm only reaching out to my best contractors for this one.

Obviously, a part of that payment will be to cover your fuel because you'll be going super far with this one. You'll need all the usual as well like a handheld tractor beam and a ship with space to store {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

Good luck. I'm counting on you.

{SignOff}

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.title: Taking Back Our Goods
missions.desc:
Some upstarts hit my hauling crew on their way to do a delivery. Our tracker is telling us that our ship’s still located at {Address} so I need you to head over there and get the cargo. You’ll need a heavy-duty tractor beam to lug the goods from the ship.

I’d bet that whoever attacked us is still there waiting. Arm up, bring your crew, and if you can, give them one from me.

Once you’ve taken back our goods, drop it off at the freight elevator located at {Address}.

-Twitch

missions.title: Time to Teach a Lesson
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client of ours has been receiving anonymous threats in an attempt to blackmail them, and after a bit of leg work on our part, we’ve managed to trace it back to an individual who pilots a particular {AmbushTarget}. The client wants us to take care of this blackmailer before they have a chance to make good.

Based on our assessment, the target shouldn’t be too difficult to handle. They fly by {Address} on the regular, which has an emission cloud that’s an ideal spot to power down your ship and lie in wait. Sometimes the target is alone but they often travel with other single-seat ships as protection. Best be strategic when you launch your ambush or the {AmbushTarget} could have a chance to get away. We don’t want to lose this one. We’ll alert other contractors in the area of the ambush so they can come help once it pops off.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client has also added a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip for the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Tricky Ambush
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Ship Ambush
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Looking for a competent contractor who can recruit a wingman to help execute an ambush. The target is a {AmbushTarget} which has been involved in several operations against one of our most important clients. By neutralizing it once and for all, it’ll make our client’s life a hell of a lot easier. While the {AmbushTarget} is our focus, they usually don’t fly anywhere without a sizable escort, including large craft.

We’ve gotten word that this group will be passing by {Address} soon. Any chance you could hurry and beat them there? That spot has an emission cloud that you can power down your ship and hide in. Then when they pass, you should have the upper hand.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract. The client knows this one will be tough, so they threw in a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip that’ll go to the main contractor.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Up in Smoke
missions.desc:
We’ve been trying to access some sensitive data over at {Address} but there seems to only be one backdoor we can use. The issue is we need someone onsite to trigger it. And I really do mean trigger it.

If you can head over there and destroy part of their infrastructure, the emergency back up systems will kick online and we should be able to access everything we want.

Wish I could see the surprise look on the faces of the lowlifes running the place when it happens.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: URGENT: Boarding Action In Progress
missions.desc:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at {Location} and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard.

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters.

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a professional to eliminate several creatures of various species. This is a preventative measure to ensure their population size doesn’t increase beyond acceptable parameters.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation.
• Locate the target species on {Location}.

missions.title: Wipe Out XenoThreat Servers
missions.desc:
Something just fell into my lap that is way too good to pass up. XenoThreat's intelligence gathering is a bit of legend in the circles I run in and it turns out that they're storing a whole heap of their best intel at {Address}.

Would be a shame if someone, say like you, were to go there and blow it all up, huh?

-Stows out

missions.title: Yellow Level Contract: Ambush An Amateur
missions.desc:
Care to help us ghost a bad guy?

We’ve been hired to hunt down an outlaw flying a {AmbushTarget}. Shouldn’t be too hard since they take the same flightpath each day. That makes them a prime target for an ambush if I ever saw one. I’ve analyzed the route and determined that {Address} is the ideal spot to strike. There’s an emission cloud there that’ll be perfect to hide your ship’s signature while you wait.

Job is simple if you’re interested. Head to the location, hide out, power down, and then wait for them to fly by. Sometimes they roll alone but they often have other single-seat ships with them. Shouldn’t be too hard to handle for a pro. Plus, we’ll still have reinforcements nearby and ready to deploy once it pops off.

Pull this off and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Yellow Level Contract: Surprise Strike
missions.desc:
An outlaw who’s been on the run finally returned to the system. Seems like they hoped that disappearing for a bit would make us forget about them. They’re not even trying to hide their identity or vary their routine which means we know exactly where they’re going to be.

Latest intel indicates that they’re flying a {AmbushTarget} and will be passing by {Address} soon. I’ve already scoped out an emission cloud that’s a perfect place for you to find cover, power down your ship, and wait. Only real variable is if they’ll be alone or not. We’ve heard they sometimes roll with friends that all fly single-seaters. Landing that first surprise strike will be important as this crew is battle-tested, but we’ll have reinforcements at the ready to provide support if you need them.

Get this done and we'll give the main contractor a bonus payment of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Good luck,

missions.title: {Address} needs help
missions.desc:
We just received reports of a massive attack against {Location} by a large group of armed individuals led by {TargetName}, a notorious outlaw who has been threatening Citizens for Prosperity personnel for months. Details are still yet to be confirmed but we know there have been multiple casualties.

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any qualified security personnel to go and retake the outposts from these hostile elements. Our understanding is that {Last} tends to hide behind their soldiers, but will emerge if you take enough of the rank-and-file out.

While we don't like to resort to violence, management can see no other way of resolving this situation and continuing our good work in the system.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: {Location} has been greenlit
missions.desc:
Word came down from the Judge that we're to hit {Address}. It's owned by CFP and security there have been less than hospitable to some of the locals, so they gotta go.

They may talk a big game about bringing security, but they got guns and are more than happy to use 'em.

Stows out.

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: {TargetName} Reported Missing
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
After receiving a report that {TargetName} has been missing, microTech Protection Services is seeking a qualified contractor to begin an onsite search of {Address} to learn their current whereabouts. The missing individual was last seen entering the {Location} so it's recommended to begin the search there.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {address}.
• Confirm the location of {TargetName} and if they are still alive.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years security experience.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with conducting missing person investigations.

missions.title: {TargetName} Whereabouts Unknown
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is seeking a qualified contractor to assist in the search for {TargetName} who was last seen near the {Location} at {Address} but who's current whereabouts are unknown.

Our preliminary investigation has led us to suspect foul play may be behind their disappearance. As such, heightened caution is advised as there may be hostile actors involved.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {address}.
• Confirm the location of {TargetName} and if they are still alive.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years security experience.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with conducting missing person investigations.
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.title: {TargetName}’s Time Has Come
missions.desc:
We’ve had our sights set on taking out {TargetName} for a while now, but we’ve never been able to find the right moment. Enough waiting. You’re going to create the right moment for us.

Head to {Address} and take out a bunch of lowlifes running around the {Location}. Kill enough of those losers, and {Last} will have no choice but to come face you themselves. That’s when you take ‘em out and earn yourself a nice fat payday.

missions.title: A Batch from Scratch
missions.desc:
Normally, I like to cook everything from scratch myself. Pride in product and all. But every once in a while, whether it's too much demand or too much heat or whatever, I need to rely on other labs for an order.

My hands are tied up here though, so I could use someone to help oversee the whole production line for me. Couldn't think of anyone better and more available than you.

{Itinerary}

Just don't get distracted in the middle and wander off. It happens more often than you'd think. Manage to finish the full list, and I'll see to it you get nice cut of the profits.

-Wallace

missions.title: A little retaliation
missions.desc:
Been getting word that CFP security have been getting a little more aggressive and started pushing people out of the homes they've built out of the scrap in the system and they want payback, so they came to us.

Head out to {Address} and clear out the CFP there. Should be pretty cut and dry with a nice payday.

Stows out.

missions.title: A Mother's Plea
missions.desc:
My son Nico was sadly among the victims of the tragic accident at Covelex's Gundo station and they still haven't returned all of his personal possessions to me. I understand that they have to do things according to regulations, but it seems unconscionable that they wouldn't make some allowances for the grieving family members. To that end, I'm seeking someone who will be able to go to the station for me. To be clear, Gundo is currently considered off limits, meaning that this would not be above board, but I feel my situation warrants special consideration. My sister says that the rate I am offering is the correct amount for retrieving the crate with Nico's belongings (#964) and bringing them to {Destination}, so hopefully I can find a competent individual to settle this matter quickly.

Sincerely,
Gloria Theolone

missions.title: A Swift Reprisal
missions.desc:
Hey,

Some two-bit thugs are holed up in {Address}. Wouldn’t pay them any mind, except the arrogant skags tried to hit an outpost under our protection.

We chased 'em off with little trouble, but we can't let that kind of disrespect go unpunished. Our Clips are busy with some bigger fish, so we'd like you to take care of this for us.

Stows out.

Since you've been doing so much work helping out the Defense Division I wanted to come to you with this contract direct. It's a bit of a delicate one. Two VIPs fell ill and the worry was that if word got out they were being transported they would become major targets.

Unfortunately, it seems that's exactly what happened. Our attempts to smuggle them from Nyx to Stanton for medical treatment have failed, and now the ship carrying them is under attack.

We need you to hurry to {Address}, neutralize the attackers and ensure that the cryopods make it safely to the freight elevator at {Address}.

In fact, I want you to make sure you have a ship that can carry the cryopods just in case their original transport is too damaged to go on.

I sincerely hope you manage to pull this rescue mission off.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Alliance Aid: Vital Package Retrieval
missions.desc:
ATTENTION ALL FTL COURIERS
FOR IMMEDIATE ASSIGNMENT

**CONTRACT DETAILS**

PICKUP LOCATION – An FTL ship carrying a delivery for Alliance Aid has not completed it's contract. The last known location has it still over at {Address}. A courier needed to retrieve package and continue delivery.

DROPOFF LOCATION – Package must be taken to {Address}.

THREAT LEVEL – It is unclear what happened to the ship, but we expect a malfunction. Still, caution is advised. Low level engagements expected.

TRAVEL – All transportation needs should be arranged by courier.

FTL Courier Services is proud to be assisting in Alliance Aid efforts to help fight the Levski outbreak.

missions.title: Ambush XenoThreat Strike Wing
missions.desc:
Been handed some strong intel on a XenoThreat strike wing's flightpath. Looking for contractors who can dust off now and be set up at {Address} ahead of them. Local conditions will mask your scanner signatures so you can give them the surprise of their lives. Let's turn the hunters into the hunted.

Interested?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Another Attempt at Red Wind Delivery

variants.title: Another Attempt at Red Wind Delivery

missions.title: Another Chance to Impress
missions.desc:
It is not often in life that we get another chance to make a first impression, but I am going to provide to you with just that.

To say I was disappointed in how things last transpired on your last assassination attempt would be a severe understatement. However, here is your chance to prove yourself capable of more.

Kill {TargetName} over at {Address} and I will consider the slate wiped clean.

Sincerely,
Vaughn

missions.title: Armor with horn and string
missions.desc:
Hello, know many humans want saldynium for regen problem. Credits good, yes, but Wikelo can use that, kopion horn, and other things to make special armor.

Once done, you be very tough. Very scary.

You see items needed. Bring to {ListAll} and I make for you.

Bye.

missions.title: Armor with Vanduul
missions.desc:
Vanduul have strange ways. I never talk to them, old souli used to, but not Wikelo. Anyway, though not friendly, they make interesting thing. If you like, Wikelo can make you look more like.

Bring things. Will do.

Bye.

missions.title: Asgard Fight Mod
missions.desc: Wikelo mod Asgard and so that it fights more. You in a fight, this mod is what you want. Plus, good deal on the trade. Just bring items here and I give you the ship.

missions.desc:
HURSTON DYNAMICS
OUTSOURCING DEPARTMENT

CONTRACT: Facility Protection
CONTRACTOR AFFILIATION: Independent
OUTSOURCE MANAGER: T. Spooner
RISK ASSESSMENT: High
RUSH CONTRACT: No

The security personnel at {Address} is being threatened by a local criminal element and Hurston Security is seeking contractors to bolster their defenses and eliminate any hostiles who attempt to breach the site.

Note that you are only cleared to engage with confirmed hostiles. Assaulting any security personnel at the site will result in a breach of contract.

Payment will be sent once the facility is confirmed to be safe.

missions.title: Assist People's Alliance Vessel Tranquility
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat Ready
Briefing:
An Idris-class People's Alliance security vessel named Tranquility is currently engaged with a Vanduul capital ship near an old QV Extraction station and Intersec is looking for combat pilots to lend some support.

Scramble to the AO and engage Vanduul fighters so the Tranquility can focus on the capital ship.

Good luck,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

missions.title: Assistance needed at {Location}
missions.desc:
We received a distress call from {Address} saying that they're being robbed by a small group of outlaws. {CaveSize} Though remote, this outpost is a crucial piece of CFP's infrastructure in the area so we need to take it back.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Attack on CFP outpost
missions.desc:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available combat operators to {Address}. A group of outlaws have launched an unprovoked attack and our security personnel are desperately in need of support.

Please dispatch to {Location} with all urgency and good luck.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval Very Dangerous

WORK BRIEF:
There's been another attack out at {Location}. Whoever did it killed the entire crew in the ambush. The Governing Committee wants answers so we're looking for someone to head out there, retrieve the blackbox and deliver it {Destination}. Make sure you bring a ship with some storage to hold the blackbox.

Be incredibly careful. They said it was a large group that attacked them, and I'd be they're still in the area.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger
missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Blackbox Retrieval w/Danger

WORK BRIEF:
We had another ship attacked out near {Location} and received conflicting reports about who did the ambush, so we're looking to hire someone to fly out and retrieve the blackbox. Last thing we want to do is blame the wrong people. You should be able to carry it, but you'll need a ship with some storage.

Just be careful, there's a real good chance the ambushers are still there waiting for someone to claim it.

If you're able to get it, deliver the blackbox to {Destination} and we'll get you paid.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon delivery

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Block XenoThreat Expansion
missions.desc:
XenoThreat are on the warpath right now. They’ve launched simultaneous attacks on several Headhunters sites and stretched our fighters thin. Got word they’re planning to storm {Address} next, and we can’t get anyone there to defend it.

I’m looking to pay someone to pull together a crew, gather supplies, and mount a strong defense for us. Gonna be honest with you, this is shaping up to be a hell of a fight. Xenos are sending some of their most experienced forces there. Not much else I can say except that they’ll probably stagger the arrival of their forces, wipe them all out and you’ll be paid handsomely.

Think you can rise to the occasion?

-Stows

missions.title: Blow Up XenoThreat Fuel Reserves
missions.desc:
It seems that XenoThreat has gotten the same intel we did and are looking to pull off the same job as us.

I want you to knock the competition out of the picture. Go to {Address} and take out the fuel tanks they got there.

Then my people can finish up without worrying about XenoThreat crashing the party.

-Stows out

missions.title: Bounty Apprehension Reevaluation
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
While your past performance has not been to our standards, microTech Protection Services has decided to offer you a chance to redeem yourself.

To reevaluate your skills, we would like you to apprehend {TargetName} from {Address}.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Neutralize {TargetName}; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• Bounty Hunters Guild membership and appropriate certification.
• Access to vehicle suitably outfitted for combat.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Ability to handle high pressure situations.

missions.title: Breach and Steal
missions.desc:
Hey there.

Nine Tails got themselves a little problem. As it turns out, they got a little side biz in the underground organ trade. Now that an area I generally like to steer well clear of, but a gig’s a gig, right? It seems that one of their mobile butcher shops aboard the 'October Rising' got pinched by private security while out chopping. Now the Nine Tails are willing to cut ties with the ship and its crew (who are probably all dead anyway), but they need a particular crate extracted. Guess it was a special order or something.

Anyway, get aboard the October Rising, get the package, and get out.

Security’s still hanging around so watch yourself and maybe bring some friends, but remember, your priority is the package. If you're looking to save yourself some extra hassle, you could also black out the area by shutting down the nearest comm array if you want to avoid the crimestats for, you know, killing a bunch of a security. But hey, you do you.

Once you’re out, drop the package off at the clinic on Grim HEX and I’ll sort your payment.

Easy peasy,

Ruto

missions.title: Build a Mod Scorpius
missions.desc: Don't know what the name mean, but ship is very fast, very good in fight. With tweak, can better. You see list of what Wikelo need, go get and I make. Bye.

missions.title: Campaign to reclaim XenoThreat outposts
missions.desc:
Although Citizens for Prosperity is committed to change through non-violent means, it's become apparent that exceptions might have to be made. CFP safe zones near {Address} were recently and violently taken by XenoThreat forces under the command of {TargetName}.

We're looking for any available combat operatives to help take these outposts back. This will undoubtedly be a difficult endeavor as XenoThreat are highly trained and eager to fight, so you should prepare accordingly.

Aside from clearing each cluster of XenoThreat forces, you will need to take out {Last}, who's loss will certainly make the system safer.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Capture Arlington Gang Leader Maltrox Arlington
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Group Warrant
CONTRACTOR STATUS: Independent
Approval code: = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

*********
__Background Information__
A group warrant has been issued for the notorious Arlington ship jacking gang after their recent brazen attempted theft of an Idris from a repair yard. While the heist was stopped, the members of the group have scattered to the black. Eckhart Security has been granted the bounty for the immediate capture of all high-level gang members: Maltrox Arlington, Kass Dent, Nicks Cantwell, Sam ‘Weepy’ Arlington, Oslo Arlington, and Les Arlington.
*********

Maltrox Arlington has been keeping a low profile recently, but we think he's come out of hiding. A patrol was refueling at a station when one of their ships was boosted. Maltrox is the most likely suspect. While the regtag was temporarily deactivated, we have been able to trace the ship’s quantum signature and have provided you those coordinates.

A third generation criminal, the Arlington gang has been under Maltrox’s leadership for the past six years. Be aware, this is a smart, aggressive, and very dangerous target. The more resources you can bring to bear, the more likely it is that we can bring Maltrox in one and for all.

You are authorized to use whatever force is necessary to neutralize the target.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Cargo Hauling Opportunity with Ling Hauling
missions.desc:
Hi,

This is Petra Ling, and I’m proud to offer you a new and exciting opportunity to partner with Ling Family Hauling. When my parents started this company, their goal was to provide fast and reliable courier deliveries around the greater Crusader area. It quickly became a success, and as our reputation grew, so did our operations.

Now, under my stewardship, Ling Family Hauling is taking the next big step – cargo hauling. Demand for this new service is growing faster than I expected, and that’s great news for both of us.

If you’ve ever wanted to be a hauler, then I can make your dreams come true. Best way to learn something is by doing it, and I’ve got a haul of {Item} that needs to go from {Address} to {Address}.

No prior experience is necessary, but here’s a few things to keep in mind. All pick-ups and deliveries must be done at a freight elevator or autoloaded. You will need a ship that can hold {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers, and a handheld tractor beam to move them around.

Upon successful completion of this delivery, you will be promoted to a ‘trusted contractor’ status and more hauls will become available to you.

Sincerely,
Petra Ling
Managing Director of Cargo Operations
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

If you feel like kicking some ass, grab the cargo from the freight elevator at {Address} and deliver it to the freight elevator at {Address}.

missions.title: Cargo Shipment Must Be Completed
missions.desc:
More and more CFP ships are being targeted lately, and despite our best efforts to keep our trading routes quiet, we're still losing haulers to outlaw attacks.

Our pilot over at {Address} is the latest casualty. It pains me to think about how much we've lost, but as long as there are people who need our help, we have to keep on fighting.

If you have a ship that can carry {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam, we need you to head to the above location and recover that cargo.

This won't be easy, the pilot was one of our best and wouldn't go down without a fight. Let's not underestimate these outlaws, bring a trustworthy crew and watch each other's backs.

Once you've got the cargo, deliver it to the freight elevator at {Address} and I'll get it processed.

Good luck and take care,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.desc:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for a final assault on the XenoThreat outlaw pack that have been plaguing Stanton System. The Navy has officially requested for any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

missions.title: CDF ALERT: Xenothreat Ambush - Support Needed
missions.desc:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, XenoThreat forces started to ambush Naval convoy ships transporting vital supplies while en route to Jericho station at the Pyro Gateway in the Stanton System. The Navy has requested CDF forces to help recover these supplies from the wreckage and safely deliver them to Jericho.

The Navy has organized a community stipend to handle the distribution of payment. This will be distributed among all CDF volunteers at assigned intervals. An indicator will appear on your HUD to measure these payouts.

Please note that some of these supplies are highly volatile if not handled correctly. Use caution while transporting these materials:
* Zeta-Prolanide degrades over time until breaking down completely.
* AcryliPlex Composite becomes explosively unstable if damaged.
* Diluthermex releases a destructive energy pulse if exposed to quantum travel.

Additionally, while not as volatile, the supplies of DynaFlex lost during the attack are still urgently needed by the Navy to complete their repairs of the Javelin and should be a priority for recovery.

Also, XenoThreat hostiles might still be in the area so be careful. CDF volunteers with combat experience are also urged to contribute by securing these areas from lingering XenoThreat forces.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.
