missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #1
missions.desc:
Looking to gain critical hands-on experience battling a variety of targets and situations? Then my Combat Gauntlet might be the perfect fit for you.

Please understand that this course is intended for pilots who have already mastered flying basics and are ready to take their abilities to the next level. If you’re starting off and want to learn the ropes, I’d recommend logging some hours in an Arena Commander simpod. But for those ready to face a real challenge, I firmly believe that students learn best by doing.

That’s why I’ve designed these eight scenarios to be as realistic as possible. I promise you this is the closest thing to Navy combat pilot training you can get without enlisting, so don’t expect a lot of hand holding. The risk of injury to yourself or your ship should be taken very seriously.

GAUNTLET SCENARIOS:
1. Single Targets
2. Multiple Targets
3. Target Priority
4. Target Stealth
5. Missiles and Countermeasures
6. Multi-Crew Targets
7. Corvette with Escorts
8. Capital Ship Encounter

So, if you’re ready to challenge yourself and prove you got what it takes to be a great pilot, the first scenario will focus on handling a single target. Head to {Address} to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Situational Awareness – Don’t get so focused on taking a target that you aren’t watching your flight path. No good taking out the enemy if you fly headfirst into an asteroid.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #2
missions.desc:
Congrats on completing part one of this eight-part course.

Scenario two will focus on how to deal with multiple targets at the same time. Goal here is give you a better handle on how to balance offense and defense.

Whenever you’re set, grab a combat ship, and head to {Address} to begin.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Pick Your Fight - For situations where you’re coming up against multiple targets of equal threat, your best strategy is to focus on neutralizing one target at a time to gradually reduce the amount of incoming fire.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #3
missions.desc:
Congrats on completing part two of this eight-part course.

The third scenario throws tactical considerations into the mix. This time around the attacking ships are from distinct classes with distinct battlefield applications. Knowing what targets to prioritize is vital to surviving engagements against multiple ships.

Whenever you’re ready, head to {Address} to get started.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Bigger They Are – Try to evaluate which threat is the most dangerous and take them out first.
- Shields – If you’re taking a lot of damage, don’t be afraid to boost away and let your shields regenerate.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #4
missions.desc:
Congrats on completing part three of this eight-part course.

Good combat pilots know not all threats are apparent. It’s the threats you don’t expect that can be the most devastating. Scenario four is focused on how to identify and deal with stealth targets. Hopefully by the end, you’ll understand just how important your radar is in determining who you’re really up against. Expect to have regular and stealth ships hunting you down.

Make your way to {Address} whenever you’re ready, and remember to keep your eyes on your radar.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Surprise Attacks - Pinging your surroundings can sometimes reveal hidden ships. Be ready for contacts to show up unexpectedly.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #5
missions.desc:
Congrats on completing part four of this eight-part course.

The fifth scenario focuses on defensive tactics. Knowing when to take evasive measures and deploy either decoys or noise countermeasures is essential to your survival. That’s why the aggressors in this exercise will be armed with missiles.

Ensure your countermeasures are fully stocked and then go to {Address} to start.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Ready to Launch - Easy access to your decoys and countermeasures can be critical in your success in dealing with incoming missile fire.
- Stand and Fight - Resist the temptation to hit the afterburner to escape as you’ll increase your signature and make it easier for the missile to hit you. They’re almost certainly much faster than you anyway.
- Close the Gap – While it may seem counterintuitive, getting closer to an enemy ship can be an advantage. Missiles have a minimum range and if you’re inside of it they won’t be able to get a lock on you.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #6
missions.desc:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.

I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.

Find your way to {Address} whenever you're ready.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #7
missions.desc:
Congrats on completing part six of this eight-part course.

You’ve gained a lot of experience across the past six scenarios, and now it’s time to put it all to practice. Scenario seven puts you up against a corvette-class ship and its escorts. This extended encounter will push you to the limit and test everything you got.

The only thing left is to understand the limit of your skillset. To put it simply, you can’t do everything yourself. Developing and maintaining relationships with fellow pilots that you can call upon for support is really the last piece of the puzzle. Not saying you can't overcome encounters like this by yourself, but even the Navy doesn’t send their ace pilots on a patrol alone.

Once you decided whether to do this alone or call in some support, head over to {Address} to kick off the encounter.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Strength in Diversity – Think about the roles your allies will be filling and choose who to bring carefully to help balance strengths and weaknesses. You’ll want ships capable of taking on the Corvette while others deal with the escort.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Gauntlet - Scenario #8
missions.desc:
Welcome to the final scenario of the Combat Gauntlet.

Throughout this course, you’ve gotten to experience the advanced combat and defensive tactics needed to survive a variety of encounters. Time to take all those new skills and knowledge and see how they hold up against a large capital vessel and some escort ships.

You know the drill by now. Once you and all your allies are set, find your way to {Address} to see how you do when truly pushed to the limits.

As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

TRICKS OF THE TRADE
- Patience is a Virtue – If you’ve balanced your squadron properly, you should be able to come out on top, just don’t expect it to be a quick fight. Ships this big don’t go down quickly.

Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly

ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”

missions.title: Combat Support: {Location}
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Clear Location
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Urgent request came in from Associated Science & Development to provide combat support at {Location}. Apparently they have been attacked by outlaws and their security forces have been unable to handle it on their own.

You've been cleared to go on site and aide local security elements in taking out the outlaws, but ASD reserves the right to restrict you from certain areas.

This is a confirmed combat op, so prepare accordingly.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Come to Aid of Convoy
missions.desc:
I’m getting reports that a Citizens for Prosperity convoy carrying vital supplies is currently under attack at {Address}. It’d be a big blow to our operations if we lost that cargo.

If you’ve got the combat skills to go up against highly aggressive hostiles, we’re more than willing to pay for your help.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Convoy Caught in Brutal Attack
missions.desc:
We just received word that a convoy of Citizen for Prosperity affiliated ships have been targeted by outlaws and that our people are in dire need of assistance.

If you are available, we need combat ready pilots at {Address} to defend our people. Note that at this dire time, we cannot afford even a single lost ship and expect with your assistance for all of our people make it out alive.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Coordinated Takedown
missions.desc:
Interesting assignment came my way. I need two separate targets taken out: {TargetName} and {TargetName2}

Problem is, either one gets word about the other being hit, they’ll go to ground. Can’t risk losing either of them.

It’ll take considerable coordination, but I want you to hit them both at the same exact time.

And since you can’t be in two places at once, you’ll need to find someone you can trust to help on this.

Thankfully, my intel says that both the targets should be traveling alone. That should help make things a bit easier on you.

missions.title: Covalex Evaluation
missions.desc:
Hi there!

Covalex is currently on the lookout for new delivery contractors. To see if you're Covalex material or not, we've arranged for the below delivery route as evaluation of your skills.

PACKAGE FOR PICK UP
· Package #{SerialNumber} from {Address}

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Package #{SerialNumber} to {Address}

Successfully completing this run will certify you as an official Covalex contractor.

By the way, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.

{SignOff}

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. By accepting this contract, you are agreeing to all terms and conditions as outlined in our extended 'Independent Workers Supplemental Information Guide v.2948.01.29.' Covalex Shipping is not responsible for any damages that occur while operating as an independent contractor.

missions.title: Covalex Re-evaluation
Crew Hasn’t Checked In
missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Crew Hasn’t Checked In

WORK BRIEF:
Just got word that one of the mining teams is unaccounted for. They were supposed to be back hours ago, but no one’s heard from them. Family have tried to reach out but haven’t gotten a response from anyone on the crew.

I can send you their last known location, so we’re looking for someone to go check in and see if they’re okay. If the worst happened, please identify anyone you find. I’m sure the families would appreciate some closure on what happened.

Thanks

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Crucial Supplies Need Retrieving
missions.desc:
We were in the process of delivering an urgent shipment to the folks over at {Address} when our pilot ran into a group of outlaws. They tried to run, but it was already too late.

There is silver lining though. The trackers are showing the cargo is still intact, located at {Address}. There's a good chance the outlaws are guarding it while they locate a ship big enough to transport everything. While I don't want to risk losing another pilot, the need of the cargo aboard is desperate enough that it justifies the decision to send someone to recover it.

This won't be easy, these outlaws showed our pilot no mercy. You'll need to take them out first before getting the cargo back. Bring a ship that can store {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam for the moving. Deliver it to the freight elevator at {Destination} and let's make this right.

Fly safe,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Cull Invasive Creatures
missions.desc:
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists are dedicated to keeping the delicate ecosystems of the empire in balance. A client recently hired us to evaluate the environmental impact of a number of invasive creatures near {Location}. We’ve determined that to preserve the natural order of the region a conscientious culling of these species is necessary.

Looking for someone able and willing to help in this effort. Please refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal for further information on the creatures being targeted.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.title: Cull Irradiated Kopions
missions.desc:
As a consequence of the ongoing radiation storm on Pyro I, some of the invasive kopions have become irradiated. This poses a threat to the health of the indigenous wildlife and to those who live and work in {Location}.

We are seeking out a skilled contractor who can cull any irradiated kopions in and around {Address}. Do not accept this contract unless you have the proper weapons and equipment that can reliably function in a radioactive environment.

Your compensation will be adjusted to match the risks associated with this contract.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.title: Curious Weapon
missions.desc:
Wikelo find very strange but functional weapon while wandering through your systems. It very simple but very effective. If you bring me things, I show you what I do to it.

Very fun.

missions.title: Cut Citizens For Prosperity Power
missions.desc:
We got big plans about to go down but unfortunately Citizens for Prosperity have people nearby at {Address}.

Since I can't afford to have those bastards cockin' things up for us, I want you to go there and take out their power generators.

Should keep them sidelined until we're done with our business.

-Stows out

missions.title: Dangerous Take
missions.desc:
I was hopin’ you’d be interested in pulling a little job for us. Got some goods over at {Address} that are just right for the taking. Only problem is – and it’s a big one – the bastards running the place have the whole area rigged with proximity mines.

You’ll need to find someway through, or if you can’t be bothered, someway to trigger the lot. Either way, just try not to blow yourself up. Then you just need to grab the stuff and take it over to {Address}.

It won’t be easy to pull off, but if you do, I promise I’ll make it worth your while.

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - {ReputationRank} Rank - {CargoGradeToken} Cargo Haul
missions.desc:
One of our best distributors got busted in Stanton so we need a replacement. The guy was an incredible salesman, but a shit smuggler. We need someone who won't run face-first into a security patrol or a pack of pirates to pick up some merchandise at these locations:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

{MultiToSingleToken}

And bring it all to {Address} before security catches on to what's happening. You'll need enough space on your ship for size {MissionMaxSCUSize} containers, and a handheld tractor beam should make loading and unloading nice and easy.

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - {ReputationRank} Rank - {CargoGradeToken} Cargo Haul
missions.desc:
We've got a shipment of contraband that needs to be hauled to a couple of different places. If you like creds, head to {Address}, load everything up, and bring it to these drop points:

DROP OFF LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

{SingleToMultiToken}

You're gonna need a handheld tractor beam to move the boxes and enough room in your cargo hold for size {MissionMaxSCUSize} containers.

Avoid other ships if you can. Security will bust you if they figure out what you're hauling, and raiders will just take it for themselves.

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - Trial Cargo Haul
missions.desc:
Call me Twitch. I run the Dead Saints.

I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling.

I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one.

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers, and you'll need a handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from {Address} to {Address} without getting security involved.

If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line.

-Twitch

missions.title: DEAD SAINTS - Trial Cargo Haul
missions.desc:

Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers, and you'll need a handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from {Address} to {Address} without getting security involved.

If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line.

-Twitch

missions.title: Deadly Combination
missions.desc:
{TargetName} and {TargetName2}.

Two serious operators who've recently decided to make a move against their boss. Each of the pair are traveling with a small, highly trained armada and cutting deep into territory that doesn't belong to them.

You, and whoever you recruit to help, are going to take them out and it has to be both at the same time so they can't regroup.

missions.title: death do us part
missions.desc:
It's pretty touching when you run across a pair that's willing to die for one another. Stupid but touching.

{TargetName} and {TargetName2} chose to stand by each other and now its gone and got them dead.

Find a friend of your own and hunt each of these two down. Make sure you kill them at the same time. Call it poetic justice.

They should die pretty easy. Maybe they'll have a ship or two with them but I don't think it'll be anything to worry about.

missions.title: Defend {Location} from Outlaws
missions.desc:
We learned that {Address} is under threat of attack by outlaws and has asked for assistance. We need someone to protect them and drive away the outlaws.

Make sure you stay close after their initial attack. Too often, outlaws win fights just by sending more bodies than anyone can reasonably defend against, so make sure you fight off any reinforcements before leaving the area.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Defend {Location} from Outlaws
missions.desc:

missions.title: Defend InterSec Operative
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: Require urgent assistance for an InterSec operative who is currently under fire at {Address}.

A group of outlaws had previously taken our operative captive with the intention of extracting sensitive information from them, but miraculously they were able to escape. Unfortunately, the pursuing outlaws now have them pinned down.

Due to the number of the ships assaulting them, we're offering additional compensation to accommodate the added danger. Recruiting additional ships to support you in this mission is highly advised.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

missions.title: Defend Location Against Minor Threats
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can assemble a security team in order to protect {Address} against any minor threats.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Provide own security team to assist.
• Protect the site against hostile threats; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with managing a team.

missions.title: Defend Location Against Moderate Threats
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can assemble a security team in order to protect {Address} against hostile threats.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Provide own security team to assist.
• Protect the site against hostile threats; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with managing a team.

missions.title: Defend Location Against Serious Threats
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can assemble a security team in order to protect {Address} against serious hostile threats.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Provide own security team to assist.
• Protect the site against hostile threats; using force as necessary.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with managing a team.

missions.title: Defend Occupants
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services is looking for a detail-oriented mercenary professional who can quickly and safely assist the security team stationed at {Address} in protecting the site against hostile threats.

Be aware that any friendly fire, accidental or otherwise, will not be tolerated.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation to {Address}.
• Help the local security team protect the site; using force as necessary.
• Avoid any friendly fire incidents.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 2 years of combined mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment and mode of transport.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with rapid hostility de-escalation techniques.

missions.title: Defend Site From Dangerous Threat
missions.desc:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

I’ve received a report that some operators are planning on making a move against {Address}. BlacJac wants you to put a team together and defend the site from this dangerous threat.

It is strongly recommended that you do not attempt to do this contract solo. Hiring a team of skilled mercenaries to provide support would be the smartest route.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Defend Site From Minor Threat
missions.desc:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

One of the sites under BlacJac’s purview has been clashing with a few local outlaws. We would like you to head down to {Address} and secure the site from these hostile threats.

From the early reports, I expect this will be a fairly straightforward matter, but if it makes you feel better, feel free to recruit a team to provide you with extra support.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Defend Site From Threat
missions.desc:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

We’ve gotten word that some local muscle have been making threats against {Address}. BlacJac is looking to have you put a team together and protect the site from these hostile threats.

And as much as we all love credits, I don’t recommend trying to do this one solo. Hiring a team to come along would be beneficial to your livelihood.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Delicate Dealings
missions.desc:
I’m really hoping you’re going to agree to do this since there doesn’t seem to be too many folks eager to take on a whole bunch of proximity mines. See, there’s a score that we’ve sourced at {Address} but the physical security is proving more difficult than expected.

If you can find a way to navigate through the mines or possibly a way to trigger them remotely, it should be relatively easy to grab the goods and make your way out of there. Drop them off at {Address} and you’ll get more than your fair cut of the credits for taking on the risk.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Deliver a Message
missions.desc:
Surprise, surprise. Seems like not everyone’s happy that the Headhunters are making inroads in Stanton. One crew in particular has been hitting our people and then scurrying back to {Address}.

Want you to go there and give ‘em a taste of their own medicine. Removing these lickboots should send a pretty clear message about what happens if you screw with us.

Stows out.

missions.title: Delivery for {Destination} Ready
missions.desc:
Hi,

Got word folks are waiting for an important supply shipment that’s not arrived. Turns out it accidently got taken to the wrong place. While we look into how the mistake happened, we need someone to head over to {Address} to pick up package #{serialnumber} and deliver it to the correct location at {Address}.

Also, to make your life easier, I'd make sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you.

You available for the run?

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Delivery Pilot for Covalex
missions.desc:
Hello there,

I have a delivery I need taken care of. The order is waiting at {Address} to be taken to {Address}.

I’m sure you’ll be fine, but for full disclosure, I’m seeing a bunch of security warnings pop up for this area. Seems there have been a handful of attacks in that area in the last few days. Now, I’m not saying you’ll run into anything, but it would probably be best if you brought along a bit of protection.

Good luck,

Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

missions.title: Destroy Dangerous Drugs
missions.desc:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

Some enterprising chemists have cooked up a new product that is twice as potent and twice as deadly as the normal stuff. We were able to trace some samples back to the source over at {Address}.

BlacJac wants you to head down ASAP to destroy the entire batch before it can hurt any more of the population. We can worry about making arrests later.

From everything we know about this crew, you should expect to meet heavy resistance while attempting to clear out the stash.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Destroy Deadly Contraband
missions.desc:
A fledgling syndicate have set up shop over at {Address} and have been trying their hand at cracking into the drug market. Unfortunately, their product has been linked to several deaths in and around Crusader. With how potent this stuff is, it’s posing a serious threat to the public.

Crusader is working to take down the whole operation, but as long as their product is circulating, the bodies are starting to pile up.

We want you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there before they get a chance to sell it. However, you should expect their stash to be extremely well guarded.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Destroy Illegal Drugs
missions.desc:
We’ve discovered that a group is trying to start up their own drug business over at {Address}. While they seem to be your average low-level thugs, the product they’re producing is toxic and responsible for the deaths of multiple civilians, so we can’t afford to allow any more to be sold.

We’re are working on a larger operation that will shut them down for good, but in the meanwhile we need to stop the flow of their drugs. That’s why Crusader wants you to go the site and destroy the stash they have there.

They will undoubtedly have guards protecting the stash, but I don’t expect them to be too much of a threat.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Destroy Outlaw Data Servers
missions.desc:
Citizens for Prosperity have been monitoring a very dangerous outlaw group at {Address} and we believe that they are in midst of planning a major attack which could throw the whole system into upheaval.

In order to protect all the progress we've made here, we would like you to raid their compound and destroy all the servers housing their plans.

This should at least provide us with enough of a reprieve for them to reconsider their offensive.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Data Servers
missions.desc:
One of the Citizens for Prosperity members who have been serving as a XenoThreat informer has let us know that the data servers located at {Address} our housing a trove of information vital to the gang's operation.

If you were able to destroy these servers on our behalf it would be a huge win for the security of the entire system.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Destroy XenoThreat Fuel Reserves
missions.desc:
I won't get into the long and complicated politics of why I'm asking you to do this, but it's enough for you to know that I want it done.

Go to {Address} and blow up the XenoThreat fuel reserves there. It'll really be helping me out of a tight spot.

-Stows

missions.title: Disable Headhunter Comm Towers
missions.desc:
Violence is never our first choice, but sometimes it must be used as a preventative measure.

We’re planning a strike on a Headhunter controlled outpost and need your help.

We need to make sure that if something goes wrong they won’t be able to call for backup and escalate the situation. That’s where you come in. We need you to head over to {Address} and disable the communication towers. There should be a control panel located at the top of each tower that you can use to deactivate them.

If you’re able to do this, Citizens for Prosperity will be able to gain some vital ground in Pyro.

It’s also worth keeping in mind for future contracts that you can choose to take out the comms towers instead of risking a fight with reinforcement dropships.

Stay alert and stay safe.

Thank you,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Divide and Conquer
missions.desc:
Normally, the pair of {TargetName} and {TargetName2} would be too much to take on together. They both are about as good as it gets when it comes to dogfighting and the crew they fly with are almost as good.

But recently they split - not sure why - and are flying separate for the moment. Someone thinks this may be the best chance to take them out.

Gather some personnel you can trust and plan a simultaneous raid against both targets. It's too dangerous to risk one of them living after such a direct move against them.

missions.title: Do Lava Suit
missions.desc: If you have armor, Wikelo can make it look warm. Good look for useful armor. Bring me things and will do.

missions.title: Double Elimination
missions.desc:
Got a contract to take out two up and comers who've been stirring up trouble. It has to be clean, both done at the same time, or else they might cause even more trouble. Long story short, you'll need some help on this one.

Both {TargetName} and {TargetName2} know how to handle themselves, and the people they fly with aren't no joke either. You can expect each of them to be guarded by a few ships.

missions.title: Double Tap
missions.desc:
A price has been set on the heads of {TargetName} and {TargetName2}. 

While having to hit two targets isn't that weird, the client wants to send a very specific message, so they need to targets hit at the exact same moment. The extra credits should make up for the hassle.

And unfortunately since the pair aren't traveling together, it goes without saying that to pull it off you're gonna need some help. Make sure you bring people you trust can handle more than one ships since the targets are known to travel with backup.

missions.title: double trouble
missions.desc:
If you had asked me, I would've said {TargetName} and {TargetName2} would have wound up eventually killing each other. But instead you're going to get the honor of killing them both at the same time.

You're going to have to work for it, though.

Each one is trouble. Serious records, highly trained, and too smart to fly without backup.

Gather the best crew you can on this one. You'll need it. And don't be stingy. You can't spend credits if you're dead.

missions.title: Driving CFP out
missions.desc:
We've been trying to play nice with these Citizens for Prosperity people, but they've made it abundantly clear that we don't have a place in their 'safe system.' Their use of mercs for security have been causing all kinds of unreasonable violence like when this asshole {TargetName} opened fire on a group of settlers to drive them away from an outpost they'd been eyeing. So now the gloves are coming off.

I need some hard workers to go hit {Address} and take out {Last}. Odds are, they'll stay hidden until you prove you're enough of a threat, so make sure you do some damage.

Stows out.

missions.title: Drop a XenoThreat
missions.desc:
Got a line on a XenoThreat that's been a pain in the ass. Not sure if you've heard the name, but {TargetName} is a scumbag even by XenoThreat standards. Vicious, sadistic, and a prick to boot. We want someone to punch their number. You up for it?

Last word was that they were somewhere around {Address}. Head there and take 'em out. Pretty simple.

Stows out.

missions.desc:

Need your help with something. If you could harvest {Resources} {MineableType}, that would really help out our understanding of the current mineral levels in the system. {Rarity}

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.

Thanks in advance.

Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

Ready to go?

missions.title: End Nine Tails' Occupation at Orison
missions.desc:
*FOR IMMEDIATE SYSTEM-WIDE RELEASE*

Attention, Nine Tails forces have seized control of several commercial platforms near Orison. Using an Identity Friend or Foe Inverter (IFFI), they have taken over the restricted air space surrounding the platforms and only Nine Tails affiliated ships can gain access to the area. This has severely hampered Crusader Security's initial attempts at retaking the platforms. As such, Crusader has requested that CDF forces assist in shutting down the inverter and eliminating all hostile presence. Any available CDF volunteers are encouraged to provide support.

Additional Intel:
* While the inverter is active and the airspace inaccessible, CDF has managed to gain control of a local shuttle system and route it to access Solanki Platform without the Nine Tails knowledge. Volunteers will need to head to the Crusader Industries Showroom on the Commercial Platform and get to the rooftop to find the shuttle that will travel to the occupied platforms.
* The IFFI is believed to be located in a locked storage container on a cargo barge docked at the central Admin Center.
* Access codes for the IFFI container are in the possession of the leader of the Nine Tails forces, Mendo Ren.
* Past experience with Mendo Ren indicates that he is unlikely to show his face and risk capture. However, if all his lieutenants are neutralized, we believe he will have no choice but to take command of the forces in person and provide us the opportunity to retrieve the codes from him.
* In addition to the shuttle system, Crusader Security has informed us that there are several vehicles on the platforms available for CDF to commandeer. These vehicles will be the only way of reaching the Admin Center. NOTE - If all of the vehicles within the restricted air space are destroyed before the inverter can be shut down, then there will be no way of reaching the cargo barge and the CDF will be forced to retreat.
* The platforms are protected by Nine Tails controlled Anti-Air weapons.

Please be aware that SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

We need to ensure that all traces of the stolen data are eradicated. This means taking out all the Headhunter servers at {Address} as well as tracking down {Last} to stop them from further disseminating the information.

Your help is much appreciated,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.

The suspect you would be after is known as {TargetName}. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Escapee Bounty Assignment: {TargetName}
missions.desc:
Convicted criminal {TargetName} has escaped from a local rehab facility and Northrock's been contracted to return the inmate to custody. In my experience, escaped prisoners tend not to give up peacefully, so use any method you can to find and subdue the escapee.

Might be worth staking out spots where they could attempt to hack their record clean. Wouldn't be the first time a prisoner has tried to wipe their sentence after escaping.

Good hunting,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Failed Negotiations
missions.desc:
Ran into a bit of crap luck that I'm hoping you can help me right.

A few days ago, I hired the crew of the 'Pride of Arliss' to obtain some important data for me. They pulled off the job no problem, but the bastard of a captain comm'd me demanding more credits. Turns out it wasn't the first time he's tried to pull this trick either because in middle of "negotiating" with me, his ship was attacked by some very pissed off individuals looking to teach him a lesson.

Our comm got cut off when the shooting started and that was the last I heard from him. I'm guessing he's as good as ghosted, but I want you to head to the Pride of Arliss and try to get my data off the captain's personal datapad.

Once you have it, I set up a secure transmission channel at the ARC-L1 rest stop. Travel there and when you're in range, submit the data to me through this contract to get paid.

Don’t try to screw me over either. Karma can be a real asshole.

missions.title: Fight for a Free Pyro
missions.desc:
XenoThreat’s efforts to keep outside influences from infecting this system is being tested by a group that dares to call itself Citizens for Prosperity. A prominent group member, {TargetName}, has established operations at {Address} and is already hard at work spreading their lies and propaganda to anyone that will listen. If we want Pyro to remain independent of UEE and alien influence, then something must be done about this now.

That’s why XenoThreat is issuing a kill order for {Last}. And knowing how important they are to Citizens for Prosperity’s operations, I wouldn’t be surprised if you had to fight your way through a bunch of their most fanatical followers first before you even get a shot at them. But remember {Last} is your target, and payment hinges solely on you making sure they’re eliminated.

Comm. Spec. Engler

Luckily, the goods are still there - for now. We need someone to visit that PAF and OLP, grab our stuff from the freight elevators, and take it to the freight elevator at {Address} where we should be able to keep it on ice.

Here’s the list of what to grab. Don’t care what order you do ‘em in. Be sure to bring a ship that can store {MissionMaxSCUSize} at the very least.

{MultiToSingleToken}

Make sure you’re ready to deal with whatever assholes you run across. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

missions.desc:
Can’t believe how many criminals are crawling around this damn system. Guess we’ll have to make some room for ourselves.

Got a list of high-level leaders here. Nothing brings chaos and disorder to the existing gangs like a good decapitation attack. The next target is {TargetName}, who we’ve tracked to {Address}. Feel like ghosting ‘em?

These old Hathor platform facilities are big and spread out. Doubt there’s a way to do this and not attract the attention of their foot soldiers. Ain’t gonna be easy but sure sounds like fun.

- Stows

missions.title: Go on the warpath
missions.desc:
Looking for some hitters to go drop some violence on some local dipshits who've been pulling jobs in the system against Headhunters. We tried reaching out to explain the error of their ways, but they shot our messenger, so now we go with option B.

You'll find them holed up near {Address}. Go there and repaint the walls with their blood.

Have fun.

Stows out.

missions.title: Golem Rocks
missions.desc:
Universe need resources so Wikelo always respect people who dig. Good profession. If you starting and want boost to Golem ship. I can do.

Bring.

I make.

missions.title: Green light on {Last}
missions.desc:
Word's come down through my bosses that we're settling old debts. I've got an open line on this old-time hitter named {TargetName} who's racked up a hefty kill list. We caught wind that they were hiding out with some people over at {Address} who aren't the biggest fans of us, so they probably won't take kindly to you. {Last} is the target here, but you might have to mix it up with them.

Again, whenever we've tried to take out {Last}, they've killed their killer. I feel like you'll fare better, but I'd bring backup if you got it.

Good luck.

-Stows

missions.title: Green light on {Location}
missions.desc:
It's sad to say but we lost one of our outposts to XenoThreat. Appalling if you ask me, but that's why we're looking for someone who's got the time and ammunition to take it back.

If that's you, head over to {Address} and take it back.

Stows out.

missions.title: Ground The Upstarts
missions.desc:
Headhunters didn't get to be what it is today by playing nice. We've tracked down the hideout of a bunch of scraggy upstarts that have been making inroads into our territory. Need you to send a message.

Head to {Address} and blow the crap out of their fuel tanks. They'll think twice about muscling in on our operations when their ships are grounded.

-Stows out

Crusader Security has learned that {Address} is currently being threatened by a well-known gang operating in the area and we’re looking to hire an experienced security team to deal with any attacks.

Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Guard Site Against Hostiles
missions.desc:
Crusader Security has learned that {Address} is currently being threatened by a local gang and we’re looking to hire a contractor to put together a security team to deal with any attacks.

This gang has a bit of a record, but they’re still pretty green overall. I expect it will be relatively straightforward for you and your team to handle.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Guard Site Against Serious Hostiles
missions.desc:
Crusader Security has learned that {Address} is currently being threatened by a group of criminals and we’re looking to hire a contractor to put together a security team to repel any attacks.

I know you may be tempted to try to handle this on your own, but you need to put a team together for this. Trust me, the credits aren’t worth it to try it solo.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Guardian Fight Mod
missions.desc: This ship look like insect in the Protectorate. Fun look. Painful sting. Wikelo can make custom version for you if you want. Make enemies sting. Bye.

missions.title: Guardian take down ship
missions.desc: Insect ship again. This one help take down other ship but if you want it to take down better. Can make. See list and tell Wikelo. Bye.

missions.title: Guardian WiK-X
missions.desc:
You Humans enjoy strange letter combinations. It very funny. Guardian ship very useful but if you want even more useful, bring me things. I give you better ship. Look better. Act better.

Thank you. Bye.

missions.title: Handle Vanduul Attack on Ship
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship
Briefing: An operator working with InterSec is currently being attacked by Vanduul ships at {Address}. The likelihood of them surviving on their own is low, so we’re looking for a contractor willing to provide combat support.

Contractors accepting this mission should be well supplied and ready to face the Vanduul threat head-on.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

You been doing good work for us, so I got a favor to ask. I'll still pay you, but it's a favor. Got some cargo that needs to get bounced from {Address} to {Address} and the guy that was supposed to do it found himself on the wrong side of an airlock, but hey, shit still needs to get done.

Only thing is you'll need a ship that can carry {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers. A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

If you could sort it out for me, that'd be great.

- Stows out

missions.title: Head Hunting
missions.desc:
The Headhunters have assembled a special strike team whose sole purpose is to attack, disrupt, and undermine our operations. As much as I’m loath to admit it, they’ve had a few small successes and are quickly becoming a concern.

XenoThreat knows the best way to kill a snake is by cutting off its head, so we’re issuing a kill order for the strike team’s commander {TargetName}, who according to our intelligence sources, has been hiding at {Address} for a few days now.

I’d expect strong resistance from the Headhunter forces there. From what we’ve heard, {Last} got this command partially because of the fierce loyalty they inspire in others. Putting your own crew together to tackle this would be a solid operational strategy.

Happy Head Hunting,

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Headhunter attack on {Location}
missions.desc:
A distress call just came in from {Address} claiming that a large Headhunter force has just attacked our outpost there. There have been multiple deaths and injuries from those who managed to flee the scene. We're looking for any available security personnel to head there and retake the outpost.

Witness accounts identified the attackers as elite Headhunter enforcers, so watch yourself out there and bring help if you can.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Help defend {Location} from Headhunters
missions.desc:
We just received a frantic comm from {Address} and are looking for any available combat specialists to help repel a Headhunter attack. There are still hostiles on site and there are reports of several casualties so we need this handled quickly.

I will provide all relevant data upon acceptance. Thank you for your assistance.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Help Me Get My Stuff Back
missions.desc:
My brother was one of those people who died when that Covalex station near Crusader blew. Even worse, he was borrowing something of mine when it happened. Now some red tape asshole is trying to tell me that I have to wait to get my stuff back. Yeah right. First you kill my brother and now you want me to be patient? The nerve of these corporate jillos. Forget that. Instead, I figured I'd hire someone to go to Gundo to get my stuff and take it to {Destination} for me. I mean, what the hell are they gonna do about it? Anyway, it's what my brother would have wanted. It's gonna be the box marked 156.

- Ed

variants.title: Help Me Get My Stuff Back

missions.title: Help Protect Site
missions.desc:
Got word that outlaws are attempting to overrun {Address}. There’s local security forces there, but they’re struggling to stop that attack.

Need a contractor to hustle there and help take care of the aggressors. Bring plenty of gear, and be careful when engaging targets. Don’t want to hear about any security team members getting caught in your crossfire.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Hide Snow Suit
missions.desc:
You want be hidden. Wikelo understand. Not ask questions why. But what do when you in snow? Wikelo have suit for that.

Welcome.

missions.title: High-Risk Ship Encounter
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Recently, we recommended that a client use a specific route to cross Nyx safely. Turns out it wasn’t as secure as we assumed, because a group ambushed our client’s ship. We need to get this cleaned up ASAP. Are you available to help?

Intel from the client indicates a well-organized attack, so you better be equipped to deal with experienced hostiles on this one. Hurry to {Address}, help them survive this, and we’ll pay you well for your trouble.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Hit 'Em Where it Hurts
missions.desc:
The muckers over at {Address} decided that it would be a good idea to interfere with our business, and now we need to let them know unequivocally that they were mistaken.

A little bit of sniffin’ through their data and we were able to sus out where the idiots keep their stash. Now all we need you to do is head over there and destroy every last bit of it.

Figure that should drive the point home.

- Bit Zeros

missions.title: Hit a CFP Complex
missions.desc:
Got a big one here. We need a team to head out to {Address}. Word is CFP are dug in at three different clusters in the area. Our judge wants them all cleared out. Seems one of their mercs, a real mean skag named {TargetName}, is holed up at one of them. We want you to go there, clear them all out and take out {Last}.

Get yourself a nice little payday in the process.

Stows out.

missions.title: Hit XenoThreat at {Location}
missions.desc:
One of our people stumbled across a group of XenoThreat hiding out over near {Address}. Not sure if they're dug in or just passing through, but we want to hit them before they move.

Maybe bring some people if you got 'em because XenoThreat don't tend to go down easy. Get there and remind them who the power is in this system.

Stows out.

missions.title: Hitting a CFP site
missions.desc:
Need someone to sweep {Address}. CFP security forces seized the outpost from a group of locals that'd been there for years. Beat the hell out of 'em from what I heard, so they came to Headhunters asking for revenge.

Need it done fast and clean.

Stows out.

missions.title: Hot Shot
missions.desc:
You need a good weapon, yes? Have one for you. Small but powerful. Like an extra spicy balalu pepper. Wikelo make this pistol look extra spicy too. You bring things I need and I do a trade.

Bye.

missions.title: ICC Special Delivery
missions.desc:
Hi,

Not sure if you ever heard of them, but a rep from the ICC (they make starmaps and study space for the empire) just reached out to us about a special job they need picked up from Wikelo's Emporium.

Kind of surprised to be honest that they having any dealings there since that Banu's trading-post doesn't exactly scream "cutting-edge science" to me.

Anyway, they want the delivery brought from there to {Address}. They also emphasized that the cargo's very delicate so make sure that you use kid gloves when you're handling it, okay? (Not that you aren't careful normally, but you know how clients are.)

Be sure to bring a heavy-duty tractor beam and a ship with enough space to store {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo.

Thanks,
Conni Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

missions.title: Idris War Game
missions.desc:
To test the preparedness of our response teams, we would like volunteers to simulate an assault against a CDF Idris by neutralizing and taking control of the vessel.

To be clear, the goal of the exercise is not to destroy the Idris, but for you to attempt to board the craft and maintain control of it as long as possible. Volunteers should expect to meet full resistance from the Idris' highly trained crew and are encouraged to get an updated imprint beforehand.

Coordinates will be provided upon confirming your participation.

Thanks and good luck.

missions.title: Illegal Blockade – Medical Supplies Needed
missions.desc:
The illegal quantum blockade of {Location} has interrupted normal trade routes and essentials are in short supply.

Crusader Security is looking for traders and haulers to provide much needed medical supplies to the station.

Prices offered by the station administration will be adjusted to reflect the situation with the Nine Tails, and in addition, Crusader will provide a hazard bonus upon successful transfer of the medical supplies because of the increased risk.

Thank you in advance for your support during these difficult times.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Director Sasha Rust
ID# 122L964G

missions.title: INFILITRATE ASD SITE AND DESTROY SERVERS
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Destroy Server
APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Our client has requested the immediate destruction of a group of servers located at a long-shuttered ASD research site. The servers in question contain information that our client considers extremely damaging and is eager to see the data completely eliminated.

Initial surveillance indicates the servers are within the facility’s Energy Lab, located in the Research wing. We’ve also picked up on a number of hostile forces, so be on alert.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Inmate Maintenance Opportunity
missions.desc:
Hello Guests,

We have recently been alerted that one of our Oxygen Dispensers has suffered a technical error. As you know these kiosks are vital to ensure that you have plenty of oxygen handy while participating in our Work Release Program.

We are looking for any available guest to reset the kiosk. That should reconnect the kiosk to the network and resolve the issue. The first guest who's able to complete this task will not only be compensated with merits, but also with the satisfaction that they're making the workplace safer for other guests.

Thank you.

missions.title: Intensive Eradication Effort
missions.desc:
Native plants and animals near {Location} are on the verge of environmental collapse due to the dramatic population spikes of several invasive species. We’ve been contracted to dramatically reduce the current population of these species to help avoid an environmental collapse. We need a dedicated and highly skilled exterminator to carry out this contract.

You can better acquaint yourself with the creatures in question by referencing "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser
Contract Manager
Highpoint Wilderness Specialists

missions.title: Interdict XenoThreat Attack Force
missions.desc:
Multiple reports are coming in of XenoThreat ships massing at {Address}
We're looking for contractors ready to take the fight to them.

They want us to believe that they have right on their side. They want us to believe that they have overwhelming force. This is a chance to show them we know better.

I won't lie, this is more than just a simple security contract to me. I really hate those intolerant assholes and everything they stand for.

You with me?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Interested in Building a Better Future?
missions.desc:
To all available contractors,

Rayari Incorporated is looking for independent contractors to provide additional support in our efforts to push the boundaries of science, agriculture, and medicine in the Empire and beyond.

A research initiative at {Address} is in desperate need of resources, so we are looking for a reliable contractor to obtain and deliver these crucial components.

For more information on the materials in question, refer to "A Forager's Guide" in your Journal.

Rayari offers competitive wages along with the knowledge that you're building a better universe.

Let’s grow together,

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

variants.title: Interested in Building a Better Future?

missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Access Engineering Files
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
From the personnel files recovered at the Onyx Facility, we have now learned that Dr. Jorrit has recently visited the site and accessed files while there. The next step will be to follow this lead and try to learn exactly what Dr. Jorrit was doing in his old lab.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files.

Additional Notes:
I've found a work around for the QT issue so you'll be able to travel directly to the site from now on.

Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Access Research Files
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
The files you found in Engineering confirm that Dr. Jorrit is actively pursuing something at the site, but it is still unclear what the doctor is up to. I’m hoping that if you can find the data he was accessing in Research it will provide further clarity.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Research wing to locate and access Dr. Jorrit’s recent files .

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you accessed these files, I'll be sending you 5 Secure Drives with copies of whatever data we've gathered so far. You can collect them at your home location.

missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Lab Sample
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
In going through the files, I’ve seen a couple of allusions to a specific lab sample that would potentially be useful to have our people analyze. Not sure where it is exactly, but if you hunt around Onyx Facility you should be able to find the sample and bring it to me.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Onyx Facility Research Wing and track down the Lab Sample and deliver it to {Address}.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Onyx Personnel Files
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
A client has requested that Hockrow compile a complete dossier on infamous scientist Dr. Logan Jorrit. Believed responsible for the incidents at Associated Science & Development’s Lazarus site, the client is eager to get a broader view of Dr. Logan and his research.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Gain access to ASD’s shuttered Onyx Facility where Dr. Jorrit was formerly the Lead Scientist. Once there, locate and access the research lab’s personnel files so that we can get an overview of what was going on there.

Additional Notes:
The QT beacon to the site was deactivated when the facility went dark so you'll have to fly the last leg manually.

While ASD has formally closed the facility, caution is still advised. Not only may the labs themselves be hazardous, but the surrounding area shows signs of recent visitors. Scavengers or squatters may be on site.

I've also managed to wrangle an employee ID code for you so as long as you're on the job, you'll be able to access the computers there.

Additionally, Onyx Facility only has large hangars available, so plan your travel appropriately.

missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Power Usage Data
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
The seismic data you extracted had some interesting revelations. My expert says she thinks that Jorrit might have been excavating down there. Hate to think what he’s doing, but it's our job to find out. I think we’re close to cracking this, so I want you to go back to Onyx and gather the Power Usage data. If we can track energy flow from the last couple months, a pattern should reveal itself.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and upload the Power Usage data.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

Once you hand off this data, I'll be sending you 10 Secure Drives with copies of the information we've gathered so far. You can collect them at your home location.

missions.title: Jorrit Dossier: Retrieve Energy Anomaly Data
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #JD10285
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Update:
Reviewing Dr. Jorrit’s recent files that you uploaded to me left us with more questions than answers. While we know for a fact that the doctor had been inside Onyx, we don’t yet know the specifics of what he was doing. The client is eager for us to learn more about what exactly Jorrit’s up to, so I’m afraid you’re going to have to go back in.

I have a few ideas on how we might be able to use the facility’s systems to pinpoint Dr. Jorrit’s activities, though you’ll have to physically bring me the data this time so we can properly analyze it. First up, are the energy sensors in Engineering. They’re still active and sensitive enough to pick up any anomalous readings.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Explore the Engineering wing and retrieve the Energy Anomaly data and deliver it to {Address}.

Additional Notes:
Be wary of possible hostile forces on site.

Travel to Onyx in a vehicle that can be stored in a large hangar.

missions.title: Kill Order: "Citizens" at {location}
missions.desc:
The group of instigators that calls itself “Citizens for Prosperity” can no longer be allowed to continue spreading their lies and propaganda without repercussion.

As a sharp reminder of who really controls Pyro we have issued a kill order to eradicate all “Citizen” presence at {address}. Resistance is likely, but we expect you to handle it with little difficulty. Do as directed and you’ll be paid well for your work.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm

variants.title: Large Deposit Of Ore To Confirm

missions.title: let's help each other
missions.desc:
Hey there. I heard you ended up in Klescher which is a real drag. But it might actually be a lucky day for both of us.

Long story short, I had somebody sneaking a datachip out of the prison, but they never got back to me. I know for a fact they haven’t left the facility, so I think something might have happened to them. While tragic, business must carry on. If you can get the chip and finish the job, I can clear your crimestat for you. What do you say?

Of course, I don't know exactly how far they got, but I can tell you that the prison's got a whole network of hidden tunnels my guy was planning on using to make his escape. My guess is his corpse is rotting away somewhere there.

Once you find the body, I’m hoping the chip will still be on him. When you’ve got it, finish escaping and get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents.

One warning though, you might want to watch out for Hurston Security. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them.

When I've got the data I’ll wipe your crimestat and then, voila, you’ll be free and clear. What you do after that is entirely up to you.

missions.title: Ling Contractor Re-evaluation
Ling Family {ReputationRank} Cargo Haul - {CargoGradeToken} Scale
missions.desc:
Hi,

Guess the folks at {Address} are planning a party and need help acquiring everything in a timely manner. You’ll need to make multiple pick-ups for this one, including one in Nyx to grab some Jynx gin. Not sure if you’ve ever had the stuff, but it’s a Nyx specialty. Some folks can’t get past that it glows pink, but I love it. Got a truly unique kick to it.

Here are the pick ups:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

{MultiToSingleToken}

Please remember to bring a handheld tractor beam, as you’ll be handling cargo containers up to {MissionMaxSCUSize}.

Happy Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.title: Ling Family {ReputationRank} Cargo Haul - {CargoGradeToken} Scale
missions.desc:
Hey,

Any chance you’d be willing to do a haul into Pyro? I know it can get dangerous there but this is for a good cause. A group of new CFP members have moved to {Address} and had a tough time adjusting to life in the system. They all left stuff behind in Stanton, because their transporter didn’t have room, so we’ve been hired to pick it all up and bring it to them.

Here are the pick ups:

PICK UP LOCATIONS (ANY ORDER)

{MultiToSingleToken}

CFP leaders hope that bringing them this stuff will make the system feel more like home. Let’s make sure this one goes down smoothly. Remember to equip your handheld tractor beam, and a ship that can fit {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

Happy Hauling,
Reyes Ling
Cargo Logistics Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

Ling Family Hauling knows it’s a dangerous and unpredictable universe and has established several protocols to protect both you and our client’s cargo. To ensure you aren’t punished for circumstances outside of your control, total payment will be prorated to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered. A delivery timer will be set for each haul. Any cargo that remains undelivered upon its expiration will be flagged as stolen and treated as such. All pick-ups and deliveries must be autoloaded or done at a freight elevator.

missions.title: Ling Family Seeking New Contractors
missions.desc:
Hi,

We're a small family owned and operated delivery company that's currently seeking new contractors in the Crusader area.

If you're interested in working with us, the following delivery would be a great trial to see if you're a good match for the company.

PACKAGE FOR PICK UP
· Package #{SerialNumber} from {Address}

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Package #{SerialNumber} to {Address}

If all goes well, you'll become the newest member of Ling Family Hauling.

Last thing, it'd probably be a good idea to bring a handheld tractor beam with.

Thanks,
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

missions.title: Locate Missing Clients
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP51643
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
Looking for an operative to confirm the status of a client. They and their partner missed a scheduled meeting and all attempts to contact them have proven in vain. Last we heard they were undertaking some business in {System} and fear that they may be the victim of some unfortunate tragedy.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate {MissingPersonList} at {Address} and confirm their status.

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
Be cautious while conducting your search. If the client did meet harm, it would be unfortunate for you to meet the same fate.

missions.title: Locate Missing Contractors
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP12854
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
We have been asked to track down two contractors who work for a client of ours after they lost contact with them. They were last known to be traveling together in {System}. Until their exact situation can be assessed, our client is stuck in a waiting pattern.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate {MissingPersonList} at {Address} and confirm their status.

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
You'll be heading into what is regarded as a particularly dangerous spot. Backup is highly recommended for this encounter.

missions.title: Locate Missing Crew
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP65648
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
A whole crew has gone missing while undertaking a contract in {System} for a client that I'm unfortunately not allowed to disclose the full details of to you. Lets just say that it wasn't the safest job and the fact the crew is not responding comms is not surprising but it is concerning. It's vital that we ascertain what happened to them.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate {MissingPersonList} at {Address} and confirm their status.

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
This investigation has high potential for there to be aggressive and dangerous hostiles on site. Arm yourself accordingly and consider bringing other skilled associates with you.

missions.title: Locate Missing Employee
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP51132
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
Need an operative to help us locate the current whereabouts of a client's employee. They were on assignment in {System} but has failed to report in. Our client is beginning to fear the worst.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate {MissingPersonList} at {Address} and confirm their status.

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
This contract has been flagged as combat-likely so prepare accordingly.

missions.title: Locate Missing Family Member
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP45648
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
A client has tasked us with tracking down with one of their family members who has gone missing. After exhibiting erratic behavior, they cut off all communications and left for {System}. We were able to track down their general whereabouts but need an investigator to head there in person to assess the situation.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate {MissingPersonList} at {Address} and confirm their status.

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
There is a high chance that you will encounter hostiles while conducting your search. We recommend considering bringing along backup to support you.

missions.title: Locate Missing Team
missions.desc:
Hockrow Agency
Case File #MP74384
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor

Case Summary:
We had sent in a two-person team to {System} to investigate a case, but have received no reports from them for several days. At this juncture we are forced to assume that they had run into an unforeseen obstacle and may be in need of rescue, or worse, have been killed.

Contract Investigator Actions:
Locate {MissingPersonList} at {Address} and confirm their status.

If they are deceased, examine the body closely so we can verify their death via your mobiGlas.

Additional Notes:
Consider the dangerous nature of their investigation, there is a very strong chance there will be hostiles on site.

missions.title: Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
missions.desc:
Hi,

Need a reliable contractor to pick up some packages for us and deliver them to their destination.

This route is a longer one so make sure you have enough fuel and don't forget a handheld tractor beam.

And not sure what you were planning on flying, but you'll need a ship that can transport {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers

{SignOff}

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
