missions.title: Looking for a little revenge
missions.desc:
Here's the deal. Some of those mercs that CFP hired as security went and shot up some Headhunters that were just moving through the system. They weren't even doing anything, just flying.

Anyway, we tracked them back to {Address} and want to dish out some payback. Grab your gear and be our weapon, we'll make it worth your while.

- Stows

missions.title: Looking for Closure
missions.desc: They said that I could find someone here to go to Gundo for me and grab a crate that belonged to my wife. If the name didn't ring a bell, that's the station where they had that big accident. My wife worked for Covalex and I know it's not really going to make losing her any easier, but I really just want Claudia's stuff back. I think about her photo collection or the necklace I gave her just sitting there in that cold dead station in some box marked 249 and it's not right. She deserves better. So how about it? You willing to go to Gundo and haul her crate back to {Destination}?

missions.title: Low Risk Protection Detail
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A client has requested a contractor with immediate availability to provide extra support to a number of ships leaving an asteroid base located at {Address}). Once you’ve accepted, rendezvous there and await further instructions. In this instance, your job is to provide support for their safe passage. Hostiles may be present, but they shouldn’t be too challenging to deal with.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Major Malfunction
missions.desc:
I won’t go into the whole long boring story of why, but there are a few bits of {Address} that we need destroyed. The important part is that I want to pay you a hefty chunk of credits to do it. I almost feel like you should be paying us for this because of how fun it’s going to be.

Don’t even care how you get it done. Grenades, rocket launcher, day old Torpedo Burrito, it’s all the same to us.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Make a Ursa Mod
missions.desc: Wikelo branching into ships too. Took a look at Ursa and improved. Bring parts for me and I will make for you. Explore planet better. Go do.

missions.title: Make ATLS shoot
missions.desc:
Hello. Know you human like strange metal suit. How about metal suit with ikti? Sorry, ikti is Banu word, you call it 'gun.'

If want, bring things I say and I will make for you. Gun will shoot. Cause many damage.

Bye.

missions.title: Make glowy armor
missions.desc:
Wikelo had exciting idea during brief work rest. Was thinking about the little glow worms in Pyro and saw armor get changed to look like.

If you get me parts, bring to {ListAll} and will make for you then you can glow too.

Bye.

missions.title: Make jumpy ATLS shoot
missions.desc:
Find very fun piece to add to big human suit that let you jump very high. Now you shoot and jump. Exciting.

If you want, bring me these to {ListAll}. Will make.

Wikelo

missions.title: Make VOLT shotgun angrier
missions.desc:
You feel like gun not angry enough? VOLT shotgun very powerful, very dangerous, but not scary? Bring to me. Can make very scary and angry.

They respect you then. Bring to {ListAll} and we make.

Bye.

Looking for a contractor with a ship that can carry {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers to run a delivery for us across Stanton.

This isn't a particularly long delivery route, but you will be moving between couple of different locations. To make sure things go smoothly, bring enough fuel and a handheld tractor beam to speed up moving the boxes.

{SignOff}

Jr. Logistics Coordinator

missions.title: Mining and Data Collection
missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Mining and Data Collection

WORK BRIEF:
Have a big one for you today. Need you to get down there and mine {Resources} {MineableType} and relay your stats back to us. I'm looking to pull together some findings from various miners around the system. {Rarity}

Also, if you're stuck of where to look or new to mining, the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out. It's in your mobi.

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon full area scan confirmation and extraction.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Mining and MOLE
missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Mining and MOLE

WORK BRIEF:
Another special job for you with an extra special payout. Like the previous jobs, I need you to find and extract {Resources} {MineableType} and relay your stats back to us. {Rarity}

I can't even tell you how helpful your work has been in the past so I've arranged an extra special payout for this one. {Rarity}

By this point you know what you're doing but just going to remind you that the United Resource Workers' mining journal on your mobi is great if you're stuck.

Let me know if you’re up for it.

PAYMENT:
You'll receive a custom ARGO MOLE as payment for all your help.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Missing Mining Team
missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Missing Mining Team

WORK BRIEF:
One of our local crews set off for a dig and haven’t checked back in. With everything going on out there, people are starting to get a little worried, so we’d like someone to try and get eyes on them.

I hate to say this, but if something happened to them, could you please identify everyone you find so we can let next of kin know?

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: Missing Persons
missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Missing Persons

WORK BRIEF:
A group of prospectors set out to look for some mining opportunities and haven’t been heard from since. We’re looking for someone to check in and see if they’re okay.

I'll send you their last known location. Just head out there and see what happened.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon entire crew's status confirmation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: money from nothing
missions.desc: Ever want to make creds just magically appear? A bunch of old CCB credit terminals are currently active and faking bank transactions to siphon off funds to whoever controls the terminals. If you want in on the action, I'll sell you the coordinates for a small fee. Better hurry if you want to make a play for it. Don’t know how long it'll stay up and running.

missions.title: Moraine Movements
missions.desc:
*********** People's Alliance ***********
******/ 'Stronger When United' /******

RE: Moraine Movements

WORK BRIEF:
This is a little outside our usual purview, but with the Moraine attacking more often, we’re hoping to find out where they’re operating and steer crews clear of those areas.

We need someone to infiltrate a suspected Moraine facility and plug a small listening device into their server. We’ve been told that the station is rarely occupied but it’s possible that you will encounter Moraine there, so be careful.

While we don’t advocate violence, the potential benefits of this intel will be able to save many lives on both sides.

PAYMENT:
Standard listed rate upon successful installation.

AUTHORIZATION:
Battaglia, Recco

missions.title: More than a Max
missions.desc: If you want to move many things. Hercules ship, very good for that. Wikelo even know souli back in Protectorate that started to use. Very big. Wikelo can give you similar version if you get what Wikelo need. Look at list and tell me.

missions.title: Most Special Wolf
missions.desc: You have been good trade partner for Wikelo. Offer you this very special Wolf mod. Make trade even better - Bring me what I want and I give you the special Wolf AND Antium Armor AND a VOLT LMG. Very good deal for my very good customer.

missions.title: My Dad's Stuff
missions.desc:
Hi,

I'm looking for someone to head to the Covalex Gundo station near Crusader and grab some items. I know this may sound like stealing, but it's my dad's stuff. You see, he was on Gundo station when it had its accident. My mom says that we need to wait until Covalex says so, but I don't think that's fair because I miss him so much. I would like something to remember him by and I don't want to wait any longer because I might start forgetting things. I'll pay you to get box 510 for me and take to {Destination} so I can have it.

Thank you very much,
Baylor Ward

missions.desc:
Hi, we need to move some cargo across the system and were wondering if you could help. I know this is outside your usual purview, but I'm low on options. This would also be a great way to show your committed to Citizens for Prosperity's greater mission here.

If you head to {Address}, there should be some cargo accessible via a freight elevator that we'll need you to take to another freight elevator at {Address}.

Only thing to call out is that your ship must be able to handle {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers. To make your life easier, be sure you have a handheld tractor beam with you. Otherwise, it should be a simple run.

Lima Endicott

missions.title: need an out?
missions.desc:
Hi there. We haven’t had a chance to work together yet but I’m in a bit of a bind here and I could use another body. Not for nothing, of course. I’m all for a good quid pro quo.

One of my associates who was serving some time in Klescher was supposed to bring me a datachip, but then they went quiet. Now I’m assuming they’re dead, but here’s the deal: if you finish his job, I wipe your crimestat. Not bad, right?

Your predecessor was apparently planning on using some old tunnels to make his escape. He made it sound like they weren't exactly the easiest thing to access, but I trust you can figure it out. I'm guessing you'll find his body somewhere in there and if we’re lucky, he'll still have the chip on him.

Once you get it, finish getting out however you can. Then get the data to me. There’s a spot nearby you can upload the chip’s contents. You might want to watch out for Hurston Security, though. They've been a hassle lately, so I wouldn't be surprised if you ran into them. After I get the data and validate it, I’ll wipe your crimestat.

Then you can go and enjoy your newfound freedom. If you do this right, maybe I’ll have more lucrative work for you down the line.

missions.title: Need multiple CFP outposts retaken
missions.desc:
The outlaw presence here has become much bolder of late and a lot of people are getting hurt. We've recently lost several clusters around {Address}. While we don't like to have to resort to violence, the board has acknowledged that these locations are crucial to establishing stability in the system and authorized the use of a security detail to retake them.

We're also aware that the embedded hostiles are being led by {TargetName} who's had a history of attacking CFP interests. The board would like {Last} dealt with to prevent future attacks.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

Got a moment? Need someone to fly over to locate {Resources} and mine at least {Resources} {MineableType}. We're updating our database for future mining expeditions. You can keep what you find, we just need the data. {Rarity}

Also, if new to mining, the United Resource Workers wrote a helpful journal that you should check out in your mobi.

Let me know if you’re up for it.

CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

After tracking them for several weeks, we’ve identified {Address} as the ideal spot to intercept them. It features an emission cloud where you can hide and power down your ship while waiting for the {AmbushTarget}.

Intel suggests that they may travel with an escort. If they do, you’ll have to deal with them too. Since this is your first contract, we will have other contractors in the area who can lend a hand once you strike.

missions.title: No Fly Zone
missions.desc:
Some competition has taken root at {Address} and they've really been gumming up the works for our operations in the area.

Now part of me sees some potential in the upstarts so I'm hoping to bring them into fold, but at the same time, I can't really afford to have them flying around causing trouble.

Instead, I want you to go and blow up their fuel tanks. That should keep them grounded long enough for me to talk some sense into their thick heads.

-Stows out

missions.title: Now make Polaris. Short Time Deal.
missions.desc:
Wikelo recently get many blueprints in trade with human who not very smart. Now can make very big ship.

Not cheap and need many pieces but will make. If you want, go quick, this cost much to Wikelo so won't be able to do for long but I like new Human system so I want to thank you all for welcome.

Bye.

missions.desc: Wikelo know many Xi'an. Talk slow but very interesting if you have patience. This is very fast little thing to get you across planet. Wikelo made a few tweaks to make it zippier. If you want, Wikelo will make for you. Bye.

missions.title: Obtain Irradiated Valakkar Pearls
missions.desc:
To all available contractors,

We at Rayari are stopping at nothing to halt the ongoing regeneration crisis, but to continue their efforts our scientists need a rare resource that the company's suppliers cannot obtain.

Rayari is seeking an experienced contractor to gather irradiated valakkar pearls, which can be extracted from adult valakkar that have been extensively exposed to radiation. Our scans have found a qualifying population inside the storm near {Location}. Because these animals are highly dangerous, Rayari is prepared to generously compensate anyone who can assist with gathering the pearls.

Once attained, please take these valuable resources to {Address}.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.desc:
Have another pair that need to be eliminated:
{TargetName} and {TargetName2}

They've been in the wind for a few days now, but just popped up. If we don't get them now, I'm not sure we will get another chance. You need to enlist a partner to make sure both targets are hit at the same time.

As far as them putting up resistance, {TargetName} is known to bring along a friend to watch their back, and I suspect {TargetName2} will do likewise.

Ella Tieno

The medical supplies Crusader needs are set to get picked up from {Address} and needs to be dropped at {Address}. And be sure to bring a handheld tractor beam to speed things along.

Thank you,
Conni Ling

Ling Family Hauling

missions.title: Overdrive Initative: Attack on XenoThreat
missions.desc:
Attention, Naval forces have regrouped for the final assault that XenoThreat have been planning. The Navy has officially requested any CDF volunteers to help provide combat support in this final push to secure our system. This will include volunteers outside of those who have participated in the Overdrive Initiative.

SAIC Rowena Dulli from the Advocacy is the official attaché to the CDF and will be running the operation.

If successful, this will complete this Overdrive Initiative series and you will receive temporary access to the F7A Hornets or a free upgrade if you currently own an F7C.

missions.title: Overdrive Initiative: EMERGENCY AT KAREAH
missions.desc:
Attention all CDF volunteers, we received a distress call from Security Post Kareah. It turns out XenoThreat used the comm arrays as a distraction to lure law enforcement away so they could launch an attack on the station.

We've learned that they're attempting to access their systems, so all volunteers must immediately divert to retake Kareah and clear out all XenoThreat forces.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

missions.title: Overdrive Initiative: Reward
missions.desc:
Thank you for your diligence on this Overdrive Initiative.

As promised, we've approved you for an upgrade from a civilian F7C mk ii to a military grade F7A mk ii if you have one.

In addition, you've been given a temporary rental of a military F7A mk ii that you can access in your ASOP.

_________________

To upgrade, visit the RSI website to apply the token, then restart the game and access the ship.

missions.desc:
Attention CDF volunteers, XenoThreat's gone off the grid. We suspect that they have gone dark in order to prep for the final phase of their plan.

History has proven that XenoThreat like to fight so it stands to reason that this might be an attack of some kind so we're calling on volunteers to deliver supplies to the Gateway station near the Stanton-Pyro jump point to shore up for a potential assault.

As a reminder, the military has generously donated some old F7A Hornets for CDF members who see this initiative through to the end.

missions.title: Package Delivery for Ling
missions.desc:
Hey,

We need you to grab a delivery for us over at {Address} and then take it to {Address}.

I was originally going to send my brother Ricki to handle this, but he said the area’s too dangerous. Guess there’s been a bunch of security warnings around there, but as long as you’re careful and bring some guns or whatever, I’m sure you’ll be fine. You probably won’t even run into anything.

Thanks,
Conni Ling
Shipment Coordinator
Ling Family Hauling

missions.title: Paid Target in CFP
missions.desc:
Headhunters are launching an attack near {Address}. This ex-Marine asshole named {TargetName} has been sending their mercs to clear out nearby encampments if they don't surrender their weapons.

While all the security have been greenlit, {Last} has been singled out. In their last raid, they beat a squatter to death for talking back. Turns out that squatter was the cousin of one of our Clips, so they're paying extra to make sure justice is done.

Watch yourself though, {Last} may be a scumbag who has this coming, they're still ex-military so they won't be easy to take down.

-Stows

missions.desc:

Outlaw activity in this sector is higher than normal, so InterSec recommends that you bring backup. When ready, dispatch to the location marker on your HUD and scan the waypoints along the route. Once you've confirmed that the entire sector is clear, the main contractor will receive a bonus of {ScripAmount} MG Scrip.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin

Briefing: There's a growing concern that Vanduul hunting parties are pushing further into Nyx. The first line of defense against this encroachment is increased patrols. InterSec has identified a sector that has seen an uptick in Vanduul activity and are looking for someone to patrol the region and provide an update on it.

missions.title: Peregrine Wikelo Mod
missions.desc: Wikelo not want to race but can still make fast ship faster. If you want, bring me things, and go faster.

missions.title: Permanently Delete
missions.desc:
The slimy little cretins over at {Address} have been selling us trash data all while trying to double deal. Can’t let it stand.

We want you to go teach them one final lesson and wipe out all the cowards you can find. Last I heard is they were holed up over near the {Location}.

Spill their blood, and we’ll fill your wallet.

-Bit Zeros

missions.title: Personal Effects
missions.desc:
Hi,

I'll totally understand if you don't want to help with this, but if you can it would be amazing.

See, my boyfriend passed away during the Covalex Gundo tragedy. They said I would get all of Scott's stuff back once the investigation was complete, but as far as I know, it's been done for a while now and they still haven't given any indication of when I can get his property. It's been hard enough dealing with all this, and knowing that a package is going to show up in a month or two and rip open all these wounds, it's just too much. I would prefer to deal with it now and get it over with. If you could find a way to get his personal effects (Employee ID# 104) and drop them off at {Destination}, I'd be very grateful.

Thanks for your help,
Anya

missions.title: Personal Transport
missions.desc: {InitiatorName} is requesting transportation from {InitiatorLocation} to {SelectedDestination}. Upon the successful completion of this service, you will be paid {PaymentAmount} aUEC.

missions.title: Pilot Under Fire From Vanduul
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Vanduul
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: We've just lost contact with a pilot who engaged with Vanduul forces at {Address}.

Travel to their last known location and if they're still alive, defend them long enough to ensure they can escape. Ensuring the safety of the operative is crucial, as is eliminating any Vanduul threats to the UEE.

You'll most likely need a strong group of ships to successfully neutralize these Vanduul.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

missions.title: Plug a traitor
missions.desc:
This shit saddens me. Not sure if you've ever crossed paths with {TargetName} in your dealings with us. Thought they were a real good one. Been with the Headhunters for years, but something must have happened because they went running to CFP for protection. Sold out some of our brothers and sisters along the way.

All the Judges are furious and wants blood. That's where you come in. Go to {Address}, find {Last}, and kill them.

Doesn't have to be anything fancy. Just want the result.

Damn shame.

Stows out.

missions.title: Precision Strike on {TargetName}
missions.desc:
Got a line on a bounty named {TargetName}. Someone spotted them along with known criminal accomplices at {Address}. Need you to get there before they get going.

{Last} has a reputation for only showing their face in places with civs. Really need you to take down this bounty without there being any civilian collateral damage. Foxwell can’t afford to be caught in the shitstorm that would erupt over the loss of innocent life.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Preemptive Strike On {TargetName}
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec requires a skilled contractor to eliminate a highly dangerous group of criminals based in Nyx who are planning a coordinated strike on a prominent member of the UEE Navy.

We have intercepted a crucial piece of intelligence suggesting a known terrorist by the name of {TargetName} intends to carry out this assassination along with the help of local criminal elements.

They are currently located at {Address}, making this an ideal time for us to strike. Be warned, these outlaws are experienced killers - bringing a group of trustworthy allies is advised.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

missions.title: Pro Tem Bounty Assignment: {TargetName}
missions.desc:
Hey,

Northrock recently received intel that a bounty who disappeared from Stanton is back. {TargetName} has been spotted at {Address}. Surveillance of the orbital platform indicates that {Last} is directing the operation there. Getting to ‘em won’t be easy, but absolutely essential.

We’re determined to not let them get away again. That’s why we’re giving anyone interested the opportunity to apprehend this target. Just be prepared to face fierce resistance.

Best of luck,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Pro Tem Escapee Bounty Contract
missions.desc:
Hey There,

My name is Braden Corchado and I'm a logistics officer for Northrock Service Group, the leading independently-owned security firm operating in the Stanton system. I may have reached out already, but we try to make it a point of approaching anyone who meets our high standards and encouraging them to complete a pro tem contract.

You can't do much better than become a Northrock contractor. We have a solid reputation for offering challenging and interesting work at a higher rate of pay then many of our competitors in system.

Now, to get approved, you will need to apprehend one {TargetName}. They have recently escaped from the detention center and your job will be to track them down before they can disappear completely off the grid.

A little hint is that it's safe to assume that the target is going to go try to clear their record. I recommend triangulating your search between the detention center they escaped from and locations where they can hack into the record system.

Get this done and we'll see about getting you more work.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

Hey,

I know it's been a little while, but if you are still interested in doing contract work for Northrock, I convinced the management to give you a reevaluation. If you can successfully complete a bounty for us, we can see about getting your employment status reinstated.

This pro tem contract is to track down escaped criminal {TargetName}. Try your best to get to them before they can wipe their record at database access point or the job's going to be significantly more difficult.

Hoping we can trust you on this.

Northrock Service Group

I've been thinking over everything that went down and decided to speak to management. They've agreed to give you another chance but only if you successfully complete a contract for us.

We can look at reinstating your employment status if you can bring in this criminal trio:
{Target1}
{Target2}
{Target3}

They evaded the last Associate who went after them, so you bringing them all in would definitely earn you some points.

Hopefully you've gotten your act together since your last job.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Pro Tem Suspect Apprehension
missions.desc:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.

The suspect you would be after is known as {TargetName}. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon,

It's been a little while, hope everything's okay. I know things didn't end on the best terms, but after discussing it with management, I would like to offer you an opportunity to redeem yourself. You had potential and I hate to think that you didn't have a proper chance to show what you're capable of.

Apprehend {TargetName} and we can see about getting your employment status reinstated.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Prospects Look Good
missions.desc: Wikelo loves rocks. Wants to help you get more better rocks. Made this Prospector more better for that tough job. Trade items and you can have.

missions.title: Protect {Location} from XenoThreat Attack
missions.desc:
We’ve learned that XenoThreat is about to launch an attack on {Address}. If they are successful, the number of casualties is expected to be high. I’m hoping that with your aid in defending them, we can make sure that doesn’t happen.

We know from past encounters that XenoThreat sends several raiding parties to carry out their attacks, so make sure you don’t leave the outpost until you’ve fought off all the reinforcements.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Protect {Location} from XenoThreat Incursion
missions.desc:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is mobilizing for a massive incursion to wipe {Address} off the map. You’re their only hope of enduring this assault and protecting them from XenoThreat’s cruelty.

I know I’m asking you to put yourself in the line of fire, but this system won’t change unless people like you are brave enough to take on these dangers. No amount of credits could measure up to how much good you’d be doing by stepping in.

If you’re willing and able to take on this mission, make sure to take some allies with you. XenoThreat will certainly send in stronger reinforcements once they realize they’re taking losses.

We believe in you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Protect {Location} from XenoThreat Raid
missions.desc:
Urgent!

XenoThreat is targeting {Address} to send a message to other settlers about what happens if they accept our support.

If you’re able to fend off the attackers, I’m sure they’ll send additional forces, so you’ll need to dig in for multiple assaults. Since XenoThreat has a lot of resources at their disposal, you should think about recruiting others to help you keep everyone safe.

We’re all counting on you.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

I’m in need of a highly competent pilot who can gather a crew of equally capable pilots for an escort mission. missions.title: Provide Backup
missions.desc:
Crusader Security has learned that {Address} is currently being threatened by a group of criminals.

While we have security personnel on site, we are looking to hire additional contractors to help them repel any attacks.

Now, as a contractor, I’m not sure how used to working with a team you are, but I don’t want to hear anything about "friendly fire" or there’s going to be problems.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Prowler More Utility
missions.desc: Wikelo work hard. You work hard. Prowler Utility work hard. But you bring me right items, I make it work more hard, then you work less hard. Bye.

missions.title: Pulse Plus
missions.desc: Wikelo really like this little Human ship. Pulse feel very fast. Can have many configuration to make Pulse go faster. If you want, can give you configurated Pulse that I like. Have list of what I want for job. Bye.

missions.desc:

A client has asked us to infiltrate an old ASD research site and wipe the contents of a few specific servers there.

We believe the servers are located somewhere within the Xenotech Lab, in the Research wing. The client has also informed us that despite the facilities being publicly declared as closed, you're still likely to find hostile forces there.

This contract is non-negotiable.

missions.title: Purge XenoThreat Servers
missions.desc:
I'm so mad right now I can barely see straight. A Headhunter who I thought I could trust just went over to the XenoThreat. Yeah, aliens killed your family. Shit sucks, but you don't turn your back on your people.

To add insult to injury, the bastard gave XenoThreat a bunch of our intel. I have some other folks tracking the traitor down, but I need you to take care of wiping out the stolen data for me. It's being kept on servers at {Address}.

-Stows out

missions.title: QV Breaker Station Mining Rights (Exclusive)
missions.desc:
CONTRACT: Mining Rights Transfer
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
Shubin Interstellar prospectors have recently discovered the location of an abandoned QV Planetary Service Breaker Station near the Keeger belt. These stations were originally used by the defunct company to harvest valuable resources from inside asteroids but knowledge of their exact locations has been lost over the years.

While this particular station is offline, our scout team believes that it could be made functional again with the necessary repairs. Additionally, if it was brought back online, there's already a resource-heavy asteroid in place ready to be cracked by the station's mining laser.

Unfortunately, with all the various challenges that come with operating in Nyx, Shubin doesn't currently have the available bandwidth to handle the aforementioned repairs ourselves. This however has created an opportunity for an interested independent mining operation such as yourself.

TERMS*:
We are making available the exclusive mining rights to this QV Breaker Station. Upon purchase, we will provide the coordinates of the station to only you and your crew. Your team will then be free to head there with a mining vessel, restore the station's mining laser to an operational status, crack the asteroid, and harvest the resources inside.

Please note that while we guarantee that these coordinates will be exclusive to you, we cannot assure that other interested parties, such as outlaws, may not discover the station's location on their own. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Ready for RAFT?
missions.desc: RAFT is very useful. Wikelo take it and make it very very useful. Do work and make you happy. You want? Bring items to Wikelo for trade.

missions.title: Reclaim Headhunter Outpost
missions.desc:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for security personnel to take a former CFP outpost that's currently serving as a hideout for Headhunters to launch attacks throughout the system.

Located near {Address}, reclaiming this outpost will allow CFP to provide greater support to local efforts to build stability.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Reclaim XenoThreat Outpost
missions.desc:
Despite our efforts to promote non-violence, local outlaw groups continue to attack our organization. XenoThreat recently assaulted {Address} and chased out our volunteers that had been working there.

We're looking to enlist combat personnel to retake the outpost. Ideally we could work something out to encourage them to move on, but XenoThreat quickly resorts to violence to solve all their issues so there will undoubtedly be a fight.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Reclaiming Clusters from Headhunters
missions.desc:
Citizens for Prosperity's board just authorized funds to hire security personnel to retake several clusters near {Address} that have since fallen into the hands of the Headhunters. While we tried to just accept the loss, it's become apparent that they are crucial to our ongoing operations in the system.

You'll need to clear out each of the locations that will be provided but more importantly, you'll also need to take out {TargetName}, who's in charge of the hostiles on site.

These Headhunters are heavily embedded and have a history of violence, so you should prepare accordingly.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Reclaiming Outposts from XenoThreat
missions.desc:
Looking for any available security personnel to reclaim several clusters previously lost to XenoThreat aggressors. Located near {Address}, they had been seized in brutal attacks led by {TargetName}, a notorious XenoThreat lieutenant.

We're looking to take these clusters back so we can reestablish operations and continue our good work. You'll need to clear all the hostiles still on-site as well as {Last}.

Just a reminder, that XenoThreat are highly trained and quick to fight, so prepare accordingly.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Recover Vanduul Corpses
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Cargo Capable Ship, Personal Arms, Heavy-Duty Tractor Beam
Briefing:
Our latest intel shows that the Shattered Blade have replenished their stock of Vanduul corpses and will shortly be transferring them from the old QV Logistics stationthey're operating from to an interested buyer. The UEE can't have another incident like what happened with ASD so they're eager for us to recover the cryopods and deliver them to the freight elevator at {Address}.

While the Shattered Blade members present at the site might offer resistance, they are not the focus of you mission. Deal with them as needed and get the cryopods.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager

missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing:
To prevent the Shattered Blade from flooding the black market with xeno-contraband, the UEE has charged InterSec with recovering a stash of Vanduul Plating and Metal. from the old QV Logistics station the gang has been occupying. Once you have the materials in your posession, deliver them to the freight elevator at {Address}.

missions.title: Red Level Contract: Clear PAFs, Recover Cargo, and Deliver to OLP
missions.desc:
Something weird is going on at the old Hathor mining facilities. Both the platform alignment facilities and orbital laser platforms have been abandoned and gathering dust for decades, but outlaws have started using them as a base of operations.

We’ve been hired by a concerned party who’s recently lost a lot of important cargo to one such gang. Currently, their stuff is stashed at {Address} and {Address}, but there’s a growing fear that the gang may be offloading their goods soon. That’s why we’ve been hired to hit both of those Hathor facilities, retrieve the cargo from the freight elevators, and bring it to the freight elevator at {Address}.

Here’s the specifics on what to grab from each location. Doesn’t matter in what order you do this, as long as it all gets collected and delivered. Just be sure to bring a ship that can handle {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers. It also wouldn't hurt to bring a handheld tractor beam with you.

{MultiToSingleToken}

Foxwell hasn’t been able to scout these locations, but if I were you, I’d expect to face some serious armed resistance. Best bring a bunch of gear and some friends.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement

Unfortunately, a Valakkar infestation is creating serious problems for not only the stations' infrastructure, but also for the chances of them being brought back online one day. Due to Valakkar's status as an invasive species, we have decided that culling them is the only viable option.

Reduce the Valakkar numbers at any of the old QV Breaker Stations and we will offer you payment.

Best,

Wanda Werkheiser

The fools are operating from {Address}. We need them all gone. Make it as loud as you can. We’ll send your payment once everyone’s taken care of.

We’ll compensate you to support that convoy.

Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Retaking Outposts from Headhunters
missions.desc:
Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available security operatives to retake several former CFP installations near {Address} from Headhunter control. These clusters were violently taken from us by {TargetName} and resulted in the deaths of many volunteers.

Bringing these outposts back under our control will help provide more stability to the system. Reports indicate that {Last} tends to hide behind their rank and file, so they will likely appear once you've cleared out most of the hostiles.

XenoThreat are trained and motivated so they will not give up easily.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Retrieve Additional Smuggler Intel
missions.desc:

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws present and armed
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec needs your services once again.

The intel you previously gathered has been invaluable in identifying several prominent buyers of the illegally-obtained Vanduul parts. However, since then the Shattered Blade have continued their operations and the UEE is requesting that we update our intel.

We believe more information can be retrieved from the storage facilities located at the old QV Logistics station.

The operation parameters haven’t changed since your last mission: find the encrypted data and use the decryption key to decipher and upload the list to us. The Shattered Blade will have reinforced the area since the last time, so expect resistance.

Good luck. We’ll be in touch.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin

Congrats! Crusader Security has decided to offer you another chance at being a security contractor. With a little bit of hard work and effort, the hope is that you can rise above any previous performance issues.

First though, to reassess your viability, we would like you to assist Crusader Security in dealing with an outlaw group that have been making threats against {Address}.

APPROVAL CODE = VS-14

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Client has requested a discreet contractor to infiltrate an ASD research site, locate a group of servers, and destroy the information stored on them permanently.

The client was able to share the location of the servers within the facility: the Control Center in the Engineering wing. The site has officially been shuttered, but there still may be hostile forces there. Be on your guard.

missions.title: Seeking Experienced Combat Pilots
missions.desc:
Citizens for Prosperity is in need of pilots with dogfighting experience. If you’re looking to put your skills to the test, I have a mission here for you to try.

A civilian ship has requested combat support near {Address}. Head there and show us that you have the skills to excel in these types of missions and we’ll put you to good use.

Please be aware. This mission is not a training exercise. This is a real encounter, so please do your best to save the ship in distress.

Good Luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Seize the Data
missions.desc:
Been hunting down a particular parcel of data and right when I get a break the ship gets attacked by this converted Nine Tails Reclaimer called the Black Kite. I tried to hack into the servers on the Black Kite to see if they copied the data, but couldn't find a way to remotely get past their encryption protocols without the physical key.

That's where you come in. I need someone to breach their ship, get a hold of their decryption key, and decrypt the server so I can remotely pull down what I need.

You're smart enough to know who we're dealing with here, so plan accordingly. Since it's gonna ruffle some powerful feathers, let's not leave anything to chance. Destroy the Black Kite when you're done to cover both our asses.

missions.title: Server Not Found
missions.desc:
Hey,

Got a problem we could use your help on. One of our former new-recruits did a complete crap job on a hack and wound up leaving a digital footprint so messy that it might as well be a full confession.

A remote deletion’s not going to be good enough so I want you to go to {Address} and make sure their data servers are wiped from existence.

As if this wasn’t a big enough of a mess already, the access codes to the locked server room door are only stored physically on site. That means you’re going to have to liberate a datapad with the code on it first before you can even get close to them.

Don’t worry though. I’ll make sure the creds are worth all the hassle.

- Bit Zeros

missions.title: Shiny Builder Suit
missions.desc: You need utility suit. Good for work. If you like, Wikelo can make shinier. Look real good. See what Wikelo need and bring.

missions.title: Shot in the chaos
missions.desc:
My boss is looking for an available hitter. Headhunters are looking to retake {Address}. The CFP Mercs there have been digging in for a long fight. Look, we don't want to kill anyone we don't have to, so we're looking into other options.

Security there's being run by {TargetName} and my Judge thinks that if they're taken out, the rest'll scatter. Shedding a little blood's better than a lot, right?

-Stows

missions.title: Show Them Who's Boss
missions.desc:
Word’s gotten out that we’re expanding into Stanton and a local crew has hit a few of our safe houses. We managed to track the bastards back to some old Hathor mining site.

You up for showing them how the Headhunters handle things? If so, head over to {Address} and show them that we mean business.

- Stows

missions.title: Shutdown CFP’s Comms
missions.desc:
CFP think they’re safe over at {Address} but we got big plans for them. You’re gonna pave the way for us by heading there and shutting down their comm towers.

There should be a control terminal at the top that you can use to shut the tower down. You get that sorted and they won’t be able to call for backup. Then we can show those skags who this system belongs to.

Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.

Stows out.

missions.title: Shutdown Xenothreat Comm Towers
missions.desc:
Citizens for Prosperity are eager to help the people of Pyro, and it starts with freeing them from the grasp of XenoThreat.

We’re preparing a team to infiltrate one of their outposts, but we need someone to go in ahead to take out their communication towers first. Once those towers are offline, they won’t be able to call for reinforcements and we can proceed with our plan.

Head to {Address} and find the towers. At the top is a control panel that can be used to disable them.

Also, it’s worth noting that most outposts use a similar system, so you’ll know how to disable the comms towers rather than risk fighting reinforcement dropships when you’re doing other jobs.

Good luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Silence the Xenothreat
missions.desc:
We’re making a play to hit some XenoThreat assholes where it hurts but need to be smart about it. That’s why we’re sending you in first to take out their comm towers so they can’t call for backup. You do that and we can be in and out before they know it.

Head to {Address} and climb the comm towers there. Should be a control panel at the top you can use to switch them off.

In fact, same goes for most other outposts. Rather than having to deal with reinforcements, you can just turn off the comm towers. But hey, if you wanna ring the bell to ghost a few more Xenothreat I ain’t complaining.

Stows out.

missions.title: simultaneous release
missions.desc:
Guess what {TargetName} and {TargetName2} have in common?

You're gonna kill 'em both!

Difficult part is that I need you to kill them at the same time so that one doesn't have a chance to escape, or worse, kill the person trying to kill them.

So put together a team to track one target while you handle the other. Divide and conquer!

And despite the fact they made a mess big enough to get themselves killed, my understanding is that they are relative lightweights. Don't expect you to meet too much resistance.

missions.title: Small Mining Order: Sadaryx
missions.desc:
CONTRACT: Mining Order
LOCATION: Nyx

DETAILS:
One of our prospecting teams recently confirmed that the asteroids which house QV Breaker Stations throughout Nyx's Keeger Belt contain a rare ore type, Sadaryx.

However, owing to the difficulty in access these stations and the inherent risks involved, we are seeking external mining crews to handle the extraction.

We do not have a confirmed location of where the Sadaryx deposits are located within the station, but would recommend starting with the cave sections where minerals naturally form. If you get really lucky, you may even find some crystals in storage that were mined by the old QV work crews.

TERMS*:
Your crew will need to gain access to a QV Breaker Station, collect the required Sadaryx ore, and deliver it to the freight elevator located at {Address}.

This will require a Multi-Tool with a Mining Attachment and a basic understanding of hand mining.

Our prospecting teams have reported that these stations may have been infiltrated by outlaws. Caution is advised.

*By accepting this contract you are assuming any and all risks associated with the work outlined herein and in no way can Shubin Interstellar be held accountable for any damages accrued during the duration of the contract.

missions.title: Sneaky Stabber
missions.desc: Have the pieces to build useful ship for people who like to sneak then fight. Take F8C ship and make even better. Have put what Wikelo will need to build for you. Now you decide. Bye.

missions.title: Sneaky Starfighter Ion
missions.desc: Starfighter Ion good ship, but it could be more sneak, yes? Surprise your not friends when you shoot them. I help with this for you. I need the right items and then I can give to you. Bring to me. Bye.

missions.title: Snow Snipe
missions.desc:
Want to shoot long away and stay hiding. But it snowing? Wikelo have gun for you.

Bring things. I give.

Bye.

missions.title: Special Covalex Delivery Stanton System
missions.desc:
Got a special assignment - Loads of packages ready to delivered across the system. Its a bit more than the usual so I'm only reaching out to my best contractors for this one.

Obviously, a part of that payment will be to cover your fuel because you'll be going super far with this one. You'll need all the usual as well like a handheld tractor beam and a ship with space to store {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

Good luck. I'm counting on you.

{SignOff}

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.title: Special Idris For Killing
missions.desc: Since Wikelo has done good business with you, make you this very special trade. Idris is a powerful ship perfect for big important person like you. Wikelo has even done mod to make it more dangerous! Bring me a few items and the ship is yours.

missions.title: Special Recovery Operation
missions.desc:
I wouldn't normally ask someone to do something so risky, but these are exceptional circumstances.

Our pilot was transporting some vital cargo when they were targeted by a group of outlaws. Under no circumstances can we allow them to get their hands on the cargo.

With the size of the hostile force who attacked, you won't be able to do this on your own, you'll need to bring a skilled crew with you to {Address} in order to take out these outlaws and get the cargo back. Make sure at least one of you has a ship that can store {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam.

If by some miracle you can get that cargo back, take it to the freight elevator located at {Address}.

It's a lot to ask, but if you can pull this off you'll have my and the whole organizations appreciation.

Best of luck,

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Spirit Cargo mod
missions.desc: Wikelo love useful cargo ship. Spirit is very useful. If you want one, can make for you. Just bring me things and I will do. Bye.

missions.title: Starfighter Inferno Special
missions.desc: Starfighter Inferno good ship, but what if you want it to be better ship at fighting? Wikelo knows just what to do. You bring me the items and I make it for you. Bye.

missions.title: Starlifter A2 War Mod
missions.desc: Bring Wikelo the things and I make you A2 Starlifter that fights better. Does war so good make you call it A1! Bye.

missions.title: Still Looking for Work?
missions.desc:
Due to a corporate restructuring, Foxwell has some new vacancies that need to be filled immediately. Foxwell knows you’ve previously expressed interest in this line of work, and we’re wondering if you would want to take another crack at a contract.

One of our clients needs support at {Address} where their security forces are struggling to handle an outlaw incursion. Head there and help the local forces get rid of the problem before it’s too late.

Successfully complete this contract, and Foxwell would be happy to send more work your way.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Stock Taking
missions.desc:
I won’t bore you with the details, all you need to know is: one of our haulers got attacked and now our goods are sitting in a freight elevator at {Address}.

Up to you how you get the goods out, but if you happen to ghost a few of our rivals in the process, I ain’t complaining. Once you’ve got the stuff take it to the freight elevator at {Address}, then we can sort your payment.

A handheld tractor beam would also be smart to bring along.

Stows out.

missions.title: Stop Attack on High-Profile Client
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

A high-profile client decided to tour Nyx system but got jumped by hostile ships around {Address}.

Sounds like they’re overwhelmed. Any chance you could head to their location and provide support?

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Stop Deadly Ship Attack
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

Despite our warnings, a client decided to fly to {Address}. Unsurprisingly, they just dropped a rescue beacon in the area, so we’re looking for a contractor to get on site, assess the situation, and hopefully rescue the client.

We warned them that extremely dangerous and well-equipped outlaws often strike ships there. That’s exactly what I assume happened here, so make sure you plan accordingly.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Stop Rivals from Launching Heist
missions.desc:
When will people learn that they can't just do whatever they feel like on Headhunter turf? These idiots are planning a big job and thought that I'd just let them get away with it? No way in hell.

I want you to fly to {Address} and destroy their fuel tanks and data servers. Show them what the Headhunters really think of them.

Let's see them try to pull off anything after that.

-Stows out

missions.title: Stop Spying Op
missions.desc:
My associates and I have found ourselves in a little predicament and could use some help. There’s an orbital sentry at {address} that’s spying on us. We don’t know who put it there, but it sure as hell can’t stay.

Thing is we’re business minded folks first and foremost and worry that if we blow it up ourselves it’ll start shit. That’s why it’s better if someone like you does it. Should be a quick and easy gig for someone interested in earning some creds.

- Smokey

missions.title: Stopping the Competition
missions.desc: Stopping the Competition

missions.title: Strategic Bombing
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Combat Ships w/Ordnance
Briefing:
Local assets have indicated that Shattered Blade elements are attempting to rebuild one of their stations and Intersec is looking for a pilot to make sure that doesn't happen.

They've managed to get basic turret defenses back online but currently only have two power relays activated. These will be your targets as they cannot be destroyed by energy weapons, you will need to bring ballistic or ordnance to be effective.

Reactivation of this station will allow the Shattered Blade to try and reclaim a foothold in this system and we can't let that happen.

Good luck,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify the sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

missions.title: Suit Up Take Off
missions.desc: Ships have big windows. Everyone can see you flying. You should look the best. Wikelo has very good flight suit for you. Do trade, bring me what I need and Wikelo give suit. Give blueprint as well if you do not have.

missions.title: Supply Line Sabotage
missions.desc:
The armchair “activists” of Citizens for Prosperity continue to try to spread their influence throughout the system. With your assistance, there is an opportunity to sever their operations at the roots.

The group is using {address} to distribute supplies to independents scattered around the planet. If we destroy the {ship} located there, their network will fall.

Bombardment would send a clear message, but I’ll leave it to you to decide the means of destruction.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Support Client Under Attack
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Defend Ship
APPROVAL CODE = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

One of our clients got the brilliant idea to test their dogfighting skills in a real world scenario. Doesn’t sound like it’s going well, because they comm’d us asking for some support.

Head to {Address} and help clean up the mess they created.

Payment will be issued upon successful completion of contract.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Surveillance Termination
missions.desc:
It seems our struggle to free Humanity has got the government lapdogs back on Earth feeling nervous. Recent scans discovered an orbital sentry at {address} that we believe is part of an UEE espionage campaign. Good credits says they’re handing the data direct to the slinks themselves.

Only one sentry has been detected so far, but who knows how big the operation will grow if it’s not taken off-line. Shouldn’t be too much trouble for a skilled merc. If that sounds like you, payment will be sent promptly once the sentry is destroyed. Plus, XenoThreat will remember that you’re someone willing to fight for what’s right.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Suspect Apprehension Certification
missions.desc:
Hi,

Hope you don't mind, but I was made aware of your Bounty Hunters Guild status and wanted to reach out and see if you'd be interested in contracting with Northrock Service Group, one of the top rated private security firms in the system.

If you are, the first step would be to complete a pro tem suspect apprehension. It's less of an evaluation and more of a chance to make sure that we can have a good working relationship.

The suspect you would be after is known as {TargetName}. They are known to be particularly elusive so you may have your work cut out for you.

Hope to hear from you soon,

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: Sweep and Clear Location
missions.desc:
Looking for someone willing to take out the trash at {Address}. Guess a gang has settled in without the permission of the owners. So they’ve hired us to get them out whatever way we see fit.

I’d bring plenty of ammo, if I were you. Doubt they’ll want to leave willingly.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts
missions.desc:
Got word from my Judge that we're to take back some of the outposts that CFP have taken over. They're a little pissed that CFP's getting as much of a foothold in the system as they are and think it's making the Headhunters look weak.

Found a couple candidates near {Address} that could use a sweep. Icing on the cake is that the head of security there is {TargetName}. Not sure if you've heard of 'em, but they shot up a handful of Clips last month, so it's a win-win. Get some territory back and punch out someone who could really stand to get got.

Stows out.

variants.title: Sweep and clear some CFP haunts

missions.title: Tactical Strike Group Needed
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Shattered Blade
Equipment Specs: Strike Group
Briefing:
We've received word that a People's Alliance security ship called Tranquility stumbled across Shattered Blade hiding out in an old QV Extraction station. Details are sketchy but will connect you with local assets once on site.

Intersec is looking for a team to intervene and protect the Tranquility and their personnel. Based on discussions with the Tranquility's captain, you will need ballistic and ordnance to break down the defenses of the station and ultimately get boots on the ground to save their pilot.

Recruiting additional ships to support you in this mission is absolutely critical. You will need a variety of ship types to balance multiple combat zones in space and on the ground.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

missions.title: Take Outlaws at {Location} Offline
missions.desc:
We have gotten word that the outlaws at {Address} have begun recruiting with the hopes of launching a raid against Citizens for Prosperity.

In order to deescalate the situation before it gets out of hand, we would like you to disable their power generators and halt their expansion.

Pull this off and it could save a lot of lives.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Taking back from the Headhunters
missions.desc:
We are currently looking for any qualified and available security operatives to head out to {Address} and reclaim a CFP installation that had been taken by Headhunters.

The group that's currently occupying the outpost is being led by {TargetName}, a Headhunter of some note who's had a history of aggression against locals and CFP volunteers.

We need all Headhunters secured and {Last} taken out.

Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity

missions.title: Taking down a XenoThreat Hideout
missions.desc:
Got a juicy assignment for any big-time enforcers who want to clear a big payday. Over at {Address} we got some XenoThreat turf run by a real bastard named {TargetName}. Now if you've been in the system long enough, you've probably either heard of {Last} or at least seen their work. Skag has a tendency to leaves bodies wherever they go.

Anyway, Judge wants this area swept clean, that means you gotta hit all three clusters and kill every XenoThreat dirt you find. Kill enough and {Last} won't be able to hide.

Take them all out and have one on us.

Stows out.

missions.title: Taking out some XenoThreat trash
missions.desc:
Just got clearance from my Judge to start banging back against XenoThreat. Been eyeballing some spots under their control near {Address}.

I'll give you the targets to hit, you kill everyone you find. Hell, I'd love to go myself, sounds like fun.

-Stows

missions.title: Taking XenoThreat Turf
missions.desc:
Need some good soldiers with a taste for violence to hit some XenoThreat hideouts located around {Address}. I'll get you the specifics if you're down, but you'll have to wipe out two separate clusters of hideouts.

We've also gotten word that {TargetName} is lurking around down there. If you take out enough XenoThreat dirtbags, they'll pop they're head up.

When they do, put a round in it.

Stows out.

missions.title: Target: XenoThreat Attack Group
missions.desc:
We have a fix on a XenoThreat Idris with fighter support at {Address}. Their comms discipline's lousy. According to the radio chatter, the Commander's on board the Idris. Can't remember the last time we had such a strong fix on him. This could be a chance to decapitate the whole operation.

Want in?

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Teach Citizens for Prosperity A Lesson
missions.desc:
Every day it seems like Citizens for Prosperity is out here trying to snatch up more people for their shitty little cause and make life more difficult for hardworkin' folks like ourselves.

I figure they could use a reminder about who really is in charge here. Head to {Address} and really mess the place up.

Nothing like a bit of property damage to get a point across.

-Stows out

variants.title: Teach Citizens for Prosperity A Lesson

missions.title: Terminate UEE Threat: {TargetName}
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: {Address}
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Heavy Gun-Ship
Briefing: An outlaw fleet lead by {TargetName} has been planning a major strike against vital UEE infrastructure. InterSec has been tasked with dealing with this threat before their attack can be launched.

Gather a suitable amount of support craft and head to the engagement site. There you will have to engage with various squadrons before their leader will deem the situation dire enough to directly lead their forces. It is critical that they be neutralized in order to ensure the attack is stopped.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of a non-binding offer that upon acceptance may be immediately terminated by either party without any given notice. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to system law where applicable.

missions.title: Terrorist {TargetName} to be Neutralized
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Outlaws
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ships
Briefing: InterSec has identified more outlaws who are planning an operation against UEE interests from within Nyx. Your mission will be to neutralize this potential threat before they can enact their plans.

Travel to {Address} and dispatch the leader of these outlaws, {TargetName} without hesitation. We have scouted a small number of ships, but our report suggest these are competent pilots - bringing back up is advised.

Remember that eliminating these outlaws not only serves the people of Nyx, but the UEE too.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

missions.title: Test Armor
missions.desc: Bring me armor and other things and I give you special test armor. First version. Very special. Bring and I give. Bye.
