missions.title: They Will Be Missed
missions.desc:
A senior security official by the name of {TargetName} is about to have their long career come to a very violent and sudden end. While they are currently at {Address}, they will not be easy to get to. I fear that a bit of work will be required to draw them out.

I recommend killing enough of their underlings that they will be forced to face you personally. Of course, once they do decide to finally show their face, it should be a rather straightforward matter.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

missions.title: They Will Be Missed
missions.desc:
A security officer by the name of {TargetName} is in desperate need of an early retirement. They are currently stationed at {Address} along with a host of other eager types in uniforms.

Feel free to indulge your violent whims, but it is only the death of {TargetName} which will earn you my credit and thanks.

Earnestly,
Vaughn

missions.title: Time to roll on CFP
missions.desc:
Looking for anyone with an itchy trigger finger. We're looking to move against some CFP at {Address} and take it for ourselves. You gotta play this smart though. There are a bunch of satellite outposts around the main one and all of 'em got security, so you should take out each of these before you take the main base.

But hey, if you wanna jump right in the deep end and fight off all the reinforcements, that's on you. As long as you get it done.

Stows out.

missions.title: together forever
missions.desc:
Here's the deal. {TargetName} and {TargetName2} need to die at the same time. Unfortunately, they aren't gonna be in the same place.

A double hit can sound complicated, but if you hire some additional guns it shouldn't be all that hard to do two hits simultaneously.

Make sure you find folks who have skills as I have it on good authority that each'll be flying with some escorts for "protection."

missions.title: Top Tier Operator Needed
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

This contract should only be considered by the most capable of pilots. A highly valued client is currently under attack at {Address} and requires immediate extraction. They’re sitting in the hangar ready to leave, but are unable to move until the hostile ships in the area have been neutralized.

I don’t see the outlaws stopping any time soon and our client’s reporting they’re packing high-grade weaponry on their ships. This will be a test of your skill as much as your endurance. Assemble whoever you need and head there immediately to assist them.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Total Server Wipe
missions.desc:
One of our datarunners went MIA while transporting vital operational information. A few hours ago, we determined that they were hit by a Headhunter raiding party and the contents of the ship’s datastores were transferred to their servers at {address}.

While we have every reason to believe that our encryption will hold, we cannot take the risk that the contents of those files will be exposed. You are being ordered to head there and ensure our data remains private by destroying the Headhunter servers.

I strongly encourage thoroughness. Raze everything and everyone you can to the ground.

Comm. Spec. Engler

missions.title: Track Down {TargetName}
missions.desc:
Looking to execute a bounty on {TargetName}. We’ve learned that they’re currently hiding out with some confederates at {Address}.

I’d be prepared to deal with the lowlifes hanging around {Last}, but our only real concern is that you land the target.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Trade Council Scrip for Favors?
missions.desc:
If you want other way to get favors from Wikelo, have thing for you. Wikelo have need for scrip given out by Council group. Wikelo not part of thief souli, but has business from time to time.

If you bring scrips to {ListAll}, will trade for favor.

Bye.

missions.title: Trade Merc Scrip for Favors?
missions.desc:
Wikelo has another way to get favors if you interested.

Your Mercenary souli has scrip metal, used like favors, but made of very interesting metal that Wikelo need for new project.

If you bring scrips to {ListAll}, will trade for favor.

Bye.

missions.title: Trade Worm Parts for Favors?
missions.desc:
Have new way to get favors from Wikelo. Hear much about worm things in radiation storms. Made up of many interesting parts that Wikelo find use for.

If you bring parts to {ListAll}, will trade for favor.

Bye.

missions.title: Trapping a Rat
missions.desc:
Got a plan to take care of a rat I've been dealing with and need a hand.

Had a client default on some debts and now they've decided they ain't going to pay up. Got a tip that they're hiding out over at {Address}. If you can take out their fuel tanks they'll have no choice but to reconsider their crap decisions.

Just be sure you don't underestimate this slimebag. They might be dumb but they're not stupid, if you get me. I've heard this place is swarming with ships and turrets, you'd have to be a total nullbrain not to bring backup.

-Stows out

missions.title: Turf War
missions.desc:
One of our Judges caught wind of XenoThreat trying to move in on our territory. Seems like they’re trying to take over {Address}. We don’t want to let those psychos get any more of a foothold in system than they already have, so we’re putting some creds on the line to get ‘em to back off.

We want you to come down on them hard. Don’t let up till the whole place is a graveyard. We’ll send your payment once the bodies are ready to bury.

- Stows out.

missions.title: Turn Things to Favor
missions.desc:
Maybe Wikelo not have something you want made (that strange, but okay). Old souli would give out favors, very good way to prove that you do work for me. Collect enough and trade when I have something you want.

Bring things to {ListAll} and will trade for favor.

Bye.

missions.title: Tutorial - Your First Flight
missions.desc:
You’re almost through with the tutorial. All that remains is to take flight!

With your business in {Name} finished, it’s time to leave the city – and eventually the planet. Make your way to the {TransitNameShort} transit shuttles. These shuttles can take you all around {Name} – but your destination is the spaceport, where an Anvil C8 Pisces has been temporarily provided for you.

This snub scouting ship is a great starter vessel, perfect for new pilots looking to get their wings.

missions.title: twice the headache
missions.desc:
Have another pair that needs simultaneous deathing. Seems to be getting more and more popular as a murder option.

This time it's {TargetName} and {TargetName2}. Both are supposed to be pretty skilled operators and they won't be flying alone.

I'd make sure whoever you get to help you on this one can handle a fight.

missions.title: two for the price of two
missions.desc:
{TargetName} and {TargetName2}. I think they may be related? Or dating? Doesn't really matter, someone wants them killed.

I've arranged it so that you can hit them when they're not flying together. Safer for you this way. They are both serious business and fly with equally serious backup.

Make sure you and your crew time your attacks. I don't want one of them left alive or it's going to be a real headache.

variants.title: two for the price of two

missions.title: Two In The Head
missions.desc:
Contract's for two targets that need to be taken out at the same time. 

Guess the client is worried that if they aren't eliminated together, one of them will go dark and try to get some revenge.

They go by {TargetName} and {TargetName2}.

Find yourself a team, divide and conquer.

And make sure whoever it is has got skills, because these two have a reputation for holding their own in a fight and they for sure won't be alone. Be ready for them to give you some trouble.

missions.title: UDM Local Delivery Evaluation
missions.desc:
Greetings Potential Qualified Shipping Partner!

Ready to contribute to our growing and expanding delivery network? Have a vessel at your disposal that can carry several packages and fly between local planetary bodies and satellites? Unified Distribution Management is looking for a pilot just like you!

We would love to evaluate your hiring potential with this carefully selected itinerary -

PACKAGE FOR PICK UP
· Package #{SerialNumber} from the {Address}

DROP OFF LOCATION
· Package #{SerialNumber} to the {Address}

If this sounds like something you're interested in, accept this offer right away! Just be sure to bring your own handheld tractor beam for maximum efficiency.

Looking forward to working with you,

Unified Distribution Management
-Delivering the Total Package-

missions.title: UDM Local Delivery Re-evaluation
UDM Package Pick Up
missions.desc:
Greetings Qualified Shipping Partner!

If you’re looking for work as a delivery pilot, we have the perfect opportunity for you!

A pick up is waiting at {Address} to be delivered to {Address}. Sounds fun, right?

Warning, there have been multiple security alerts flagged in the area. Be sure to bring along some defensive measures so you can stay safe.

If this sounds like something you're interested in, accept this offer right away!

Looking forward to working with you,

Unified Distribution Management
-Delivering the Total Package-

missions.title: Unexpected Inheritance
missions.desc:
Hey,

So this is a little awkward for me to talk about, but it turns out that one of the people who passed away on that Covalex station disaster, Kyomi Santos, actually bequeathed me something in her will. I was surprised to hear it, but apparantly I'm now the proud owner of everything stored in box #173. The people at Covalex say I'll be able to get it when the station opens back up but ... this is the awkward part ... I kind of really need it right now. Normally I'd just wait, but I'm trying to start my own business (I make cakes in the shape of people's homeworlds) and the credits I get from selling it will really be a huge help. I've got a little bit stashed away now that I can use to pay for someone to deliver it from Gundo to {Destination} for me. I know the whole things a little bit irregular, but if there was any other way I wouldn't be asking.

Thanks for the help,
Thrace

missions.title: Upgrade Intrepid
missions.desc: If you are looking for Intrepid ship that more intrepid. Wikelo can help. Bring things and you will get special touches on ship by Wikelo and pretty new coat to it. Bye.

missions.title: Urgent - Ship Under XenoThreat Attack
missions.desc:
A distress beacon came in from {Address} about a ship under attack from XenoThreat. The pilot reports that their shields are failing and they can't outrun the attackers.

The ship's a {Ship}, but the pilot's Human, which according to XenoThreat's twisted way of thinking, makes them a traitor to Humanity and a target for their hate.

We're looking for operators to head out there and do some good.

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: URGENT: Boarding Action In Progress
missions.desc:
An executive client just informed us that their 890 Jump had been intercepted at {Location} and boarded by outlaws. They would prefer to have this handled privately owing to the sensitive nature of proprietary data that's being stored aboard.

Your first priority will be to clear all outlaws as quickly as possible so that a recovery team can be dispatched to return the ship to the owner. The longer the outlaws have control of the vessel, the higher the chance it will be lost. I recommend you acquire a team for this outing to expedite matters.

Note that thanks to a small contingent of Security Personnel who stayed aboard, all surviving members of the crew were able to flee in an escape craft. The current status of the remaining security is unknown, but just in case, keep an eye out for friendlies when you engage the hostiles.

Secondly, if at all possible, the client is *very* interested in preventing the theft of the aforementioned data. If you are able to stop the theft of their confidential data stores before they are transmitted, a generous bonus will be issued.

Needless to say, this is a client I would very much like to keep happy.

Braden Corchado
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

missions.title: URGENT: Retake Security Post Kareah
missions.desc:
Security Post Kareah is under attack by an unknown number of assailants.

Crusader is seeking contractors to quickly travel to the station and eliminate all trespassers in the vicinity before our security forces are overwhelmed.

We’re not sure whether the attackers are targeting the contraband in our evidence lockup or our CrimeStat database, but whatever they’re after, they need to be dealt with. You will receive a combat bonus for each target neutralized.

By accepting this contract, you agree to abide by all Crusader Security protocols: If you harm any guards or other authorized contractors while on the station, your contract will be terminated and you will be marked as a target.

Time is of the essence, but make sure you’re well equipped to handle the hostiles before responding.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Vanduul-Tech Smugglers
missions.desc:
MISSION SPECS

Area of Operation: Nyx System
Hostile Forces: Unknown
Equipment Specs: Combat-rated Ship, Personal Arms
Briefing: InterSec has been enlisted by the UEE to gather intel on a group of black marketeers dealing in Vanduul parts, that have been linked to the illegal Vanduul experiments happening at ASD’s Onyx Facility. The UEE is eager to understand and put an end to their operations.

Based on evidence extracted from the ASD facilities, we’ve potentially managed to track down the location of one of their storage sites.

Once accepted, head over to the old QV Planet Services Logistics station and we’ll be in touch.

Respectfully,

Deacon Tobin
Operations Manager
InterSec Defense Solutions

This communication consists of confidential information solely intended for the recipient. Please disregard if received in error and notify sender. All operations are conducted at the contractor’s own personal risk and must adhere to UEE and system law where applicable.

missions.desc:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: {TargetName}
SYSTEM: {System}
RISK ASSESSMENT: {Danger}
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: {Address}
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: HeadHunters
NOTES: Headhunters are a reputed criminal organization who have a long history of clashes with law enforcement. There is a good chance that they might have other gang members when confronted so exercise caution when engaging.

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

missions.title: Verified Bounty: {TargetName} | XenoThreat | {Danger}
missions.desc:
--------------------------------------------------------
----------------- BOUNTY CONTRACT -----------------
--------------------------------------------------------

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
PROCESSING & DISTRIBUTION

The Bounty Hunters Guild has authorized an official bounty.

NAME: {TargetName}
SYSTEM: {System}
RISK ASSESSMENT: {Danger}
LAST KNOWN LOCATION: {Address}
KNOWN AFFILIATIONS: XenoThreat
NOTES: Xenothreat has consistently displayed unprovoked aggression against any law enforcement or security personnel. There is a good chance that they might have other gang members when confronted so exercise caution when engaging.

BOUNTY HUNTERS GUILD
In Pursuit of Justice

The Bounty Hunters Guild is a security service sanctioned by the Mercenary Guild and authorized to operate in both the UEE and beyond in accordance with Xenotrade Authority Acts.

missions.title: Verified Freelancer Bounty Assessment
missions.desc:
In an effort to increase the safety of Crusader and its environs, Crusader Security is seeking qualified individuals to assist with the collection of bounties in the area.

We have evaluated that you possess the skill set needed and as such, we would like to offer you an initial trial bounty contract for {TargetName} last seen at {Address}. 

Upon the successful completion of this contract, you will be placed on Crusader's Verified Freelancer list and be eligible for any future bounty collection work as it becomes available.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Verified Freelancer Bounty Reassessment
missions.desc:
Good news! Crusader Security has decided to offer you another chance at being a bounty contractor. We are hoping that during this time you have corrected any past performance issues and can once again be a useful asset.

First though, we are required to reevaluate you, and as such, would like you to complete this bounty contract for {TargetName}. 

Upon the successful completion of this trial, you'll be restored to Crusader's Verified Freelancer list and be eligible for any future bounty collection work as it becomes available.

CONTRACT AUTHORIZED BY:
Liaison Officer Bautista
ID# 948J030K

missions.title: Very Hungry
missions.desc:
You humans keep Wikelo very busy. Work more than when I at old souli. But Wikelo very hungry now and can't get food.

Please help. Bring food and drink to Wikelo Emporium at {ListAll}.

Very appreciate your help. Will give thing in return.

Bye.

missions.title: Very Long Distance Covalex Delivery Stanton
missions.desc:
Hiya,

Covalex requires a safe pair of hands to pick up some packages and get them where they need to go.

Designating this a long distance delivery so stock up on fuel and supplies. And definitely make sure you bring a handheld tractor beam.

As for what ship to bring, you'll also need something that can move {MissionMaxSCUSize} cargo containers.

{SignOff}

Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'

Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

missions.title: VIP Client Needs Protection
missions.desc:
ECKHART SECURITY, LLC.
CONTRACTS & DISPATCH

CONTRACT TYPE: Escort Ship
Approval code: = {ApprovalCode}

FOR IMMEDIATE PROCESSING

In need of a contractor who can report in now. A client has found themselves in hot water over at {Address} and a protection detail to get away from an asteroid base. They’ve reported multiple, well-armed hostile ships meaning you’ll need a crew of your own to deal with them. Based on the client’s account, these attackers seem highly motivated so they will likely not back down easily.

This contract is non-negotiable.

This message may contain confidential, proprietary, privileged and/or private information. The information is intended to be for the use of the individual or entity designated above.

missions.title: Vital Resources Needed For Research
missions.desc:
To all available contractors,

Rayari scientists are hard at work trying to solve the issues with failing regen tech. Currently, their efforts are hindered by a lack of three resources essential for their experiments: saldynium, jaclium, and carinite.

In particular, our scientists at {Address} have had to put their work on hold after running out of those resources. With a restock from our normal provider not possible for months owing to short supply, we’ll pay a premium to anyone who can assist with restocking the materials.

Though we haven’t been able to do thorough scans, there’s a strong belief among our teams that Hathor’s defunct Orbital Laser Platforms were built above areas with a high concentration of these resources. Reactivating these OLP could be your best hope of acquiring what we need.

Together we can make the universe better for all.

Narina Lerrem
Senior Manager
Clinical Research Outsourcing

missions.title: Want Polaris? Need something special.
missions.desc:
Wikelo need large amounts of quantainium and is willing to give you nice Polaris in exchange but also know many humans not have much space, so you trade as you go. Wikelo will you Polaris bits if you want trade quantainium. Work like favors. Help Wikelo remember how much you give.

Bring quantainium to {ListAll} and will trade for bits.

Bye.

missions.title: Want Taurus ship
missions.desc: Wikelo came across plans to build Constellation Taurus ship. Nice ship, but Wikelo make a little better. Prettier too. If you want, bring stuff.

missions.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: {TargetName} (ERT)
missions.desc:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

You might have heard of {TargetName} before. They’re an extreme-risk target and they’ve been making headlines recently. The hope is you’ll be able to put together a response team and help BlacJac shut them down for good. Our most recent intel has their sub-capital ship and heavily armed escorts flying over at {Address}.

I’d recommend making sure you’ve got an up-to-date imprint before heading out. Just in case.

Good luck,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: {TargetName} (HRT)
missions.desc:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Your next bounty, {TargetName}, is definitely considered a high-risk target for good reason. They’re known to travel with some serious firepower and are escorted by enough protection to make anyone think twice about picking a fight.

Sources indicate that {Last} is hiding out over at {Address}. When you head out to track them down, just make sure you’re prepared. Might even think about bringing along some backup yourself.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: {TargetName} (LRT)
missions.desc:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Bounty came in for a low-risk target by the name of {TargetName}. The target themselves isn’t all that much to worry about, but it seems that they typically fly in a pack, so there’s a high chance they’ll have a few friends along when you track them down.

Speaking of, I’d start the hunt over at {Address} since we have reports of them being spotted in the area.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: {TargetName} (MRT)
missions.desc:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Need you to sort out {TargetName}, a moderate-risk bounty last seen at {Address} flying a small, multicrew ship.

We weren’t able to get details on exactly what they were piloting, but it seems they did have a few other ships with them. Be ready for a fair bit of resistance when you come calling.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: {TargetName} (VHRT)
missions.desc:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

BlacJac just got word that a very high-risk target, {TargetName}, was spotted moving through the flight lanes over at {Address} piloting a formidable ship with a heavy escort.

We want this bounty closed out before they commit any more crimes. Gather whatever resources or support you need, and head out as soon as you can.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Wanted by ArcCorp: {TargetName} (VLRT)
missions.desc:
ATTN: Bounty Hunters

Got a very low-risk target I need you to take care of: {TargetName}.

Their last known location was {Address}.

This is a low threat bounty, so I expect you to be able to clear it pretty fast. They typically fly a small ship and don’t have very many known acquaintances. It doesn't get much more straightforward than that.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: Wanted: {TargetName}
missions.desc:
Here's the deal, we just got word that a XenoThreat power player named {TargetName} just came out of hiding and was spotted at {Address}.

Headhunters have been hungry to put this asshole in the ground for months, so we launched an assault against the outpost, but the Judge wants to make sure {Last} doesn't slip away, so they want to use you as insurance.

This'll be a tough kill in the middle of a warzone, but we'll pay out if you pull it off.

Stows out.

missions.title: Wasting Their Stockpile
missions.desc:
Look, Headhunters don't waste time on petty revenge, but I'm not about to let this nonsense fly either.

Some asshole took out a bunch of my crew and has been bragging all over about it. I've also heard that this nullbrain is stockpiling quantum fuel over at {Address}. I'd like to see how they deal with some real heat when you fly over there and burn everything they've built to the ground. Oh, and with the amount of firepower they got gathered over there, wouldn't be smart to fly alone on this one, so take a crew with you.

-Stows out

missions.title: What is Terrapin?
missions.desc:
Wikelo not know this Human word but ship is very useful when things go danger. If you want, can give new version of it. Maybe more useful?

You fly and tell. Bye.

missions.title: Where Wolf? Here Wolf
missions.desc: If you want to be quiet and surprise people, this is the Wolf you want. Wikelo mod it to be extra stealth. Trade you for it when you bring me the items I want.

missions.title: Wikelo Arrive to System
missions.desc:
Hello, I am Wikelo. Recent addition to your system and very excited to be here. Spent many time here in UEE and happy to spent more.

Have place where I make things from other things.

Need person to bring me useful things to finish project I work on. You have list. Get, please. I am at {ListAll}.

Will give you item for your help.

Also, when done, if you want to do more. Have many things can make in my humble shop. Come, look at pretty poster and then decide what you want me to make.

Bye.

missions.title: Wikelo Navy F7
missions.desc: Know how much you Humans like Navy so Wikelo have one now. If you want Wikelo version of F7 mk2, bring me things and you are in. Very funny. Bye.

missions.title: Wildlife Control: {Creature}
missions.desc:
ABOUT THE JOB
microTech Protection Services need a professional to bring the number of {Creature} in the wild back to within acceptable parameters. Their population is increasing too quickly, and culling some of their numbers will help ensure the situation doesn’t spiral out of control.

RESPONSIBILITIES
• Provide own transportation.
• Locate the {Creature} on {Location}.
• Use force as necessary to eliminate the {Creature}.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
• 1 year of relevant mercenary and/or security experience.
• Access to combat equipment.
• Available for immediate deployment.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
• Experience with extermination

For more information on the animals in question, refer to "The Guide to Stanton Wildlife" in your Journal.

missions.title: Wipe Out Drug Stash
missions.desc:
ATTN: Verified Mercenary Operators

It seems there’s a new operator trying their hand at manufacturing drugs over at {Address}, but the product they’re putting out is extremely toxic.

We’re sorting through how to handle the arrests, but the important thing is to prevent any more of their supply getting distributed. I need you to get down there and destroy the drugs they’re storing on site.

There's a good chance the facility isn't abandoned, so you might run into these thugs when you head down there, so be ready for a fight. But if their gun skills are anything like their chemistry, it probably won’t be much of one.

Thanks,
Gloria Mesa

Private Contract Supervisor
BlacJac Security, "Protection Provided"

missions.title: XenoThreat Lieutenant needs some killing
missions.desc:
Headhunters just rallied up a crew to go hit {Address} and wipe out the XenoThreat there, but I'm looking to add some extra insurance.

See there's this heavy hitter there named {TargetName} who's up in the XenoThreat command structure and we want them taken out. Every other one you kill is gravy, but they're your prime target.

-Stows

missions.title: Yellow Level Contract: Clear Out PAF
missions.desc:
We’ve been tracking a group of outlaws who’ve been causing trouble for one of our clients. Seems they’ve taken up residence at an old Hathor facility. Don’t know what their plans with that old facility are but our client is eager to have them taken care of.

Looking for someone to go to {Address} and neutralize these targets.

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

variants.title: Yellow Level Contract: Clear Out PAF

missions.title: Yellow Level Contract: Clear Shipjacking Group
missions.desc:
There's a small group of criminals that have been marking their territory, striking out any freighters that get close enough. They got a little too greedy though, because now someone's paying us to go deal with them.

Once you and whoever you're bringing are ready, go to {Address} and engage with these criminals. Since they like to fly in separate packs, be sure you wait around to clear every last one of them out.

Good luck,

Marcus Clenn
Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

variants.title: Yellow Level Contract: Clear Shipjacking Group

missions.title: Yellow Level Contract: Disrupt Operations
missions.desc:
We've just received the location of an outlaw outpost where some up-and-coming criminals have been hanging out. Now, our client says there's no reason to engage these folks directly. Instead you will be targeting their supply lines.

Fly on over to {Address} and take out their fuel stores while dealing with any minimal resistance they may put up. It will be your call on how much you engage with the hostile forces, just don't forget that your main objective is ensuring those fuel tanks are out of action.

This is a yellow level contract so pay will be proportionate.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

Foxwell Enforcement is a bonded security specialist licensed to operate throughout the UEE. We are always looking for new operators to join our family. If you or anyone you know is interested, please reach out to one of our contract representatives.

missions.title: Yellow Level Contract: Limiting Potential Threat
missions.desc:
A bunch of outlaws have been harassing our client and recently things have taken a turn for the worse. They've taken over their property and we've exhausted all other options.

We need a decent pilot to head to {Address} and take out their fuel tanks. If you can cut off their supplies, you can pave the way for the client to take back their property.

This shouldn't be a tough one. You might run into a ship or two and maybe a few turrets, but you've been authorized to use lethal force. All we need for you to do is get in there, get the fuel tanks, and get out.

Good luck,

Kevin Walton
Dispatcher, Foxwell Enforcement
'Security, Your Way'

missions.desc:
We’ve been following a group of outlaws on behalf of a client, and it looks like they’ve taken a permanent pit stop on an old orbital platform.

We’re looking for a contractor who can head over to {Address} and neutralize the targets. The platform is crawling with a bunch of armed and dangerous thugs, so we’ve designated this a yellow level contract.

missions.title: Yellow Level Contract: Neutralize Shipjacking Gang
missions.desc:
Okay, this might be a bit of stretch to do on your own, so if you got any favors to call in, it could be good to cash those chits now. There's a group of desperados striking delivery ships up and down this sector and we've been tasked with cleaning them up.

Once your crew is ready, head over to {Address} and take the hostiles there down. Now, these bastards are a bit clever so they tend to split up into smaller packs. Make sure you wait around to clear every last one of them out.

Good luck,
